bluejetty:00025875:android.description:
Challenge the levels to get rich resources and speed up!
War strategy mobile game! Waiting for you to fight!
As unknown viruses spread, human civilization has fallen from grace. At the intersection of the old and the new world, you are the Commander in this doomsday that marks the fall of the old and start of the new. Crossing this threshold to enter the new world will be a very challenging task. But don’t worry, you are not alone in this fight for survival.
[Features]
**New Base Attack & Defense Battles and Quick Siege Mode is open**
**Clear stages with 5-person Squad to get 1 million Soldiers!**
**Lots of Newbie bonuses, includes “Caelum City” Troop March Appearance**
**Routine gameplay with abundant rewards!**
[Strategic Gameplay]
▶ Survive the Zombie Horde ◀
While the humankind is falling apart, you will thrive to win every future battle in the doomsday. Build, upgrade, and expand your own army into an invincible force. Zombies are everywhere attacking in endless hordes. This power will help you survive. Survivors also want more than just surviving. They can be as dangerous as zombies. You’ll need the power to fight against them too. Every victory will push you further on the path of survival.
▶ Build Your Base ◀
Survive first to rebuild human civilization. Build your base from scratch to make it safe and stable. When doing this, you need to manage all resources to maximize productivity of the base and enhance the defense system to prepare for future attacks both inside and outside the wall. This is not just any base. It is your home, Commander. Please protect it!
▶ Real-Time Strategy ◀
During a horde attack, you can be ambushed at any time. But no worries, March forward! As the Commander, you need to deploy different heroes strategically so that they can break through the siege of the hordes. Only those with good tactics can survive! Use your strategies to survive in this world full of zombies!
▶ Unite with All Survivors ◀
Hearing "you are not alone" from someone in the doomsday is heartwarming yet somewhat daunting. Meet other survivors and build an alliance. But remember, choose your allies carefully. A friendly environment and a decent leader of the alliance will help you grow better. Or, you can become the leader yourself to forge a powerful civilization in this deadly jungle. Be careful of survivors lurking in unknown places. After all, human nature is unpredictable, especially in the doomsday when old rules don’t work any more.
▶ Explore the Map ◀
In the doomsday, this vast land is no longer in the hands of human beings. But humankind cannot be chained between those high walls! You need to climb over the walls, investigate, explore, and fight to get more food and resources for the base or even save other Survivors. In this wasteland, you will also encounter unusual challenges. Use strategies and the power of your army to conquer them one by one. Commander, do you have the will, the commitment to bringing back human civilization to its former glory?
Please keep in touch!
Customer Service Email: ZSW@eggtartgame.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100082131654585
Discord: https://discord.gg/CbssYxM5Zm

bluejetty:00163599:ios.summary:
Record Scanner - Vinyl & CD is an app that will help you to build, store & manage your record collection - Identify, check the price & search for songs! You can detect the song even if you have only its cover or barcode!
Main features & be
bluejetty:00163599:ios.description:
Record Scanner - Vinyl & CD is an app that will help you to build, store & manage your record collection - Identify, check the price & search for songs! You can detect the song even if you have only its cover or barcode!
Main features & benefits:
- Easily identify a record by scanning its cover, barcode, or catalog number.
- Quickly add records to your collection or wishlist.
- Establish LPs/CDs/Cassettes market value.
- Add additional info about the records you own.
- Place records in your virtual cabinet in our cloud storage.
- Instantly play the records you identified on Spotify.
- Close integration with Discogs.
- Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Swedish, Portuguese, Dutch and Arabic.
Other features: Manual search, Filter by details, Export collection to CSV, Add custom records, Add app localization, Create a Spotify playlist.
Identifying LPs or CDs by typing complex serial numbers on a small smartphone keyboard can be frustrating. Record Scanner reduces this process to two simple steps:
1. Take a photo of the cover
2. Specify your record format (CD / LP / Cassette)
And that's it!
Record Scanner enables you to have your full collection at hand - hundreds of records in your pocket!
Use cases:
- Found an interesting gem in a record store but you're not sure about paying the price? Check the real value of the record instantly with Record Scanner!
- Want to sell some records from your collection and make room for new ones. Quickly scan your titles, jump directly to Discogs, add to your store and it's done.
- A huge delivery just arrived to the record store you own and you need to quickly price all the records. Try this path: record => smartphone => photo => average prices online.
- You see an interesting record sale offer online: a lot of photos of records for sale and one price for them all. Use Record Scanner to quickly check their individual prices.
- You just realized that Discogs has a great collection manager feature - it might be worth to list hundreds of your records there. Listing all your records might take weeks... Not with this fancy mobile app!
Download our Vinyl & CD tool and start exploring the world of music - Create and manage your music collection! Enjoy the unique and reliable music record identifier and detector!
---

bluejetty:00079319:ios.description:
Don't take chances with your passwords or private information. mSecure is the simple, secure way to manage logins, passkeys, 2FA codes, and sensitive data across every device you own — protected by industry-standard AES-256 encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.
WHAT'S NEW IN MSECURE 7
● Passkeys — sign in to passkey-enabled sites without a password.
● Built-in one-time passwords (OTP) — keep your 2FA codes alongside your logins, no separate authenticator app required.
● Two-Factor Aware — see which of your logins support two-factor authentication, so you know where it's worth turning on.
● Sharing Center — a unified place to manage vaults and shared records.
● Redesigned Record Details, Edit, and Recents views.
● Custom filters — save up to 5 views.
● Enhanced search with the search bar pinned to the top.
● Improved password generator and a refreshed light mode.
—————————————————
CHOOSE THE PLAN THAT FITS
Every tier is protected by the same AES-256 encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.
● Free — unlimited records, password generator, smart search and sorting, over 20 built-in templates, and AES-256 encryption with auto-lock.
● Essentials — adds AutoFill, cloud syncing (mSecure Cloud, Dropbox, iCloud, or Wi-Fi), Face ID and Touch ID unlock, passkeys, built-in one-time passwords, Two-Factor Aware, Security Center, custom templates, custom icons, file attachments, backup and CSV import, and Apple Watch support.
● Premium — adds the Sharing Center, custom filters, advanced field settings, multiple tags per record, and username selection.
● Family — every Premium feature for you plus 4 family members, with shared vaults and a Family Sharing Center for admins.
● Teams — 10 licenses so you and up to 9 colleagues are covered under one plan, with shared vaults, monthly add and remove of members, more licenses available at cost, and a separate Family plan included for the team admin.
—————————————————
SECURE — Protect your information with confidence
● AES-256 encryption, end to end, on every plan.
● Zero-knowledge architecture — your master password never leaves your device.
● Biometric unlock with Face ID or Touch ID.
● Auto-lock keeps your vault safe when you step away.
● Security Center surfaces weak, duplicate, and old passwords, and flags which accounts support two-factor authentication.
● Password generator with customizable length, symbols, and complexity.
SIMPLE — Add, find, and organize without friction
● iOS Password AutoFill in Safari and supported third-party apps.
● Over 20 built-in templates, plus full custom templates.
● Powerful search, smart sorting, tags, and custom filters.
● Redesigned Record Details and Edit views speed up data entry.
● Apple Watch support for quick lookups on the go.
SEAMLESS — Sync all of your devices seamlessly. Choose to sync via mSecure Cloud, Dropbox, iCloud, or Wi-Fi to access your records on all of your devices across multiple platforms. Keep your data safe and secure with mSecure.
—————————————————
SUPPORT

bluejetty:00177709:ios.name: Combustion Inc.
bluejetty:00177709:ios.summary:
See (and graph!) exact temperatures throughout your food while it cooks. Know exactly when it will be done. View and graph core, surface, and ambient temps in real time.
The wireless Predictive Thermometer was built to answer a simple but
bluejetty:00177709:ios.description:
See (and graph!) exact temperatures throughout your food while it cooks. Know exactly when it will be done. View and graph core, surface, and ambient temps in real time.
The wireless Predictive Thermometer was built to answer a simple but important question: when will my food be ready? Combustion’s Predictive Engine™ estimates exactly when that will be, using the data from 8 onboard sensors (the most of any cooking thermometer).
Important firmware updates! The Combustion App includes the latest firmware updates for Predictive Thermometers and other Combustion Accessories including Boosters, Displays, Giant Grill Gauges and other forthcoming products. Firmware updates improve core functions including time-to-cook predictions, longer battery life, and can add new features.
MeatNet™ Cloud – for functionally unlimited range! Use with WiFi Accessories or with a second mobile device to stream your cook data to the cloud. Watch your cook in real-time from anywhere with internet access. 
Live Activity/Apple Watch support. The Combustion App works with iOS as well as iPadOS and MacOS (M1 or newer). Includes Live Activity (Dynamic Island) display feature so you can watch key temps even when the app is in the background. So handy!
Combustion App Features:
– Set target temp: so that your food comes out just the way you want it
– See predictions in relative time (“ready in” countdown) or in absolute “clock” time
– See key temps in real-time: including TrueCore®, TrueSurface™, TrueAmbient™
– Get notifications for important cooking events with advanced alerts (ready alarm, 5-minute warning, disconnect alert, low battery notification)
– Set SafeCook™ parameters (integrated food-safety)
– Know exactly when your food is safe to eat 
– Set-up WiFi connectivity for Combustion WiFi accessories
– Graph your food’s temperatures in real-time!
– See (and graph) temperatures from all 8 sensors with Advanced Cooking Mode
– Enables multi-node MeatNet™: use any combination of Combustion accessories to extend Bluetooth signal range + strength
– Use with or without Combustion Display
– Export cooking data - to fine-tune your technique
– Update firmware: get better performance and new features for Combustion tools
– Works with most cooking appliances and cookware types
– Works with all kinds of foods and most cooking appliances - BBQ smokers, ovens, ranges, grills, and more - indoors and out.
– Works with or without WiFi
Get more consistent results with all your favorite foods: steak, pork chops, brisket, pork shoulder, roasts, turkey, whole chicken, ribs, fish, bread, and more.
Advanced graphing on the Combustion App helps you visualize exactly how heat moves through your food. You will understand the relationship between ambient cook temps and surface temps. And how surface temps really control how long things take – and how evenly food cooks. It may shock you to find out the oven temp (or grill temp) you set is not the same as the food is actually experiencing! 
The Combustion Inc app puts all that knowledge in front of you – with instant feedback, so you’re not just cooking better, you’re also learning as you go. 
And learning has never been so delicious.

Enjoy the precision of the pencil and eraser, and experiment with expressive brushes and markers. It's the perfect drawing board for digital artists! Creative Freedom & Customization
Express yourself with a vibrant color palette, offering a wide range of hues to bring your drawings to life with this sketchpad. Undo and redo functions allow you to experiment without fear, making the learning process seamless and enjoyable. Experience the fluidity of art flow within a simple, intuitive interface.

Take your creativity to the next level with our innovative features! The AI Sketch Generator helps you create unique artwork instantly, perfect for inspiration or quick drafts. Unleash your inner artist and explore new possibilities with digital drawing.
Draw in a New Dimension
Step into the world of Augmented Reality with our AR Drawing Mode. Bring your creations to life by drawing directly onto your surroundings. It's a fun and immersive experience for artists of all ages, and a great way to practice sketching and drawing techniques. This sketchpad offers a unique blend of traditional and modern art creation.
Unleash your inner artist. Open My Sketchbook and start your artistic journey! Experience the ultimate art flow within a portable drawing board for all levels.
PLEASE NOTE: Some features are only available with subscription. Free version provides you with a limited number of lessons and coloring pages, 1 AI sketch generation. Subscription offers you unlimited access to AI, all lessons and coloring pages.

bluejetty:00062021:ios.name: Boat Master
bluejetty:00062021:ios.summary: Boat Master is a boat navigation and berthing (parking) simulation game where players have to berth different boats in varying conditions. It is designed to replicate the controls and conditions of berthing and navigating a real boat in a m
bluejetty:00062021:ios.description:
Boat Master is a boat navigation and berthing (parking) simulation game where players have to berth different boats in varying conditions. It is designed to replicate the controls and conditions of berthing and navigating a real boat in a marina and coastal channels (rivers and bays) as closely as possible.
Current Features
- Drive and berth a motorboat or superyacht (see screenshots) with 2 engines and bow and stern thrusters, using either berthing controls which allow access to all thrusters and easy individual engine control or driving mode which provides a steering wheel and individual or simultaneous control of both engines.
- Drive a yacht with a single engine and steering wheel, along with bow thrusters in easier levels.
- Drive a speedboat with a single engine & steering wheel as well as realistic tilting when turning at speed.
- Drive a dual engine control Euro Cruiser with a steering wheel but no thrusters.
- Drive a Jet Ski with realistic engine-driven steering, making low speed maneuvering more difficult.
- Drive any boat through a channel in various conditions where you need to obey navigation markers and signs as well as avoid AI-Controlled boats going in the opposite direction. At the end of the navigation level, you then need to berth the boat in a small marina.
- Multiple difficulty levels and berthing conditions and situations, including:
 - A hands-on tutorial level explaining the different controls
 - Wind and current which vary in direction and strength in different levels
 - Different berth locations and widths
 - Randomly timed thruster failure in harder levels
- Berth the boat as quickly as you can without damaging it with the built-in time-based scoring system, as well as a 3-star scoring system, which gives you a rating based on your performance. If you don't obey navigation rules, crash, or are too slow, you won't get the 3 stars for the level (specific rules for getting ratings are outlined at the start of each level on the start screen).
- Realistic water physics with drag based on speed and realistic boat handling (now including prop walk on the yacht)
- multiple camera modes, including views from both sides, the front, back and the top of the boat as well as a camera mode which looks at the target berth from anywhere on the map while keeping the boat in view.
- Console and PC level graphics with modern post-processing effects like Bloom, Ambient Occlusion and Filmic Colour Grading (turn on in settings). You can also improve the performance of the game by reducing reflection resolution, increasing the FPS target, and more. A new battery saver mode and the new balanced mode will automatically determine the best settings for your device.
DISCLAIMER: This app is not a substitute for real life boat berthing or driving training, some boats (Superyacht, Yacht, Speedboats & Jet Ski) are paid (they are behind a one-time in-app purchase that costs real money to unlock). 
MINIMUM HARDWARE:
iPhone 6 / 6S. The iPhone 5S really struggles to run this game, as does the original iPad Air.
RECOMMENDED HARDWARE:
iPhone 6S / 7 / iPad Air 2 or above.
When playing on these devices or above it is recommended to turn on Balanced mode for a better graphical experience.
Turning on post-processing features in settings will reduce the performance of the app, with Bloom and Ambient Occlusion being the most demanding.
Want to get information about upcoming updates to Boat Master and gain early access to them? looking for more progress content such as gameplay videos & progress updates? Follow us on Facebook for all of this inside info, access and more!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/flatWombatStudios/
Website: https://flatwombatstudios.com/
Boat Master has a pending self-certified IGRS rating of 3+.
Music in video previews: "Notanico Merengue" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)

bluejetty:00030577:ios.summary: Tiny Connections is a puzzle game that challenges players to create networks connecting houses with infrastructure in tight spaces. In this engaging game, your mission is to make sure each home gets essential services like power and water,
bluejetty:00030577:ios.description:
Tiny Connections is a puzzle game that challenges players to create networks connecting houses with infrastructure in tight spaces. In this engaging game, your mission is to make sure each home gets essential services like power and water, all while balancing efficiency and community wellbeing.
The challenge isn't a walk in the park. You'll need to cleverly link houses of the same color to their matching stations, all while navigating tricky setups and avoiding lines crossing. To help you out, you'll have access to handy power-ups that introduce progressively tougher puzzles.
With its simple mechanics, Tiny Connections welcomes players into a world where straightforward gameplay hides deep strategy. This game is more than just entertainment; it's a relaxing escape from the chaos of daily life as you connect houses and infrastructure.
Game Features:
- Easy Connection System: Seamlessly connect houses to matching infrastructure.
- Abundant Power-ups: Use tunnels, junctions, house rotations, and powerful swaps to enhance your strategy.
- Real-world Maps: Dive into maps inspired by real countries, each with unique challenges.
- Daily and Weekly Challenges: Compete in time-limited events for rewards and to test your skills.
- Achievements & Leaderboards: Show off your gaming skills, earn achievements, and climb the global leaderboards while enjoying this rich gaming experience.
- Accessibility: We offer a colorblind mode with support for multiple variations, ensuring that all players can enjoy the game to the fullest.
The game supports the following languages: English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish, Russian, Italian, Japanese, Thai, Korean, Portuguese, Turkish.

bluejetty:00018894:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on a challenging and relaxing puzzle-solving journey with Farm Dots, the ultimate dots-matching and connecting game! 
Connect the Dots - In Farm Dots, your mission is simple yet incredibly engaging - connect more than two dots of the same color to create colorful, dazzling pathways. Each level presents you with a unique grid of multicolored dots, and it's your task to skillfully draw lines to match and collect them. The more dots you connect, the closer you get to mastering the challenging levels! Use our unique booster system to blast through the levels even faster.
Features:
Challenging Puzzles - Farm Dots offers a wide range of meticulously crafted puzzles that will test your matching and connecting skills to the limit. From basic dot matching to complex formations, each level presents a fresh challenge that will keep your brain engaged and helps you to relax.
Strategic Gameplay - Farm Dots requires strategy and careful planning. You'll need to think ahead and make wise decisions to connect the dots efficiently and achieve your goals. With every move, you'll feel the thrill of strategy paying off.
Vivid Graphics and Mesmerizing Sound - Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors and eye-catching graphics as you navigate through the game. Farm Dots features stunning visual effects and captivating soundtracks that enhance your gaming experience.
Collect and Master - Your ultimate goal in Farm Dots is to collect as many dots as possible and master each level with the highest scores. As you progress, you'll discover power-ups, bonuses, and surprises that add a new layer of excitement to the game. The possibilities are without limit – Collect em all!
Build your Farm - Complete cozy and exciting areas as you progress through each level, continuously expanding both your farm and land.
Endless Fun - With hundreds of levels to explore, Farm Dots guarantees endless hours of fun and entertainment. The game's difficulty gradually increases, ensuring that players of all skill levels can enjoy the challenge.
Social Features - Connect with your friends and compete to see who can master the most challenging levels. Share your accomplishments and challenge others to beat your high scores in thrilling leagues to gain the best rewards.
Relaxing and Addictive - Farm Dots strikes the perfect balance between relaxation and addiction. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or challenge yourself to conquer complex puzzles, this game offers it all.
Train Your Brain - With its strategic gameplay and intricate puzzles, Farm Dots is not just about connecting dots but also a fantastic way to exercise your brain and improve your problem-solving skills.
Don't miss out on the Farm Dots-connecting craze! Download Farm Dots now and experience the ultimate dots-matching adventure. Connect, collect, and master the art of puzzle-solving in this addictive and challenging game. Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned pro, Farm Dots has something to offer for everyone. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of connecting, collecting, and matching – one dot at a time! 
Remember, every dot counts. Can you connect em all? Download Farm Dots today and find out!
Questions about the game? Ask our support team: fd-support@happy-games.net
Please note Farm Dots – Brain Puzzle is a free-to-play experience; however, some in-game items can be purchased with real money. A network connection is required to play. For further details, please refer to our comprehensive terms of service.

bluejetty:00127575:ios.description:
DateStamper allows you to apply beautiful date stamps overtop your photos – and include time, location, caption, and filename if you’d like.
—
"DateStamper brings back old memories for me ... It looks good, it gets the job done, and it’s nicely integrated with Apple’s Photos app." 
– MacStories Editor-in-chief and Founder, Federico Viticci
—
The modern photo date stamp is here! Easily add a stamp to your photos so you can remember when or where they were taken. Perfect for printing pictures to display in albums or scrapbooks, allowing you to preserve your memories.
The best feature of point and shoot cameras is now available on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac – and better than ever.
Styles
◦ With many fonts, colors, and styles to choose from, you can get just the look you want*
◦ The vibrant style beautifully blends the stamp into the photograph, allowing the image behind to shine through
◦ Or go with a classic look with the traditional digital display font
◦ Add a background color, stroke, shadow, underline, and adjust opacity
◦ Customize the date and time format
◦ Use the date taken, date created, date added, current date, or a custom date
◦ Add the location where your photos were taken — name, address, GPS coordinates, or custom text
◦ Add the photo caption, a custom caption, or filename
◦ Adjust the placement with position and padding options, and change the order of the text
Stamp
◦ Quickly select photos from your library to stamp — select each individually, swipe to select, select a range, or select all photos in an album
◦ Stamp multiple photos at the same time**
◦ Take a new picture with a stamp pre-applied
◦ Use the DateStamper edit extension to stamp a photo directly in the Photos app
◦ Use the Stamp Image action in Shortcuts to automate your workflow
◦ Easily see which photos have been stamped with filters, badges, and a DateStamper album
Edit
◦ Edits are applied right on top of the photo in your library, no duplicating necessary
◦ Remove or change a date stamp at any time, it’s completely nondestructive
◦ With iCloud Photos, when you apply a date stamp on one device, it will appear on all your other devices automatically
Features
◦ Lock Screen widget and Control Center control
◦ Beautiful and intuitive Liquid Glass design
◦ Universal app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
◦ No ads, no tracking, no nonsense
* Premium Styles is an available in-app purchase that allows you to utilize all of the style options
** Unlimited Batch is an available in-app purchase that allows you to stamp more than 10 photos at a time

bluejetty:00087333:ios.name: Sure Petcare
bluejetty:00087333:ios.summary: Sure Petcare™, Reimagining Pet Care. The Sure Petcare™ App is the beating heart of the Sure Petcare ecosystem of connected feeding, drinking and outdoor access solutions, keeping pets connected with their pet parents to enable a new standar
bluejetty:00087333:ios.description:
Sure Petcare™, Reimagining Pet Care. The Sure Petcare™ App is the beating heart of the Sure Petcare ecosystem of connected feeding, drinking and outdoor access solutions, keeping pets connected with their pet parents to enable a new standard of pet care.
• View personalised information and insights about your pet's behaviour for a greater peace of mind
• Gain clarity and a better understanding of your pet’s behaviour and habits throughout their life's journey, ensuring that you are equipped with the knowledge and tools to give them the best possible care at every stage
• Enjoy a stronger connection that goes beyond basic care, addressing your pet’s unique care needs and ensuring they have the best quality of life while making things more convenient for yourself
What you can expect:
Insights
• Monitors a pet’s water consumption and drinking patterns when used with Felaqua™ Connect
• Supports measured food portioning and monitors a pet’s food consumption and eating pattern when used with the SureFeed™ Microchip Pet Feeder Connect 
• Tracks a cat’s comings and goings and monitors their outdoor routines when used with the SureFlap™ Microchip Cat Flap Connect or SureFlap Microchip Pet Door Connect
Understanding
• Timeline: Quickly check on what’s happened during the day
• Historic records grouped into daily, weekly, monthly or six-monthly overviews, easily look back in time to compare and spot trends 
• Pet Reports: Export to save or share your pet’s data as a PDF with your vet
Connection
• User invitations: Share the care, connection and insights with your family and friends
• Going on holiday? Provide your pet sitter with greater visibility of what your pets are up to and when they might need immediate attention by adding them to your app household 
• Stay connected to your pets while away: Receive push notifications about your pet’s comings and goings, when and how much they ate or drank, and when their food or water needs replenishing
Convenience
• All your pets and products in one place: each pet has their own pet tile with a summary view of their products and daily highlights
• Food portioning: Set up your pet’s food portion sizes in the app to help provide an optimal diet (SureFeed only)
• Curfews: Remotely set automatic locking and unlocking times, you are in control wherever you are (SureFlap only)
• Invite your friends, family and pet sitters into the app to help sharing responsibilities while gaining better clarity and connection
Product compatibility:
SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect - Stops pet stealing each other’s food. Equipped with an integrated scale, LED portioning guides and compatible with the Sure Petcare App, it helps you provide your cat with a diet that is tailored to their individual needs and enables you to build a detailed record of their feeding habits. 
Felaqua Connect - A drinking monitoring solution designed to encourage drinking by delivering water in a cat-friendly way, while taking away the maintenance hassle of cat fountains. It recognises your pets by their unique microchip ID or their Sure Petcare RFID Collar Tag while they’re drinking and builds a record of their water consumption and drinking patterns.
SureFlap Microchip Cat Flap Connect - Allows authorised cats safe, secure access while keeping intruder animals out of your home. Set curfews, remotely lock or unlock and easily check in to see if your cats are home, even when you aren’t.
SureFlap Microchip Pet Door Connect - Ideal if you have a larger cat or small dogs. Allows authorised pets safe, secure access while keeping intruder animals out of your home. Set a curfew, remotely lock or unlock and easily check in to see if your pets are home, even when you aren’t. 
IMPORTANT: The Sure Petcare App only works with Sure Petcare Connect products and requires a Sure Petcare Hub for connection. If you have purchased a Sure Petcare Animo® Activity and Behaviour Monitor, please download the Sure Petcare – Animo App.

Sure Petcare™, Reimagining Pet Care. The Sure Petcare™ App is the beating heart of the Sure Petcare ecosystem of connected feeding, drinking and outdoor access solutions, keeping pets connected with their pet parents to enable a new standard of pet care.
•	View personalised information and insights about your pet's behaviour for a greater peace of mind
•	Gain clarity and a better understanding of your pet’s behaviour and habits throughout their life's journey, ensuring that you are equipped with the knowledge and tools to give them the best possible care at every stage
•	Enjoy a stronger connection that goes beyond basic care, addressing your pet’s unique care needs and ensuring they have the best quality of life while making things more convenient for yourself
What you can expect:
Insights
•	Monitors a pet’s water consumption and drinking patterns when used with Felaqua™ Connect
•	Supports measured food portioning and monitors a pet’s food consumption and eating pattern when used with the SureFeed™ Microchip Pet Feeder Connect 
•	Tracks a cat’s comings and goings and monitors their outdoor routines when used with the SureFlap™ Microchip Cat Flap Connect or SureFlap Microchip Pet Door Connect
Understanding
•	Timeline: Quickly check on what’s happened during the day
•	Historic records grouped into daily, weekly, monthly or six-monthly overviews, easily look back in time to compare and spot trends 
•	Pet Reports: Export to save or share your pet’s data as a PDF with your vet
Connection
•	User invitations: Share the care, connection and insights with your family and friends
•	Going on holiday? Provide your pet sitter with greater visibility of what your pets are up to and when they might need immediate attention by adding them to your app household 
•	Stay connected to your pets while away: Receive push notifications about your pet’s comings and goings, when and how much they ate or drank, and when their food or water needs replenishing
Convenience
•	All your pets and products in one place: each pet has their own pet tile with a summary view of their products and daily highlights
•	Food portioning: Set up your pet’s food portion sizes in the app to help provide an optimal diet (SureFeed only)
•	Curfews: Remotely set automatic locking and unlocking times, you are in control wherever you are (SureFlap only)
•	Invite your friends, family and pet sitters into the app to help sharing responsibilities while gaining better clarity and connection
Product compatibility:
SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect - Stops pet stealing each other’s food. Equipped with an integrated scale, LED portioning guides and compatible with the Sure Petcare App, it helps you provide your cat with a diet that is tailored to their individual needs and enables you to build a detailed record of their feeding habits. 
Felaqua Connect - A drinking monitoring solution designed to encourage drinking by delivering water in a cat-friendly way, while taking away the maintenance hassle of cat fountains. It recognises your pets by their unique microchip ID or their Sure Petcare RFID Collar Tag while they’re drinking and builds a record of their water consumption and drinking patterns.
SureFlap Microchip Cat Flap Connect - Allows authorised cats safe, secure access while keeping intruder animals out of your home. Set curfews, remotely lock or unlock and easily check in to see if your cats are home, even when you aren’t.
SureFlap Microchip Pet Door Connect - Ideal if you have a larger cat or small dogs.  Allows authorised pets safe, secure access while keeping intruder animals out of your home. Set a curfew, remotely lock or unlock and easily check in to see if your pets are home, even when you aren’t. 
IMPORTANT: The Sure Petcare App only works with Sure Petcare Connect products and requires a Sure Petcare Hub for connection. If you have purchased a Sure Petcare Animo® Activity and Behaviour Monitor, please download the Sure Petcare – Animo App.

bluejetty:00179796:ios.name: Pocket Anatomy
bluejetty:00179796:ios.summary:
“Navigating the human body couldn't be EASIER”.
Loved by Millions Worldwide.
Complete sections of the app are now FREE, so boost your anatomy knowledge TODAY! With our multi award-winning app, it’s easy: retrieve any anatomical structure
bluejetty:00179796:ios.description:
“Navigating the human body couldn't be EASIER”.
Loved by Millions Worldwide.
Complete sections of the app are now FREE, so boost your anatomy knowledge TODAY! With our multi award-winning app, it’s easy: retrieve any anatomical structure and relevant clinical information in an instant. Search through 1000s of anatomical structures such as ligaments, tendons, arteries, veins, organs, and glossary items. Browse by system layers including skin, skeletal, connective tissue, muscular, circulatory, digestive, reproductive, lymphatic, respiratory, urinary and more…
“User Interface: This is really what separates this app from the rest. Easy and high resolution zooming and movement. Navigating the body couldn't be easier. Of all the anatomy apps I've seen this is definitely one of the best.” *****
“Thinking of you: All the anatomy apps have the blue dots with information, but with Pocket Anatomy you can click on a muscle and it will give you origin, insertion, key relations, functions (actions), nerve and blood supply, and clinical perspectives” *****
Why? The following unique combination of features makes Pocket Anatomy the superior Anatomy and Physiology product in the marketplace (Please note: a subscription is needed to access the app content.)
1. INTUITIVE SEARCH
Confusion is easy when it comes to anatomy terms. With our intuitive search option it will suffice to type in only the first characters of the word you are looking for, or one of the words composing the main term. E.g. If you type in “trap” you will get “trapezoid” as well as “coracoclavicular-trapezoid ligament”. The more letters you type the more refined the search.
2. INTUITIVE NAVIGATION
Fly around the male and female human body by swiping your finger on the screen, fluidly navigating from the skin layer through the superficial to deep musculature, and on through to internal organ structures, ligaments and the skeletal system.
3. RICH CONTENT
Pocket Anatomy includes full 3D male and female anatomy as well as detailed stand alone visual information on circulatory, connective tissue, digestive, integumentary, lymphatic, muscular, reproductive, respiratory, skeletal and urinary systems.
4. CLINICAL RELEVANCE
Anatomical structures in each layer are pinned for identification. Each pin is associated with additional concise relevant information and clinical notes.
5. GREAT STUDY TOOL
Studying for your next Anatomy and Physiology exam? Add your notes next to a pin, bookmark the content you are interested in and retrieve it every time you need it. Test your knowledge with your classmates or challenge yourself with our quizzes.
6. YOU’RE IN GOOD COMPANY
***** "This BEAUTIFUL app offers mobile medical education for students." ~ Apple iTunesU
***** “EXCELLENT visuals and seamless 3D navigation” ~ MedGadget
***** “Renders the old text-book pretty close to obsolete” ~ CNET
7. OUR COMMITMENT
We are committed to offer you the best updated content to help you enhance your anatomy learning experience. With regular updates, we are committed to ensuring that your voices are heard. Please email us at hello@PocketAnatomy.com and share your feedback on how to improve the content, usability & design of our apps.
Best,
The PA Team

Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/
SUBSCRIPTION & IN-APP PURCHASES
This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available. You can buy individual units of content via in-app purchases. Alternatively, if you subscribe to the app you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the rate of the selected subscription plan.
• You can change your mind at any point. Cancelling can be done through your iTunes settings.
• Your subscription will auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account.
• After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings.
• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with the same Apple ID that you subscribed from.

bluejetty:00100693:ios.name: Storytime: Truth and Tales
bluejetty:00100693:ios.summary: Give your child stronger focus, more creativity, more empathy and better ways to handle big feelings, the abilities that help children learn and get along with others. In Truth and Tales, children ages 4 to 8 build them through play: intera
bluejetty:00100693:ios.description:
Give your child stronger focus, more creativity, more empathy and better ways to handle big feelings, the abilities that help children learn and get along with others. In Truth and Tales, children ages 4 to 8 build them through play: interactive Teaching Stories, audiobooks with human narration, read-along, coloring and movement. Research-based and made with neuroscientists and educators. No ads, and no data collected from children.
Used by 100,000+ families and educators worldwide.
WHAT YOUR CHILD GAINS
- Focus: stories that hold attention without flashing rewards, timers or autoplay
- Creativity: characters solve problems in unexpected ways, showing your child there is more than one way to see a situation
- Empathy: open questions after each story invite your child to imagine how others think and feel
- Handling big feelings: your child practices noticing what they feel and choosing what to do next, the ability educators call self-regulation
- Flexible and critical thinking: puzzles and choices that reward a fresh look, not a memorized answer
WHAT YOUR CHILD PLAYS
- Interactive Teaching Stories: narrative games with choices and puzzles, followed by questions with no single right answer
- Audiobooks: professional human narration, never AI-generated, for bedtime and car rides (works offline)
- Read-along: words highlighted as they are spoken, a support for children learning to read
- Artist's Gallery: coloring inspired by the stories
- Move It Move It: body movement inspired by yoga and tai chi
WHY TEACHING STORIES
Teaching Stories are traditional tales shared across cultures for over a thousand years, particularly from Central Asia and the Middle East. Unlike fables that teach what to think, or behavioral stories that model what to do, Teaching Stories develop how children think by presenting characters who solve challenges through unexpected solutions. Our approach draws on decades of work by Robert Ornstein, Idries Shah, Arthur Deikman, Doris Lessing, Georgi Lozanov and Paul Zak, and Truth and Tales is designed with doctors, educators and neuroscientists.
LEARNING THROUGH PLAY, NOT POINTS
No points, badges or streaks: the story itself is the game, and nothing autoplays. Research shows external rewards can reduce intrinsic motivation over time (Deci et al., 1999), so here your child plays because the story is worth playing.
FOR TEACHERS
Educator logins and individual child access codes, with no child accounts or personal data. Pedagogical guides for every activity; one device per child, in pairs or as a whole class. Addresses all five CASEL competencies.
QUESTIONS FAMILIES ASK
What will my child develop?
Attention, creativity, empathy, emotional intelligence, cognitive flexibility and critical thinking. Research on social-emotional learning reports 11 to 13 percentile-point academic gains (Durlak et al., 2011). That describes the research field, not measured results for this app.
Is it free?
Several stories and activities are free. A subscription opens everything, starts with a free trial and can be cancelled anytime in your App Store settings. No ads either way.
Does my child need to read?
No. Every instruction is narrated, so a four-year-old can start before reading and grow into the text.
Does it work with a screen reader?
Yes. Screens, menus and controls have spoken labels for VoiceOver on iPhone and iPad, plus dyslexia-friendly fonts, a color-blind accessible palette and simple controls for reduced mobility. Artwork tapped inside a story scene is not described yet.
Is it safe?
Ad-free, no data collected from children, and the grown-ups' area sits behind a parental gate. Compliant with COPPA, GDPR, the UK Children's Code, LGPD and PIPEDA. Privacy policy and support at truthandtales.app.
Mom's Choice Gold Award | GESAwards 2025 Winner | Apple "Kids We Love" and "App of the Day" | BIG Festival Impact Educational Award

bluejetty:00083795:ios.summary:

“I’d recommend Hush to anyone who uses Safari”

bluejetty:00083795:ios.description:
Browse the web like it should be – free of nags to accept cookies or privacy invasive tracking. It's tiny, fast, free, open, secure and without any access to your data.
“I’d recommend Hush to anyone who uses Safari”
— John Gruber, Daring Fireball
SECURE AND PRIVATE
Hush doesn't have any third party dependencies, behavioral tracking nor crash reporting – no data is collected and nothing leaves your device. 
The blocking is done by Safari itself with instructions from Hush, so the app has no access to your browser habits nor does it want to. Don't take our word for it – we play with open cards and publish the source code for anyone to inspect. 
SIMPLE YET POWERFUL
Using Hush is as easy as installing it and enabling it in Settings -> Apps -> Safari -> Extensions. No settings, no maintenance – just thousands of rules doing the hard work for you in the background. 
It works like magic – you will not notice Hush until you disable it. 
MODERN, TINY AND FAST
The app is primarily a host of rules that integrates with Safari in a native lightweight way, making the blocking efficient, fast and easy on your disk space.
FREE AND OPEN
Hush is both free of charge and Open Source with a permissive MIT license. No in-app purchases, no nonsense. 
AVAILABLE ON ALL DEVICES
Hush is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Today, our language learning approach has evolved for the digital age, bringing experiential, immersive learning online on a global scale.

bluejetty:00069261:ios.summary:

- Clans & playing with a
bluejetty:00069261:ios.description:
Chess is a smart entertainment for children and adults. Play chess online with people from around the world and develop logical thinking.
The main features of our Chess application:
- The Chess application is free
- Clans & playing with a friend online
- The Book of Chess with chess strategies
- Playing chess online with Blitz mode and competing in tournaments
- 10 different levels of difficulty
- Challenges with hundreds of chess puzzles and piles of gold to collect
- Hints are available to show the most advantageous moves
- Undo, you can use this option in the case of a mistake
- Chess Rating presents your personal score
- Game Analysis helps you to progress.
*Chess online & Chess with friends - multiplayer mode!*
Play multiplayer Chess & defeat your opponents!
Crave for playing chess online? This is a great option for 2 players! Play with friends online or face people from all over the world in an online chess duel. Decide which online option suits you best.
Do you miss your friends?
Renew your friendships!
Add friends in the app and invite a friend to the game.
Remember to share your thoughts in the in-app chat!
*The Book of Chess & Chess Openings*
Earn Experience Points (XP) after each online game to unlock new pages of the Book. The Book of Chess is filled with secret chess content - from classic strategies and top players to fun facts and tips. It also includes a guide to chess openings. Follow the moves on the board and learn chess strategies step by step. Apply your new skills in matches or tournaments!
*Clans… Clans? Clans!*
Create your clan or join a CLAN! Lead up to great triumph through unity and cooperation among clan members. Focus on goals to achieve success.
*Tournaments*
Try your hand at Blitz ARENA tournaments!
Sign up for tournaments in advance by clicking the *Join* button, and when the tournament starts, tap *Start playing* and compete!
*Chess Rating and Game Analysis*
Check your progress with ELO Rating. This is the rating system that assesses your skill level in playing chess and presents scores and the history of your results. 
Improve your tactics! Game Analysis allows you to look over your gameplay. This feature points out the moves you should avoid in the future and the ones you should stick to.
*Mini-game and Chess Puzzles*
When you don't want to play a full game or multiplayer chess mode, solve chess puzzles. Move to a distant land, earn gold with Knight moves, and explore hundreds of puzzles. Each square on the board contains a chess puzzle you must solve to move on. Chess puzzles are quick tasks where you checkmate your opponent in a limited number of moves.
*10 levels of chess difficulty*
Chess for beginners, children, or perhaps for a master? Everyone will find a level suitable for their chess skills. Choose from 10 different difficulty levels, train, and check your chess tactics in the multiplayer chess duel.
Our Chess application gives sheer pleasure as standard gameplay with a friend or playing online.
Playing our Chess app also entertains, educates children, and develops their intellectual skills.
*Undoing movements*
Have you made a mistake or want to try another tactic? No problem. Use the Undo button and win!
*Hints*
If you need a hint on your next move, use the Hint. Move the piece to the highlighted field to defeat the opponent. The Hints will help you learn the most successful game strategies. They are great for beginners and more experienced chess players.
Learn new moves and impress your friends while playing chess online.
Chess is famous worldwide - the Portuguese and Brazilians play xadrez, the French play échecs, and the Spanish choose ajedrez. 
Ready for a chess clash? Play chess online with friends!

bluejetty:00138801:ios.description:
تقدم شركة نجم لخدمات التأمين التطبيق الإلكتروني للهواتف الذكية  "نجم" والذى يمكن قائدي المركبات/عملاء شركات التأمين من الإستفادة من الخدمات التالية:
-  التبليغ عن الحوادث 
-  تصوير موقع الحادث
-  متابعة حالة الحادث
-  معرفة الوقت المتوقع لوصول المحقق مع إمكانية معرفة و متابعة موقع المحقق بالخريطة
-  تتبع مسار تقرير الحادث
-  الإستعلام عن حالة وثائق التأمين
-  تحديد مواقع فروع نجم بالخريطة ومعلومات الإتصال
-  إرشادات ومعلومات تهمك
وما يميز هذا التطبيق أنه يساعد بشكل مباشر في تسهيل عملية الإبلاغ عن الحادث المروري وسرعة وصول محقق نجم لموقع الحادث في زمن قياسى وذلك بتحديد موقع الحادث بشكل دقيق وتسجيل رقم الحادث بشكل آلي ومن ثم تعيين المحقق الأقرب آلياً. ومن الممكن أيضاً متابعة حالة الحادث بشكل مباشر إبتداءً من تبليغ الحادث وحتى وصول تقرير الحادث لشركة التأمين المعنية. 
ملاحظات : 
- يدعم  التطبيق حالياً اللغتين العربية و الإنجليزية 
- التطبيق يخدم الحوادث الواقعة في نطاق تغطية شركة نجم داخل المملكة العربية السعودية 
- لا يمكن استخدام التطبيق في المناطق الغير مغطاة من قبل شركة نجم
في حال وجود أي إستفسار الرجاء الإتصال بمركز خدمة العملاء 199033
Najm for insurance services provides a smartphone application “Najm” which enable drivers/insurance Co. clients to take advantage of the following services:
-  Reporting an accident 
-  Taking photos for the accident scene.
-  Following-up with accident status.
-  Knowing the expected investigator arrival time with the possibility to track him on the map.
-  Checking the accident report status.
-  Checking the status of the vehicle policy
-  Locating  Najm’s branches on the map along with contact information.
-  Guidelines and Important Information
This application helps to facilitate the process of traffic accident reporting. It also speeds up the arrival of Najm’s investigator to the accident scene by getting the accurate location of the accident. In addition, it is automatically registering the accident number and assigning the nearest Najm’s investigator.
Also, you can follow-up with the accident status starting from reporting the accident till sending the accident report automatically to the respective insurance company.
Notes:
-   This application currently supports Arabic and English languages.
-   The application serves the accidents occurring within coverage of Najm in Saudi Arabia.
-   You cannot use this application in areas not covered by Najm.
In case of any inquiries, kindly contact customer service on 199033.

bluejetty:00177742:ios.name: Pokémon TCG Live
bluejetty:00177742:ios.summary: Embark on an exciting new adventure with Pokémon Trading Card Game Live—now available on mobile, PC, and Mac OS! Build powerful decks featuring your favorite Pokémon, collect cards at no cost through the Battle Pass, and challenge Trainers
bluejetty:00177742:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting new adventure with Pokémon Trading Card Game Live—now available on mobile, PC, and Mac OS! Build powerful decks featuring your favorite Pokémon, collect cards at no cost through the Battle Pass, and challenge Trainers from around the world in thrilling online matches. Download now and discover a whole new way to enjoy the fun and strategy of the Pokémon Trading Card Game!
HONE YOUR SKILLS
Beginner-Friendly Tutorials: New to the Pokémon TCG or Pokémon TCG Live? Our practice matches and tutorials will guide you step-by-step, helping you become a great Trainer in no time.
Learn Together: Players can learn together by visiting our Learn to Play page. Discover helpful tutorials and tips to enhance your gameplay experience.
Battle Trainers Everywhere: Whether you’re honing your skills, climbing the ranks, or just looking for a friendly match, there’s always someone ready to play wherever you are.
CRAFT YOUR PERFECT DECK: Start things off with eight powerful starter decks based around powerful and iconic Pokémon, including Charizard ex, Pikachu ex, and more. Use the deck editor to craft new cards by collecting Trade Credits through play. Unlock the exact cards you need or upgrade to special rarity versions of cards to show off your favorite Pokémon, Trainers, and places!
FREE REWARDS WITH EVERY EXPANSION
Fresh Battle Passes: Each new expansion release introduces a brand-new Battle Pass loaded with two new competitive decks, tons of booster packs, and deck cosmetics like coins, deck boxes, and card sleeves—all at no cost to the player. Collect rare alternate-art cards and customize your deck along the way.
Challenge the Ladder: Once you find your footing, test your skills in competitive matches and rise through the Leagues. Aim for the prestigious Arceus League, where you can see if you have what it takes to be the very best. 
SWITCH THINGS UP WITH UNIQUE CHALLENGES
Trainer Trials: Step into a constantly evolving game mode packed with fresh new challenges! Build new decks as you master limited-time events such as Silver Series and Gym Leader Challenge!
Casual Formats: Dive into the Expanded format on Pokémon TCG Live, featuring cards stretching back to the Sun & Moon Series, or fine-tune your skills with new decks in relaxed and low-stakes Casual Standard.
PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Cross-Platform Play: Enjoy seamless gameplay with a single collection across mobile devices, PCs, and Macs. Log in with your Pokémon Trainer Club account and pick up where you left off with all your cards at your disposal, no matter where you are.
Note: All features and content are subject to availability. An internet connection is required for online features.
Parents’ Guide: For more information and resources, please visit our Parents’ Guide and Learn to Play page. Discover tips, tutorials, and tools to make your Pokémon Trading Card Game experience both fun and rewarding.

bluejetty:00078861:ios.summary: Realize is like the Sims for your home - a fun, relaxing app that turns designing your place into a game. You get to live the life of an interior designer and design in 3D with real furniture from real décor brands. Bring your dream home to
bluejetty:00078861:ios.description:
Realize is like the Sims for your home - a fun, relaxing app that turns designing your place into a game. You get to live the life of an interior designer and design in 3D with real furniture from real décor brands. Bring your dream home to reality, and customize every detail. BUY FROM THE APP! Choose everything from your favorite wallpaper to the perfect accent rug from hundreds of real life options. Doesn't matter if you're designing your dorm, apartment or home - Realize is for you :)
Realize is where your inspiration finds life! Snag that cute coffee table to go with the armchair you saw at your neighbor’s apartment or just browse through our thousands of products so you can make your space your own.
Imagine if Chip and Joanna Gaines could do a Magnolia style Fixer Upper for you any day of the week, everyday of the year. That’s the Realize Experience. Before and after is a thing of the past. Now you can see the future before you spend thousands of dollars on a couch with cheetah print or a chaise sectional sofa with red linen. Everything is to scale and you can design your dream home and know how much it will cost. Using our new shopping cart feature, you can buy it all!
Shuffle the entire room. Get AI suggestions on similar item. Share your room with others to get feedback before you make the big purchase. Your creativity shouldn’t not be locked away. They’re meant to be shared and enjoyed by all!
We have 1,000’s of beds, desks, rugs, bookcases, tables, chairs, etc. from all of your favorite brands – Pottery Barn, Article, Target, West Elm, Overstock, Herman Miller, Samsung Anthropologie, Arhaus, Restoration Hardware, Wayfair, Burrow, One Kings Lane, Serena & Lily, The Container Store & more!
Whether you’re designing a living room, basement, bedroom, great room, man cave, loft, etc., Realize has you covered. Everything is to scale and you can use overhead view to see the floorplan, or buzz around in 3D to get the perfect view. Designing your home has never been this easy or fun! Decorate your makeover with all of the furniture from our retail partners. We’re adding new pieces from the brands you love every day!
Free Version:
- AR Capture Process and 3D editor
- 500k+ decor item catalog
- Demo Rooms
- Full catalogue of Wallpapers and Floor texture options
- Limited Room Designs
Premium Version:
- AI Features like find me somethin

bluejetty:00092582:ios.description:
DESCRIPTION:
Timeless American style is only a click away. The Dooney & Bourke app puts the quality, craftsmanship and style you love right at your fingertips. It features easy shopping and a faster checkout, plus view app-exclusive special features.   
FEATURES:  
EASY SHOPPING  - Optimized for mobile screens, the Dooney & Bourke app offers an intuitive, organized shopping experience that you can take anywhere. 
  FASTER CHECKOUT -  Wrap up your order quickly and securely while on-the-go. With saved payment information and addresses, checkout has never been easier.
SPECIAL FEATURES  - From app-exclusive products and deals to a behind-the-scenes look at the brand, our app is your personalized look into everything Dooney & Bourke. 
Have a suggestion for new features? Have input on a new design? Email us a line at service@dooney.com.
ABOUT DOONEY & BOURKE
 Founded in 1975 in Norwalk, CT, Dooney & Bourke is an American heritage brand that designs and crafts handbags and accessories with the perfect union of timeless American style, the highest regard for materials and craftsmanship, and a dedication to effortless functionality.

bluejetty:00155374:ios.name: Westwood Plateau Golf Club
bluejetty:00155374:ios.summary: Westwood Plateau is much more than just a golf course, we are a community comprised of residents, visitors, members and the dedicated staff that bring them all together. Our two locations are truly unique, nestled on the Plateau of Eagle Mo
bluejetty:00155374:ios.description:
Westwood Plateau is much more than just a golf course, we are a community comprised of residents, visitors, members and the dedicated staff that bring them all together. Our two locations are truly unique, nestled on the Plateau of Eagle Mountain in Coquitlam BC where we enjoy panoramic views and natural wildlife settings only 45 minutes from downtown Vancouver, BC. From daily tee-times, weddings to golf tournaments you can find it all at Westwood Plateau Golf.
The Westwood Plateau Golf & Country Club includes the following amenities:
- 18-Hole Championship Golf Course
- 35 000 Square Foot Clubhouse
- 3 Private Banquet Rooms
- Rogues Bar & Grill
- Members Practice Area
The Westwood Plateau Executive 12-Hole Course includes the following amenities:
- 12-Hole Executive Golf Course
- Full Size Pro-Shop
- Driving Range
- Fairways Grill & Patio
- Teaching Academy
At Westwood Plateau ‘Above & Beyond’ is much more than a catchy phrase…
‘Above & Beyond’ not only refers to our fantastic location where you can find yourself ‘Above & Beyond’ the clouds, it is a style, an atmosphere, an attitude. It’s tangible and it’s intangible. It’s the manner in which we, as staff, interact with our customers every day. It’s the way we sell a hot dog, host a wedding, or cut the greens and fairways. It’s the way we display merchandise, the way we serve food at the table and the way we look after a bride on her special day or answer the phone to book a tee-time.
‘Above & Beyond’ is made up of little things we excel at. The care and attention we make to the finest of details. That’s what makes us unique.

Favor is the app for Texans to get Anything Delivered®. From an extra-hot latte that meets you at the office to queso delivered (almost) right to your couch, we’re here when y’all are hungry.
Texans’ must-have membership
- Subscribe to the best of Texas with Favor Gold! Packed with uniquely local savings and perks, it’s everything you love about Texas, made even better.
- Members enjoy unlimited $0 delivery fees on almost everything in the app, monthly H-E-B savings, discounts for supporting local, reduced service fees, and much more.
- Try Favor Gold and enjoy 30 days free for a limited time!
PROUDLY PART OF H-E-B
- Experience the quality, value, selection, and service you expect from H-E-B in every single delivery.
- Available exclusively in the Favor app, H-E-B Now is the easiest way to get last-minute groceries right when you need them.
- Get restaurants for when you’re hungry now and groceries for when you’re hungry later—all in one place. Update to the latest version of the app to shop H-E-B Now and all your other in-store favorites!
- Delivery fees are always $0 from H-E-B-owned restaurants and stores, including H-E-B Beer & Wine, True Texas BBQ, and Blooms by H-E-B!
- H-E-B Visa® cardholders also earn unlimited 5% cash back on every Favor order. 
THOUSANDS OF RESTAURANTS AND STORES
- Get the best selection of national and Texas-only restaurants—plus alcohol, flowers, and more—delivered in as little as 45 minutes.
- Support locally-owned businesses and give back to your community.
- Order from favorites like Burger King, McDonald’s, Buffalo Wild Wings, Papa John’s Pizza, Applebee’s, Whataburger, Panda Express, Church’s Chicken, Five Guys, Dairy Queen, California Pizza Kitchen, Firehouse Subs, Hooters, Jersey Mike’s Subs, Pei Wei, Romano’s Macaroni Grill, Urban Bricks Pizza, Velvet Taco, Zoës Kitchen, and more!
DELIVERY YOU CAN HANG YOUR HAT ON
- We’re committed to making sure your order is fresh, accurate, and on time (every time).
TRULY TEXAN HOSPITALITY

- Enjoy one-on-one service and personal updates from your Runner (that’s what we call Favor delivery drivers).
PROUDLY UNAVAILABLE IN 49 STATES
- As a homegrown Texas brand and part of the H-E-B family, we’re uniquely focused on serving fellow Texans in more than 400 cities across the Lone Star State.
- Abilene, Arlington, Austin, Baytown, Beaumont, Brownsville, College Station, Corpus Christi, Dallas, Denton, Fort Worth, Georgetown, Houston, Killeen, Lubbock, Midland, New Braunfels, Odessa, Port Arthur, San Antonio, San Marcos, Temple, and Waco are just a few of them!

bluejetty:00156586:ios.name: Ognomy - The Sleep Apnea App
bluejetty:00156586:ios.summary:
Sleep apnea is a sleep disorder that can affect anyone, at any age. Over 25 million Americans have it, but 80% still remain undiagnosed. 
Ognomy is the world’s easiest way to get tested, diagnosed and treated for it, without ever leaving
bluejetty:00156586:ios.description:
Sleep apnea is a sleep disorder that can affect anyone, at any age. Over 25 million Americans have it, but 80% still remain undiagnosed. 
Ognomy is the world’s easiest way to get tested, diagnosed and treated for it, without ever leaving home. Patients meet doctors virtually through our app, have a video consultation, and get a sleep test sent to their home. They will then review your results and start you on a treatment plan for better sleep, all in a matter of days.
Who Is It For?
- Do you regularly wake up unrefreshed or with a slight headache?
- Do you doze off during the day?
- Are you told you snore?
- Perhaps you get warm at night or kick your feet out from under your sheets to cool down?
- Or, maybe you wake up regularly to urinate at night, more than you think is normal?
If you experience one or more of these symptoms, you may be suffering with sleep apnea. Therefore, it's important to have a consultation with a sleep doctor as only they can give you the proper medical advice.
Why use Ognomy?
1. It’s simple to book video calls with a sleep doctor through the app
2. We will send a sleep test straight to your door
3. You can get treated for sleep apnea from home
4. You no longer have to stay overnight in a sleep center to get tested
5. And we accept most insurances! 
Can I speak to someone on the phone?
Yes, you can call us at 1-877-664-6669 to speak to our Sheepa (customer service) team or email us at sheepa@ognomy.com with any questions.

bluejetty:00185700:ios.name: SeaBattle: Warships Puzzle
bluejetty:00185700:ios.summary: Discover by logic alone where the SeaBattle fleet is hidden in the sea! SeaBattle puzzles are a single player version of the classic game many of us used to enjoy as children. Using pure logic and requiring no math to solve, these addictive
bluejetty:00185700:ios.description:
Discover by logic alone where the SeaBattle fleet is hidden in the sea! SeaBattle puzzles are a single player version of the classic game many of us used to enjoy as children. Using pure logic and requiring no math to solve, these addictive puzzles offer endless fun and intellectual entertainment to puzzle fans of all skills and ages.
A typical SeaBattle puzzle consists of a 10x10 grid containing a hidden fleet of ten known ships. The only information is numbers telling how many ship segments are in each row and column, and some given ship segments in various places in the grid. The object is to discover where all ten ships are located in the grid.
The game includes a pencilmarks feature to place temporary water or ship segments when solving very hard puzzles, and a highlight excluded squares feature to help see where certain ship sizes can be placed.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, SeaBattle contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 160 free SeaBattle puzzles
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Grid sizes up to 10x10
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Show conflicts during gameplay
• Pencilmarks feature for solving hard puzzles
• Autofill Water option
• Show errors during gameplay option
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
SeaBattle puzzles have also become popular under other names such Batalla Naval, Bimaru, Yubotu and Batoru. Similar to Sudoku, Kakuro and Hashi, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00186902:ios.description:
Discover Drivio Australia's revolutionary test system designed exclusively for you! 
Boost your learning potential with our cutting-edge application featuring a staggering 400 practice questions. Unleash the power of convenience as you embark on a journey to rapid progress, leaving traditional methods behind.
With Drivio's intuitive app, you hold the key to success in your hands. Say goodbye to rigid schedules and hello to flexibility! Seamlessly take tests and refine your skills anywhere, anytime. Whether you find yourself at a bustling bus stop, an engrossing classroom, a demanding workplace, or even the dreaded dentist's waiting room, our app ensures you never waste a precious moment.
Don't settle for mediocrity, choose Drivio Australia and experience unparalleled convenience and accelerated learning like never before. Get ready to drive your success to new heights!
APP FEATURES:
- No internet connection required once installed.
- Intelligent learning system
- Search theory content
- Add pages to bookmark
- Keep a track of your driving lessons, input your lessons, add times and dates, traffic conditions, notes and lesson costs
- Easy to use interface with features including:
- Road rules theory of Australian states 
- Test your knowledge with 400 questions 
- Statistics module to track and monitor your progress
- Flashcards with traffic signs
The application is divided into the following sections:
# Road rules theory 
 You can study the official online guides containing all states's traffic laws, traffic signs and regulations.
Included Australian states: 
• New South Wales
• QueenIsland
• Victoria
• Western Australia
• South Australia
• Tasmania
• Northern Territory and
• Australian Capital Territory
In this section you will learn about:
- Licence types
- Road safety
- Safe driving
- General road rules
- Traffic signs
- Penalties and much more.
 # Practice
Test your knowledge by practicing. 
This section have 8 already prepared mock theory tests, all test are created based on 10 categories, these are: 
- General Knowledge 
- Alcohol and Drugs
- Fatigue and Defensive Driving 
- Intersections 
- Traffic Lights / Lanes
- Negligent Driving 
- Pedestrians 
- Seat Belts / Restraints
- Speed Limits
- Traffic Signs
# Flashcards 
This section contains 800 questions, that helps your to memorize better all theory questions. If you have doubts about your answer just tap on the card to see the right answer. Swipe left or right to see next question.
# Progress Monitor 
The application saves the result of each test answered and a history of failures and successes. At the end of the test, you can check your answers and learn from your mistakes. 
Disclaimer
This handbook is not intended to be used as a legal document. It is intended as a guide only, and its aim is to set out, in simple form, the main legal requirements in Australia that a driver is required to observe in everyday driving, as well as other useful information for drivers.
Terms and conditions - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy - https://www.appnursery.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00024639:ios.description:
Discover an amazing sudoku world of 1000+ Nonogram Color puzzles! Solve a logic color by number puzzle to uncover a hidden picture of pixel art. Clean you mind & train your brain. Start playing our color picture cross sudoku puzzles at an easy level, and become a real Nonogram Color master! Download & Challenge!
Nonogram Color is a picture cross sudoku puzzle, you just need to follow the basic rules and logic to reveal the hidden picture. Squares on the board must be colored by number, color or left blank. Numbers show how many squares to color. The color numbers above the column are read from top-to-bottom. Numbers to the left of the rows are read from left-to-right. According to the numbers, color a square or mark it with an X.
Nonogram is also known as Picture Cross, Japanese Sudoku, Hanjie, Picross or Griddlers. Nonogram Color is a new color version of the Sudoku-like picture number puzzle, it’s a great exercise for your brain! This is the upgraded multicolored mode of the monochrome version of the nonogram, making the game more fun, challenging and testing your logic skills. Solve the logic color number puzzles and train your brain NOW!
You only need to follow three steps to get start:
1- Select colors based on clues;
2- Look at the numbers at the ends of the rows and columns;
3- Use logic to fill the blocks and discover the hidden picture!
Color Griddlers will help you to have a good time no matter wherever you are! Griddlers are suitable for almost everyone. Pass the time-solving picture cross sudoku puzzles and play nonogram color puzzles everyday. Perhaps solving color nonogram puzzles will turn into a good habit over time.
Our quick in-game tutorial will have you solving color picture cross challenge puzzles like a genius of sudoku - like puzzle games in no time!
■ 5 difficulty modes for the challenge. Choose the Color Griddlers game difficulty level that is the best for you.
■ Massive themed puzzles await you to complete. Don’t forget to receive your Achievement rewards.
■ Relieve stress with relaxing BGM. Gentle music calms you down.
■ Discover new puzzles at your own pace. Unlock more and more new world

bluejetty:00070102:ios.description:
Forty Thieves Solitaire Classic is for those who like to relax with a challenge! It needs time, some luck, and skill to win. Our app makes other card games look easy, even the infamously hard 4 suit version Spider Solitaire. 
To step up to this to this challenge our tutorials and intuitive controls will ease you in. If you are familiar with Freecell then you’ll quickly understand the rules. Of course, as with all our games, if you are on a winning streak we’ll let you keep on playing. How many rounds can you win in a row?

bluejetty:00131824:ios.description:
FORScan Lite application was developed specially for a computer diagnostics of Ford, Mazda, Lincoln and Mercury vehicles. 
Supported adapters:
- OBDLink MX+ (recommended)
- vLinker FS Bluetooth (recommended)
- vLinker FD BLE (recommended)
- other ELM327-compatible WiFi or BLE adapter (not recommended). Attention: this application may not work properly in case of bad quality ELM327 adapter used!
Supported cars:
- Ford, Lincoln, Mercury models of 1996 - 2022MY (some models of 1994-1995MY are also supported)
- Mazda 1996-2022MY. Attention: Mazda 7G models (new Mazda 3, CX-30, MX-30, CX-50 etc) are supported partially or not supported!
- Vehicles other than Ford, Mazda, Lincoln, Mercury are not supported!
Features:
- Analyzing an on-board network configuration of the connected vehicle
- Read and reset DTC for all modules
- Read sensors and other data (PIDs) from all modules
- Execute tests
- Execute majority of service functions
Note: Configuration and Programming functions, as well as some of service functions, are not available in FORScan Lite.

- NBA
- NFL
- CFB (NCAAF)
- CBB (NCAAB)
- NHL
- MLB
- WNBA
- World Cup
- Champions League
- Premier League
- MLS
- La Liga
- Bundesliga
- Ligue 1
- Serie A

HOW IT WORKS
HOME
Stay updated with upcoming matchups and stat breakdowns for every game
Explore matchup strengths & weaknesses, key players, injuries, and usage trends
OPTIMIZER
Analyze combinations of player and team stats across single or multiple games
See how often specific combinations have occurred historically
Understand correlation between stats and remove less consistent stats
Send your research directly to other apps in one click
DEEP STATS
Dive into player and team performance data with easy-to-read visuals and supporting data
Look up any player or team to view charts, game logs, and matchup strength data
View stats from players of the same position who recently faced the upcoming opponent
Toggle between different time spans
Apply filters such as Head-to-Head games, Home/Away, With/Without Teammates, Opponent Strength, and more to check performance under specific circumstances
LEADERBOARDS
View consistency rankings for player stats like 1+ TDs for NFL or 25+ points for NBA
Toggle to view leaders over just the last 5 games, last 10 games, or head-to-head games
Check matchup grades and odds for each player/team stat
TRENDS
Browse player projections sorted by value
Use advanced filters to customize your research
Identify outliers based on historical and recent data
–––––
ABOUT US
HOF was started by two lifelong sports fans and Ivy League grads with the goal of making stats-driven sports research more accessible and fun.
We’re obsessed with delivering a world-class experience for fans who love data, trends, and sports stories told through numbers.
Our mission is to help you enjoy the game on a deeper level — whether you’re tracking your favorite player, building a custom analysis, or just digging into stats with friends.

HOW IT WORKS
HOME
Stay updated with upcoming matchups and stat breakdowns for every game

OPTIMIZER
Analyze combinations of player and team stats across single or multiple games
See how often specific combinations have occurred historically
Understand correlation between stats and remove less consistent stats
Send your research directly to other apps in one click

DEEP STATS
Dive into player and team performance data with easy-to-read visuals and supporting data
Look up any player or team to view charts, game logs, and matchup strength data
View stats from players of the same position who recently faced the upcoming opponent
Toggle between different time spans
Apply filters such as Head-to-Head games, Home/Away, With/Without Teammates, Opponent Strength, and more to check performance under specific circumstances

LEADERBOARDS
View consistency rankings for player stats like 1+ TDs for NFL or 25+ points for NBA
Toggle to view leaders over just the last 5 games, last 10 games, or head-to-head games
Check matchup grades and odds for each player/team stat

TRENDS
Browse player projections sorted by value
Use advanced filters to customize your research
Identify outliers based on historical and recent data

bluejetty:00144937:ios.description:
ByeNoise combines powerful AI noise reduction with a complete video and audio editor. Remove wind, hiss, hum, buzz, and distracting background sounds - then edit, enhance, volume boost, subtitle, and export your content in one app.
Turn noisy interviews, podcasts, videos, and recordings into clear, polished content in just a few taps.
“...I was surprised by the results and found no traces of noise in my audio recording” (iGeeksBlog.com)
REMOVE THE NOISE. KEEP WHAT MATTERS.
• Clean up wind, hiss, hum, buzz, fan noise and more.
• Choose between two AI modes, including one built for speech.
• Bring voices forward so your audience hears you - not your surroundings.
POWERFUL VIDEO & AUDIO EDITING
• Combine video and audio clips across multiple tracks.
• Trim, split, merge and arrange with precise timeline controls.
• Add smooth transitions and preview your edits instantly.
MAKE EVERY WORD HEARD
• Boost volume up to 400%.
• Fine-tune your sound with a five-band equalizer.
• Adjust pitch and speed, or add reverb for extra depth.
