• Sharpen details and enhance color and lighting.
• Crop, rotate, blur, speed up or slow down clips.
AUTOMATIC SUBTITLES
• Auto generate subtitles for the entire video.
• Edit the words, adjust timing and choose your style and placement.
RECORD. EDIT. SHARE.
• Record audio with live level monitoring and noise reduction.
• Save projects and pick up where you left off.
• Export video in multiple resolutions and formats - or save just the audio.
From a noisy interview to your next podcast, vlog or family video - make the recording worth keeping.
Download ByeNoise and hear the difference.
DISCLAIMER: ByeNoise has been tested and trained on a wide range of audio and video recordings, but cannot guarantee removal of all background noise. Results depend on the original recording. Are you a law enforcement officer who wants to download an app to get access to the most updated information for case law and law enforcement training? If yes, then look no further than Alpha Cop!! It is designed to help you with training topics including Impaired Driving, Miranda Warnings, Drugs, Criminal Amendments, etc.
Are you interested in getting access to case law from specific states? We warmly welcome you to the Alpha Cop, where you get comprehensive resources for case law and law enforcement training. It is designed especially for law enforcement officers that provides you with the most updated information.
+ Consistently updated
+ Searchable case law
+ Easy to read and navigate
+ An app without Ads
+ Access offline whenever you want
+ New Jersey, Florida, Wisconsin and Oklahoma Case Law topics included

bluejetty:00015874:ios.description:
Jet set around the world while solving thousands of word puzzles! Can you solve them all?
Word Swipe World Tour Connect is the newest edition to the popular Word Swipe series. Both relaxing and challenging to simultaneously stimulate and calm your mind. Just a few minutes a day can ease your stress, relax your brain, and keep your mind sharp.
This new take on word search games combines all the best elements of crossword, word search, anagram, scramble, text twist and word puzzle games. Over one thousand free puzzles set against beautiful settings and landscapes from locations around the world. Escape the stress of your modern life as you exercise your brain with an endless supply of fun words puzzles.
◆ Completely free to play. Easy to pickup, too addictive to put down!
◆ Solve fun puzzles while traveling the world.
◆ Drag your finger over the letters to create a word. Connect and cross words in the grid to complete the puzzle.
◆ Unique hand crafted puzzles featuring a dictionary of over 80,000 words.
◆ Find bonus extra words to rack up coins.
◆ Daily Gift rewards give free coins every day!
◆ Complete your passport book as you increase your tour score.
◆ Relaxing and inspiring soundtrack adds to the atmosphere and immersion.
◆ Free updates with more world locations, puzzles, music, and features!
◆ Calm your mind with beautiful landscape backgrounds complete with stunning visual effects.
◆ Visit Iceland, Italy, New York, Paris, Norway, and so much more!
◆ Puzzles ranging from three letters all the way to ten letters. How many puzzles will you solve? See if you can connect them all.
◆ Train your brain with an expanded vocabulary.
◆ Familiar word search and crosswords rules, but in an entirely new kind of game.
◆ Escape the stress of your daily life by playing just 5 minutes a day.
If you enjoy word games, puzzle games, crossword puzzles, word search, anagrams, scrambles, jumbles, text twist, and brain training exercises, you’ll love the free to play Word Swipe Connect World Tour.
Start solving today!
Need help? You can report an issue or give a feature request by submitting a ticket here: https://loyalfoundry.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1
If you like the game, please leave an app rating and review! Thank you for playing & check out more of our games to play!

bluejetty:00141516:ios.description:
House Color by Number is a relaxing coloring game that brings your artistic creativity to life. Whether you enjoy coloring pages or are just looking for a fun way to relax, this game is perfect for you. Explore a collection of beautifully designed houses, each waiting for your unique touch of color.
From cozy cottages to grand mansions, explore an array of house designs that will captivate your imagination. Each house comes with intricate details and patterns, providing a delightful coloring experience that is both relaxing and rewarding.
House Coloring uses paint-by-number mechanics. You simply follow the numbers to fill in the colors and watch as your masterpiece comes to life. The intuitive interface makes it easy to select colors and zoom in on details, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable coloring experience.
With House Color by Number, you have the freedom to express yourself and explore your artistic side. Experiment with different color combinations and create stunning works of art. Whether you prefer bold, vibrant hues or soft, pastel shades, the choice is yours.
Show off your completed works of art with friends and family. Easily share your finished houses on social media or save them to your device. Watch as your gallery of beautifully colored houses grows, showcasing your artistic journey. It's a great way to spend quality time with family or to enjoy a peaceful moment alone.

Choose a house design from our vast collection.
Select the numbered color and start filling in the areas.
Use the zoom feature to color details with precision.
Relax and enjoy the process as you color the house.
Save and share your art with friends and family.
Experience the joy of coloring with House Color by Number and start creating your own beautiful, colorful world one house at a time.

bluejetty:00022647:ios.description:
Enjoy the best coverage around the world of motor racing with the official Motorsport.com App featuring Formula 1, MotoGP, Formula E, NASCAR, IndyCar, WEC, WRC, F2, F3, WRX, DTM, WSBK, Moto2, Moto3 and much more in a unique, easy-to-use App. Download now for free!
Top Series selected and sorted for you by our experts so you can experience the best possible coverage at your convenience. 
◆ KEY FEATURES
• Unique design with trending functionalities and an easy-to-use interface. 
• Edition is pre-selected automatically based on the user’s own language and region settings.
• Push notifications setup with ‘Spoiler’ option. 
• Slider system for easy access to your favorite series content.
• Four tabs to quickly jump to the section you prefer: News, Photos, Videos or Race Hub where you can find Schedules, Results and Standings.
• Available in 22 editions: Global, USA, Canada, UK, Australia, France, Germany, Italy, Russia, Brazil, Middle East, Spain, Latin America, US Hispanic, Poland, Turkey, Hungary, Switzerland, Netherlands, China and Japan.
◆ HOME 
• Latest, featured, trending with analysis, and opinion pieces.
• Select from all series combined or simply select from the Slider menu your favorite series. 
• Live Text coverage for major series such as F1, MotoGP and selected local series.
◆ PHOTOS 
• The largest motor racing image database in the world.
• Latest and featured galleries.
• Illustrations from renowned F1 illustrator Giorgio Piola. 
• Select by series, by event, by session and by race.
• Highly functional design and easy-to-use browsing. 
◆ VIDEOS 
• Original productions with interviews, specials, 2D/3D animations, and more.
• Latest, trending and featured videos.
• All series in one place, or selectable individually. 
• New-look interface with standard and portrait mode.
◆ RACE HUB 
• Unique user-friendly motorsport results section in the world. 
• Three Tabs: Schedule + Results + Standings.
• Get a glimpse of all series in one screen or simply select one series and quickly find what you are looking for.
• Schedule: Upcoming, future and past events, with times adjusted to local or “your time”. 
• Results: Full display of all up-to-date results, sessions, past years and past events. 
• Standings: Always current, full tables, race-by-race with fastest laps, practice sessions. 
About us 
Motorsport Network connects hundreds of millions of people who love motorsport and cars. Using our technology and brands portfolio to differentiate our services, unique content and products, we engage motorsport and auto fans in 16 languages around the world. Digital original content, live events, merchandising, gaming, social networking and our car shopping experience content with a passion for all things auto. We are a global technology and digital media company and your gateway into the world of cars and motorsport.

bluejetty:00073551:ios.description:
When will it be good to fly your quadcopter? See the weather forecast, GPS satellites, solar activity (Kp), No-Fly Zones and flight restrictions, all in one convenient tool. Perfect for DJI Neo, Mini, Mavic, Air, Inspire, FPV, and Hover, Autel and Skydio drones, and many other Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and Systems.
UAV Forecast is the original, best, and classic tool for drone pilots. Suitable for both beginners and advanced pilots, recreational and commercial, features include:
• Hyperlocal weather data, including detailed wind and gust speeds at ground level and at any altitude.
• GPS satellite data including Galileo and GLONASS, solar weather (Kp) index, and more.
• Hourly forecasts up to 15 days.
• Automatic color-coded analysis of the conditions: green for Good To Fly, red for Not Good To Fly.
• Fully configurable thresholds.
• Light and Dark themes, with automatic switching at sunrise and sunset.
• Location search and Favorite Locations.
• Full tablet support.
Our users include paraglider and paramotor pilots too.
Become a subscriber for 24-hour, 7-day, or 15-day hourly forecast and many other features. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms: https://www.uavforecast.com/terms

- Convide seus amigos
- Exercite a memória e a concentração com um passatempo para lá de divertido!

bluejetty:00065790:ios.name: Balloon Paradise: Match 3 Game
bluejetty:00065790:ios.summary: Looking for a relaxing match 3 puzzle game you can play offline, no wifi needed? Balloon Pop brings over 11,000 colorful puzzle levels to your phone, anytime and anywhere, with no internet connection required. Just pure match 3 fun in Ballo
bluejetty:00065790:ios.description:
Looking for a relaxing match 3 puzzle game you can play offline, no wifi needed? Balloon Pop brings over 11,000 colorful puzzle levels to your phone, anytime and anywhere, with no internet connection required. Just pure match 3 fun in Balloon Paradise, ready whenever you are.
Swap and match shiny, colorful balloons to clear each puzzle and unlock new worlds. Match three in a row to burst them open, or line up bigger chains to trigger boosters and power-ups that wipe out entire rows, columns, and color clusters at once. The longer the match, the bigger the combo, and the closer you get to moving on to the next adventure.
Play Offline, No Wifi Needed
Balloon Pop is built for real offline play. No wifi. No data. No surprise loading screens mid-level. Whether you are on a plane, a long commute, a road trip, or just somewhere without a reliable signal, your match 3 games keep going without interruption. Download once and play anywhere, any time. Offline puzzle games this colorful and this complete are rare, and Balloon Pop delivers genuine no wifi gameplay on every Android device.
The World of Balloon Paradise
Welcome to Balloon Paradise, a magical world hidden high above the clouds. Belle, a fearless and cheerful adventurer, has discovered the sky city of Floatopia, a floating civilization built entirely out of balloons. A powerful gust of wind has swept through the city, scattering colors and breaking Floatopia apart piece by piece. Only a player with real match 3 puzzle skills can put it back together. Level by level, world by world, Belle is counting on you to restore Balloon Paradise to its colorful, balloon-filled glory.
Boosters and Power-Ups That Change Everything
As you explore Balloon Paradise, you earn boosters and power-ups that transform the way you play. A rocket balloon tears through an entire row or column. A rainbow burst wipes out all balloons of a single color at once. A balloon bomb sends a shockwave across a wide area, clearing everything nearby. Combine boosters in a single move and chain reactions clear dozens of balloons at once. Swap and match your way to bigger combos and use your power-ups wisely to conquer the toughest puzzle layouts.
Features
* Over 11,000 match 3 puzzle levels, with new content added regularly
* Play offline with no wifi and no internet connection required
* Swap and match colorful balloons to build combos and clear the board
* Earn powerful boosters: rockets, rainbow bursts, balloon bombs, and more
* Relaxing match 3 games at your own pace, no timers, no pressure
* Help Belle explore Balloon Paradise and restore the sky city of Floatopia
* Beautiful colorful sky worlds with unique puzzle layouts and fresh challenges
* Smooth gameplay designed for players of all skill levels
* Seasonal events and themed worlds for returning players
With more than 1 million downloads and a 4.6-star rating from tens of thousands of players, Balloon Pop has built a loyal community of match 3 puzzle fans around the world. If you love a calming brain puzzle or need a reliable no wifi game for travel and commutes, Balloon Pop is ready to play offline every single time.
Whether you play for five minutes between meetings or five hours on a long flight, Balloon Pop and Balloon Paradise are ready. Match 3 your way through the sky, unlock every world, and help Belle bring color back to Floatopia. Your offline puzzle adventure is waiting.

bluejetty:00175470:ios.summary:
Pixel Pro Golf is a wonderfully unique arcade golf game, that combines realistic physics with zen-like gameplay and beautiful pixel-art. It can be played online, in global tournaments, over iMessage, or as a single player experience.
SINGL
bluejetty:00175470:ios.description:
Pixel Pro Golf is a wonderfully unique arcade golf game, that combines realistic physics with zen-like gameplay and beautiful pixel-art. It can be played online, in global tournaments, over iMessage, or as a single player experience.
SINGLE PLAYER
Play through over 50 gorgeously pixelated courses, each carefully crafted with a unique style and conditions, as you try to become the best of the best.
Use the simple controls to aim, change club and swing. Then watch your ball head down stunning pixel fairways.
Play well to earn ranking points and rise up the world rankings, unlocking different tours until you reach the Majors and hit the top spot. 
Finish a tournament high enough to earn winnings, that you can use to upgrade everything from your driver to putter. Alternatively, use your winnings to customise your character with some awesome clothes, from panda hats to cool new Ts.
Challenge friends over Game Center, with achievements and leaderboards for all the courses.
TOURNAMENT EVENTS
Every day offers new daily tournaments - each played on a different course - with only one attempt at each! When you are done, you can see where you rank against real-world players in the global leaderboard. 
Daily tournaments are grouped into Seasons, comprising 20 daily events. Hit the top 500 in a daily tournament to earn points, which add up over the season. At the end, the player with the most points is crowned champion.
Similar to real life, Pixel Pro Golf's Major series like The Maestros or American Open are multi-day events, with scores aggregated over 4 days. Winning one of these is now the ultimate badge of honour in Pixel Pro Golf.
Tournaments are in two leagues, Open and Handicap. In Open, your basic, unedited, score is what counts. In Handicap, as it can be in real golf, your score is handicapped - with less accomplished players given extra shots, so whoever plays well within their own skill level rises to the top!
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Using Game Center, challenge up to 4 online opponents to a realtime game. Choose from randomly selected 3 or 9 hole courses, or select a specific course to play.
Invite friends to play via Game Center, or let the matchmaker choose some random players for you, and soon you will be testing your skills against real online opponents.
iMESSAGE

listings.description:
Pixel Pro Golf is a wonderfully unique arcade golf game, that combines realistic physics with zen-like gameplay and beautiful pixel-art. It can be played online, in global tournaments, over iMessage, or as a single player experience.

SINGLE PLAYER
Play through over 50 gorgeously pixelated courses, each carefully crafted with a unique style and conditions, as you try to become the best of the best.

Use the simple controls to aim, change club and swing. Then watch your ball head down stunning pixel fairways.

Play well to earn ranking points and rise up the world rankings, unlocking different tours until you reach the Majors and hit the top spot. 

Finish a tournament high enough to earn winnings, that you can use to upgrade everything from your driver to putter. Alternatively, use your winnings to customise your character with some awesome clothes, from panda hats to cool new Ts.

Challenge friends over Game Center, with achievements and leaderboards for all the courses.

TOURNAMENT EVENTS
Every day offers new daily tournaments - each played on a different course - with only one attempt at each! When you are done, you can see where you rank against real-world players in the global leaderboard. 

Daily tournaments are grouped into Seasons, comprising 20 daily events. Hit the top 500 in a daily tournament to earn points, which add up over the season.  At the end, the player with the most points is crowned champion.

Similar to real life, Pixel Pro Golf's Major series like The Maestros or American Open are multi-day events, with scores aggregated over 4 days.  Winning one of these is now the ultimate badge of honour in Pixel Pro Golf.

Tournaments are in two leagues, Open and Handicap. In Open, your basic, unedited, score is what counts. In Handicap, as it can be in real golf, your score is handicapped - with less accomplished players given extra shots, so whoever plays well within their own skill level rises to the top!

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Using Game Center, challenge up to 4 online opponents to a realtime game.  Choose from randomly selected 3 or 9 hole courses, or select a specific course to play.

Invite friends to play via Game Center, or let the matchmaker choose some random players for you, and soon you will be testing your skills against real online opponents.

bluejetty:00126928:ios.description:

Precisely adjust saturation, contrast, hue, exposure, brightness, and more. You’ll get an ultimate toolkit to make your images flawless before moving on to filters.

bluejetty:00172648:ios.name: Voice Tools
bluejetty:00172648:ios.summary: Analyse your voice pitch, associated voice gender, & volume in real-time with the ability to record and replay the last 10 seconds. Essentially a voice analyser for transgender, LSVT, singers, and voice therapy patients to help improve the
bluejetty:00172648:ios.description:
Analyse your voice pitch, associated voice gender, & volume in real-time with the ability to record and replay the last 10 seconds. Essentially a voice analyser for transgender, LSVT, singers, and voice therapy patients to help improve the quality of their voice.
-View a graph of your voice pitch/associated gender in a real-time!
-Phonetically balanced sentences for you to read
-Listen to tones of specific pitches for you to mimic
-Record & playback without saving files to your device
-Real-time volume analysis
-Transgender & non-binary friendly
Please note; this app does NOT change the pitch of your voice, it only provides visual feedback specifically tailed for use as part of voice therapy!!!
The voice pitch analysis works best with an external microphone! It will work without an external microphone but please be-aware that results may vary as the voice pitch analysis requires a relatively quiet environment and some phone microphones can pickup a lot of background noise. 
This tool is designed to act as a voice recorder/playback/analyser tool but with useful information such as voice pitch, tones, & volume with resonance and phonetics to be added at a later date. It is mostly intended for use as part of voice therapy, and users should be aiming to use the tool for about 5 minutes a day over several months. It does not provide lessons or guidance, it is intended to be used as a tool to assist with voice therapy and not as a replacement for voice therapy.
=Privacy=
No voice recordings are saved or leave the device.
=Free=
This app is available in two flavors; a free advert supported version, and a paid advert-free version. You can remove the adverts via an in-app purchase in the settings screen.
=Bugs=
Help us to improve this app, if it doesn't work, or you have any ideas to help us improve please drop us an email so that we can improve things in the next release!

The voice pitch analysis works best with an external microphone! It will work without an external microphone but please be-aware that results may vary as the voice pitch analysis requires a relatively quiet environment and some phone microphones can pickup a lot of background noise.  

This tool is designed to act as a voice recorder/playback/analyser tool but with useful information such as voice pitch, tones, & volume with resonance and phonetics to be added at a later date. It is mostly intended for use as part of voice therapy, and users should be aiming to use the tool for about 5 minutes a day over several months.  It does not provide lessons or guidance, it is intended to be used as a tool to assist with voice therapy and not as a replacement for voice therapy.

=Privacy=
No voice recordings are saved or leave the device.

=Free=
This app is available in two flavors; a free advert supported version, and a paid advert-free version.  You can remove the adverts via an in-app purchase in the settings screen.

=Bugs=
Help us to improve this app, if it doesn't work, or you have any ideas to help us improve please drop us an email so that we can improve things in the next release!

bluejetty:00066429:ios.description:
Trying to avoid walking straight into a rainstorm when you go out? Check our rain radar and rain graph before you leave so you never have to get drenched!
De Buienradar app starts with the 3 hour or the 24 hour rain radar forecast. The rain radar image will show you whether it is going to rain in the next upcoming hours or even the next day. Below the radar is the rain graph. In this graph you can see exactly when it is going to rain and how much rainfall is predicted (in millimeters). If you prefer an even more detailed image of your city or town you can press the magnifying glass icon to zoom in.
The Buienradar app is suitable for iPhone and iPad. Via the handy widgets (with rain graph for your current location) you can quickly see on your today's screen whether it will rain soon without opening the app. There is also the Buienradar Watch app.
Besides the Buienradar you can also find other radars and maps:
- Drizzle
- Sun 
- NL Satellite images
- Lightning
- Pollen (hay fever)
- Sun (UV)
- Mosquitos
- BBQ
- Temperature
- Feeling temperature
- Ground temperature
- Wind
- Fog
- Snow
- Air Quality
- Humidity
- Precipitation sum
- EU Buienradar (rain radar)
- EU Satellite images
- EU Temperature
You can find personalized weather info in the table “Coming hours in” for your favorite location (even abroad!) like hour-to-hour predictions for: temperature, feeling temperature, the number of millimeters of rain per hour, the chance of rain and wind force (in Beaufort).
Besides thunderstorm, snow, sun, wind and temperature maps we also offer wind chill, ground temperature, sun intensity, air pressure, gusts, visibility and humidity data, together with the exact times of sunrise and sunset for your location.
We also offer seasonal radar maps. In the summer, for example, you can use our pollen and mosquito radars in order to receive a timely notification when it is wise to hang up your mosquito net. In the winter you can use our snowradar, which informs you about winter precipitation, but we also offer a map especially for ground temperature which warns you about night frost.
In the “Forecast” tab you will find the weather forecast (in a graph) for the next 14 days. You can also see a detailed list view when you click on the tab “Lijst”. This list offers an hourly forecast for the next 7 days and a daily average for the second week.
In the “Alerts” tab you can create your own rain alert (free push notification) customized to your daily time schedule and favorite locations so you will never be unprepared for rain or a storm.
With the Buienradar Premium subscription you get the app ad free, exclusive free gifts and extra functionality for only €6,99 per year.
Our Terms of Use can be found here:
https://privacy.dpgmedia.nl/nl/document/terms-of-use
Our Privacy statement can be found here:
https://privacy.dpgmedia.nl/nl/document/privacy-policy
We are continuously improving the Buienradar app. If you have any suggestions on how we can improve or if you have any questions, you can always reach out to us by using the feedback form in the app or by sending us an e-mail via appsupport@buienradar.nl. Thanks!
App conditions: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

SAFETY SERVICES RIGHT ON YOUR PHONE
Get family safety services — Roadside Assistance, help in a crash, family locator and Emergency Services — with the OnStar Guardian® app. No matter where you are, we're with you and your family – in any
bluejetty:00136011:ios.description:
SAFETY SERVICES RIGHT ON YOUR PHONE
Get family safety services — Roadside Assistance, help in a crash, family locator and Emergency Services — with the OnStar Guardian® app. No matter where you are, we're with you and your family – in any vehicle, even on your motorcycle. Eligible OnStar Members receive the OnStar Guardian app as part of their plan. A standalone plan is only $15 a month. Plus, you can share the app with up to 7 friends or family members at no additional cost.
FAMILY SAFETY THAT GOES WHERE YOU GO
Mobile Crash Response
•      Crash detection that can send for help automatically
•      Smartphone sensors can detect a car accident and alert an OnStar Advisor
•      Help in a crash in any vehicle — or on your motorcycle
Roadside Assistance
•      Don't get stranded. Get help on the road, jump a dead battery, get assistance with a flat tire — you can even get fuel delivered or request a tow
•      Roadside Assistance for any vehicle or motorcycle
Location Status
•      Togetherness when you're apart. The family locator that lets you share and save real-time locations, view a live map, even send departure and arrival notifications
Emergency Services
•    Help when it's needed. The red Emergency button provides priority access to an OnStar Emergency Advisor 24/7
•    Get specially trained assistance with medical issues, severe weather and more — all while our Advisors send First Responders to your exact location
LIMITATIONS
Price subject to taxes and fees. See onstar.com/plans/guardian-app for details and limitations.
U.S. and Canada only. Available on select Apple devices. OnStar Guardian service plan, cell reception, GPS signal and device data connection required. May not transmit all crash data. You may cancel at any time by calling 1.888.4ONSTAR (1.888.466.7827).
Location Status services designed to locate compatible smartphones with Location Services permission enabled. Functionality varies by mobile device and plan. Data rates may apply. Terms and limitations apply.
Roadside services provided by third-party providers. Roadside services are for passenger vehicles (cars and trucks) and motorcycles only. Limitations and restrictions apply. Towing services can be used four times per year then additional charges apply. Additional charges apply to tire changes when a spare tire is not provided.  
Up to seven additional individuals can be added to the “My Family” section within the app.

bluejetty:00153758:ios.description:
GPS Speedometer is an intelligent speed measurement application based on high-precision satellite positioning technology, suitable for various scenarios of car, bicycle, motorcycle, running, and ship travel. It can display the current speed in real time, record the travel trajectory and provide speeding warning function. Designed for drivers, cyclists and explorers, it is the perfect companion to help you monitor the speed accurately and safely.
Professional car speedometer | bicycle speed measurement | motorcycle speed measurement | running speed tracking | driving record | speeding alarm
**GPS Navigation & Speedometer**
1. Whether you're driving, cycling, or using it as a head-up display, this app reliably provides GPS speedometer, odometer, and trip tracking. It supports speed units such as miles per hour (mph) and kilometers per hour (km/h).
2. Offers accurate GPS navigation and a real-time digital speedometer, helping you confidently track your speed and trip. It uses advanced GPS positioning technology to display your current speed, distance traveled, and trip data in a clear and easy-to-read interface.
**Accurate speed measurement, safe travel**
GPS speedometer uses satellite positioning technology to provide you with real-time speed measurement for various transportation scenarios such as cars, motorcycles, running, bicycles, mountain bikes, and ships. It has a low error rate and is more accurate than traditional speedometers!
**Core functions**
**Multi-mode speed measurement**
- Classic dashboard (simulates real speedometer)
- Digital large screen display (supports KMH/MPH/KNOTS unit switching)
- HUD head-up display (projected to windshield at night, safe driving)
- Map navigation mode (real-time track recording, anti-lost)
**Professional driving analysis**
- Automatically generate trip report: maximum speed, average speed, driving distance, altitude change
- Historical track playback
**Intelligent safety warning**
- Customized speeding alarm (voice/vibration reminder)
- Fixed speed camera prompt (location service needs to be turned on)
- Rapid acceleration/rapid deceleration warning
**Applicable in all scenarios**
- Car speed measurement
- Motorcycle/electric vehicle speed measurement
- Bicycle meter (riding speed & mileage statistics)
- Running pace calculation
**Why choose us? **
**High-precision positioning**: multi-satellite system (GPS) joint positioning.
**Speed limit alarm**, safety assistance: customizable speed threshold, trigger voice or vibration reminder when speeding.
**Ultra-low power consumption**: support background continuous speed measurement
**HUD mode: speed can be projected onto the windshield when driving at night, reducing line of sight deviation and facilitating night viewing.
Download now to experience professional-level speed measurement tools!

bluejetty:00146514:ios.name: Masjidal Athan+: Times & More
bluejetty:00146514:ios.summary: Masjidal's Athan+ is the only app that displays prayer times by location but goes a step further to instantly locate the nearest mosques* around you to show selected mosque’s exact prayer and iqamah times along with their useful contact inf
bluejetty:00146514:ios.description:
Masjidal's Athan+ is the only app that displays prayer times by location but goes a step further to instantly locate the nearest mosques* around you to show selected mosque’s exact prayer and iqamah times along with their useful contact information.
Save your most visited mosques as favorites. Set customizable iqamah reminders and never missed a congregational prayer again. Tap the mosque to view the events, announcements, reminders or even make a donation to the mosque.
Prayer timings for your locations are also displayed and can be customized. Five-time daily athan, Qibla direction, Duas and Adhkars, Islamic Radio, Hijri calendar, daily dua/hadith/verse, and so much more.
Multiple widgets available to display the Prayer/Iqamah timings and motivational quotes.
Athan+ never sells any data to anyone. No annoying ads, no fees, no in-app purchases!
Main Features:
- Prayer and Iqamah times for nearby mosques (Driving directions and contact information to nearby mosque)
- Selected mosque’s monthly prayer timetable, events, announcements, and more* (Masjids that are signed up on the Masjidal platform)
- Accurate prayer times based on current location (Supports multiple angle settings and prayer calculation methods, Asr calculation, Hijri offset)
- Travel mode built-in to update prayer timings while traveling
- Visual countdown to next prayer 
- Home Screen and Lock Screen Widgets
- Reminder settings for Iqamah (custom setting to remind minutes(s) before Iqamah timing). 
- Audio and visual notifications for prayer alerts
- Compass to locate the Qibla direction
- Ramadan Suhoor and Iftar times
- Daily Verse, Hadith or Dua (option to share)
- Islamic Hijri dates 
- Stay up to date with a complete list of significant Islamic dates 
- Beautiful widgets allow users to see prayer times, following prayer, and the Hijri Date at a glance from the home screen.
- Emotion based duas, daily duas and adhkars
- Notifications for special Islamic events, like Ramadan, Eid-ul-Adha
- Islamic radio in various languages
- Instant feedback option
- Zero data collection or ads
- 100% privacy guarantee
*Please note mosques must be signed up at Masjidal.com to show up on the list. Mosques are responsible for the content including the Iqamah times. It’s a free service for Masjids to use.

bluejetty:00149189:ios.name: ZipSign: Signature Maker
bluejetty:00149189:ios.summary:
This app helps you put your REAL/HANDWRITTEN signature on digital documents easily. No more awkward finger drawing. Get a true signature that reflects your real handwriting with the help of ZipSign and our built-in signature maker.
Why?
Y
bluejetty:00149189:ios.description:
This app helps you put your REAL/HANDWRITTEN signature on digital documents easily. No more awkward finger drawing. Get a true signature that reflects your real handwriting with the help of ZipSign and our built-in signature maker.
Why?
Your signature doesn’t look the same when you draw it digitally as it does on paper. It can appear unprofessional unless you spend a lot of time trying to perfect it. ZipSign saves you time and makes digital signing feel as authentic as pen on paper.
How?
1. Add your signature:
Use a real pen to draw your signature on a white piece of paper. Then take a photo with ZipSign's signature scanner. Our advanced AI removes the background and creates a clean digital version with the help of our signature maker.
2. Import your document:
Scan your document or import it from your device storage or photo library.
3. Sign:
Choose your saved signature, place it on any page, and save the document.
That’s it. You can export your signed files and share them instantly using ZipSign.
Key Features:
- Signature Maker: Turn your handwritten signature into a crisp PNG ready for digital signing.
- Saved Signatures: Store multiple versions for quick access.
- Unlimited Signing: Sign as many documents as you need, without limits.
- No Login Needed: Open the app and start using ZipSign immediately.
- Photo to PDF: Convert images into documents to sign.
- Easy Imports: Bring files from your Photos or Files apps.
- Check Every Page: Browse all PDF pages and sign wherever necessary.
- Share or Print: Send or print documents right from the app.
- Export Signatures: Use the signature maker, then save and move your digital signature across devices.
- Privacy First: Your documents and signatures stay on your device, never uploaded to the cloud.
Whether for business or personal use, ZipSign helps you sign documents quickly and professionally. With the power of our signature maker, your real handwriting becomes a reliable digital signature.
Privacy policy: https://signaturescanner.com/privacypolicy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00065603:ios.description:
HidrateSpark has helped over 1 million people drink more water and live healthier! 
HidrateSpark uses psychology to help you drink more water and create a lasting hydration habit. It takes the guesswork out of how much water you should drink by calculating a personalized daily goal for you. Stay on track with simple beverage tracking, helpful reminders throughout the day to take a sip, and trophies to celebrate your progress.
Maintain a healthy lifestyle, avoid pesky headaches, increase your energy levels, improve your mood, clear your skin, and enhance your physical performance & productivity by drinking more water with HidrateSpark. 
Key Features:
Track your water intake 
Smart drink water reminders throughout your day, customize your schedule 
Daily water goal automatically calculated based on your weight, age, height, sex, activity level, weather and more
Track water, tea, and coffee
40+ popular beverages to track*
Hydration Score based on how well you hydrate throughout the day*
Compete with friends
Fun healthy hydration challenges
Unlock trophies
Apple Watch app
Apple Health integration + other popular health and fitness apps
Home screen Widgets
30+ colorful wallpapers to customize the look of your app*
Dark mode or light mode
Hydration Streak: how many days in a row can you meet your goal?
Hydration history calendar
Oz / Ml measurement units
Hourly hydration goals for optimal hydration
Pulsing green target to keep you on pace to meet your goal
Compatible with connected HidrateSpark smart water bottles to automatically track your water (Not required)
Choose from 8 different glow colors for your HidrateSpark PRO smart water bottle 
Glow Studio: Design your own 2 color glows for your HidrateSpark PRO smart water bottle*
Benefits of hydration: 
Weight loss
Healthy skin
Improves productivity & mood
Improves physical performance
Relieves fatigue & boosts energy
Improves sleep quality
Avoid headaches
Healthier heart, immune system & brain
Regulates blood pressure & body temperature
Lubricates joints
Aids in digestion
Helps remove waste products
Delivers nutrients and oxygen to cells
Aids in kidney stone prevention
Are you always busy and on the go, or find yourself forgetting to drink enough water? You’re not alone, 75% of Americans are chronically dehydrated. Don’t just hydrate when you feel thirsty. Hydration is essential for the human body. Learn to sip consistently throughout the day with personalized daily & hourly hydration goals calculated by the HidrateSpark App. Never forget to drink water with entertaining drink reminders that motivate you to drink throughout the day. Add friends and join challenges to compete against others and yourself for added accountability.
The HidrateSpark App also integrates with our easy to use HidrateSpark smart water bottles that keep track of how much water you drink, light up and glow to remind you to drink, and sync your water records via Bluetooth or NFC so you can see your progress. The app does NOT require a bottle to be used, but our smart bottles glow to remind you to drink and make tracking your intake easier.
*HidrateSpark PREMIUM features are available as a monthly & annual subscription with a 1 month free trial. Your iTunes account will be charged after the 1 month free trial. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. You can go to your iTunes Account Settings to manage your subscription & turn off auto-renew. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
NOTE: HidrateSpark is not a medical app. Recommended water intake goal is just an estimate. Please consult your healthcare provider if you want to use it for medical purposes or to obtain specific hydration needs.

bluejetty:00185089:ios.description:
The #1 hit app as seen on TV! More than 10 million downloads so far.
Bring photos of your pet to life. Make them speak realistically and share it as a video on Facebook, or email it as a special greeting to your friends and family.

- Lots of animals to choose from even if you don't have your own pet
- Record your own voice or choose from hundreds of hilarious pre-recorded clips 
- Change the voice from big dog to little cat or anything in between
- Add hats, glasses, moustaches and more to your pet 
- Turn your pet into a digital personal assistant. Have them tell you the weather forecast , news headlines , or even get them to remind you of your appointments

- Advanced animation, your pet looks around in 3D
- Add text to make your own memes

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

Good luck!

bluejetty:00062621:ios.summary:

You can test our free pages by downloading them from our website (https://qu
bluejetty:00062621:ios.description:
The Quiver App makes learning fun by combining physical coloring with cool augmented reality technology to create an engaging, educational and magical experience.
You can test our free pages by downloading them from our website (https://quivervision.com/). By using our expertise in augmented reality technology, the Quiver App makes a huge range of educational topics fun to learn about by letting the users creativity and imagination run wild. Every colored page comes to life in its uniquely colored way, giving the artist an immediate and special sense of ownership and pride! The Quiver App is immersive, educational, exciting and inspiring – a must have tool for the classroom or at home where kids can develop skills and retain knowledge like never before. Try it out yourself and we are sure you will agree.
If you are willing to subscribe, Quiver is your one-stop shop for Augmented Reality content and lesson plans for Pre K to Year 4 and beyond. The Quiver App and website offer an educational platform that helps students better visualize & understand various learning subjects.
Included for free on the website are a great range of augmented reality lessons, created by teachers & educators, and specifically designed to meet the needs of all students by incorporating a variety of activities. It’s now time for you to start using augmented reality in your classroom right away!
The Quiver Education dashboard also allows the Quiver App to be deployed across multiple devices in the classroom using just one subscription. This then allows all of those devices to access and use all of the available Quiver App content during the term of the subscription. 
How to use:
- Using Quiver couldn’t be simpler.
- First, find our pages by downloading the app and on our website: https://quivervision.com/.
- Next, save and print your pages from the computer and color away with your favorite colors.
- Ready to bring your finished creation to life? Simply open the Quiver App, press the camera button, scan the page QR code, then scan the coloring page with your camera and watch your coloring leap from the page like magic! How cool is that?
- No two pages are the same, making each new Quiver experience as memorable and exciting as the last.
Visit our website (https://quivervision.com/coloring-packs) for a list of available Quiver coloring pages. The pages include a range of educational pages (e.g. abc’s, space, math, science, geography) plus a range of pure entertainment pages with lots of fun and games included.
Features:
- Traditional coloring with immersive educational augmented reality.
- Learn and discover, with quizzes and other educational tools.
- A range of free lesson and activity plans to match the available coloring pages. 
- Watch your creations magically come to life on your smart device screen.
- Engage, interact and play games with your creations.
- Capture photos and videos of your creations to share with friends.
- Different sound effects associated with each page.
Please Note:
- The Quiver App requires physically printed coloring pages to enjoy the full experience.
- To print out pages, visit https://quivervision.com/coloring-packs.
- An Internet connection is required to download new content associated with the Quiver App.
- The Quiver App only works with QuiverVision pages - look for the Quiver Butterfly logo to ensure the pages are compatible.
- In-app purchases & Subscriptions give access to premium Quiver content.
- For more information, visit https://quivervision.com/.
- For additional assistance, please contact us at support@quivervision.com.
- For our full terms of use, please visit https://quivervision.com/terms
- The Quiver App collects anonymous, aggregated analytics data for the purpose of improving the app experience. No personally identifiable data is collected nor requested by QuiverVision. View our full privacy policy at https://quivervision.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00186302:ios.description:
Featured as one of the “Best New Apps” on the App Store!
Food and wine pairing has never been so clear, accessible and easy to understand. The app gives you a detailed index of hundreds of meal types, showing you the best matches for different wine styles, grape varieties and blends. 
A “Do’s & Don’ts” section, along with a “Quick Guide To Food Types” provides valuable and easy to follow information enabling you to discover even more unique food and wine pairings for yourself.
Add your wines to the unique “My Wines” cellar function, along with your views and ratings. The app also allows you to add as many photos as you like to each wine entry, so you can include a photo of the meal you paired the wine with, a photo of the restaurant menu or a copy of a recipe. 
Explore the Styles section and gain valuable insights into wine styles and why they are so important in enabling you to approach wines with confidence, like a professional. Discover the grape varieties that belong to each style, as well as their key attributes, flavor profile, regions and food pairing advice. 
Here’s what some users of our full Pocket Wine app had to say:
“This app is sensational! I discovered my love for wine. Wonderful on pairing with foods and discovering which wines suit your palate.”
“From a beer only drinker to a full on wine enthusiast and all because of this wonderful little app! I definitely recommend giving it a try.”
“A must for any wine enthusiast. This app is worth every dollar, and even more if you’re learning or want to discover new wines.”
“This app is the deal … an exploration tool … what really matters.”
“Best of the best. Hands down worth every penny, great for all levels of learning.”
“Thanks to this app I now know what I’m looking at and looking for when I go to a wine store.”
“The best wine app out there, hands down.”
“Great app. I’m a winemaker in VA and recommend this for visitors in the tasting room. Definitely recommend it, worth the price for the education and food pairing suggestions.”
“Absolutely fantastic wine reference tool. Beautiful interface, easy to use and unbelievably informative.”
“Finally, an app that has made wine accessible to me – brilliant!”
Enjoy and happy food and wine pairing.

bluejetty:00193024:android.summary: Mobile Legends: Adventure (MLA) is a relaxing idle RPG that can be fit perfectly into a busy daily schedule. Embark on the adventure with 100+ unique heroes, to reveal the truth behind a horrifying prophecy and save the Land of Dawn from de
bluejetty:00193024:android.description:
Mobile Legends: Adventure (MLA) is a relaxing idle RPG that can be fit perfectly into a busy daily schedule. Embark on the adventure with 100+ unique heroes, to reveal the truth behind a horrifying prophecy and save the Land of Dawn from destruction!
++ IDLE & AUTO-BATTLE ++
Heroes battle automatically to gather resources while you idle! Evolve heroes, upgrade gear, and deploy your squad to fight the evil clones with just a few taps. Say no to grinding—enjoy a casual RPG that you can play anytime, anywhere for just 10 minutes a day to gradually strengthen your team!
++ LEVEL UP WITH EASE ++
Trying to build multiple lineups but running short of resources? Save time and effort with level transfer and level sharing features to instantly level up your new heroes!
++ BATTLE STRATEGY ++
For 100+ heroes of 7 types, team compositions and strategy are key to dealing with difficult bosses and other players in MLA. Use strategy to maximize bonus effects for your lineup and solve fun puzzles and mazes!
++ ENDLESS GAME MODES ++
Explore the main storyline, apply strategies on your dungeon runs, go on bounty quests, battle your way to the top of the Tower of Babel... Unlock even more exciting free features as you progress. Constantly updated events and new heroes will keep you hyped!
++ GLOBAL PvP BATTLES ++
Compete with Adventurers from around the world with your strongest hero lineup. Form a Guild with your friends, upgrade facilities, and fight for your Guild's glory!
++ COLLECT HEROES & UNLOCK STORIES ++
MLA is a role-playing game based off the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) universe, so you will see familiar faces from MLBB redesigned with a 2D anime art style. Pull gachas to collect all of your favorite MLBB heroes, and unlock their exclusive stories in this new adventure!

bluejetty:00036024:ios.description:
Welcome to AI Game Master: The Infinite Text RPG ! Where every choice you make changes the story. You don't just read the novel you step inside it and play it ! AI Game Master is an AI text RPG that is based on your imagination and has no limits to your creativity, and storytelling. Play, create and share your favorite genres - all in one place.
Whether you are a fan of the high stake action fantasy of Dungeons & Dragons , the captivating drama of Isekai Anime Romance or evergreen stories that last forever, your choices dictate the narrative and the AI Dungeon Master will react to every choice and create the best RPG experience for you! 
[APP FEATURES]
■ Unlimited, Ad-Free Immersion: Dive deep into stories with Unlimited play and absolutely no commercial interruptions.
■ Shape Your Epic Adventure: Seamless character creation and world-building tools. You write the AI creates, no limits !
■ Deep Memory: Companions that truly remember your shared history and grow with you.
■ Best AI RPG System: Recruit companions or enemies, Get rewards fromQuests, Fight enemies & Heal party members, Item generation, XP & Level up system, Special abilities, pets, Dice and much more...
■ Multiplayer 
■ Complete Privacy Control: Keep your stories secret or publish them to the community.
■ Vibrant Community: Follow favorite creators and experience user-generated masterpieces.
[EXPLORE AN INFINITE LIBRARY OF YOUR FAVOURITE GENRES]
■ Anime & Isekai 
■ Dungeons & Dragons 
■ Horror & Apocalyptic
■ Sci-fi & Cyberpunk
■ Romance & Fairy tales
■ Superheros & Multiverse
■ And many more...
[NO SCRIPTS, JUST YOUR CHOICES]
Experience interactive fiction like never before. You can create any character with your AI Dungeon Master and immediately start your adventue , there are no predetermined plots, and no two stories are ever the same. Every narrative is entirely unique, driven solely by your decisions, leading to unexpected plot twists. You hold the pen craft the ultimate ending with your own hands. Simply type your actions, and watch the story unfold in real-time. 
[NO LIMITS, ENDLESS ROLEPLAY THAT REMEMBERS]
Fans of DnD and choose your own adventure, can enjoy our AI Dungeon Master that will create the ultimate tabletop text RPG experience. Dive into the AI Dungeon and type what you want to do, our one of a kind AI RPG system will generate it for you with Images, Narration and Videos! Become a mage. Befriend a dragon and add it to your party. Betray the kingdom and battle the king, Use spells, steal his magic sword, heal, kill & level up to complete epic quests. Your AI dungeon master keeps your fable moving.
[UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY IN SECONDS]
Bring your ideas to life in seconds. Character Creation is open to everyone - no endless windows of choices or professional writing skills needed. Just write what you want to be and the AI Dungeon Master will create it for you. Craft alternate timelines and invent rich fictional universes. Keep your creations strictly private for your own enjoyment, or share your masterpieces with the world and build an Evergreen legacy within our global creator community. Bring your text RPG to life with AI-generated images & videos for characters, enemies, weapons, and fantasy scenes.
[UNLIMITED LIMITLESS CONVERSATIONS, ZERO INTERRUPTIONS]
Never run out of tokens to play with or new worlds to explore. Enjoy a completely unlimited ad-free experience designed for ultimate story immersion with zero disruptive advertisements. Get lost in long, uninterrupted moments with your favorite companions. Chat endlessly for free with your characters without rigid restrictions. Whether you are transitioning from other chat platforms or stepping inside your favorite Webnovels, you'll find a welcoming home for immersive storytelling and pure fun.
Download AI Game Master: The Infinite RPG today, let your imagination write the story, play it and craft your own ending. 
Your unwritten journey starts now!

bluejetty:00135447:ios.description:
PLEASE NOTE: Coromon is a “try before you buy” title. A portion of the early game is free to play, but a single purchase of $4.99 is required to unlock the full experience.
CLASSIC MONSTER COLLECTING IS BACK, WITH A MODERN TWIST!
Collect and train over 120 unique creatures, customize your trainer from hundreds of options, and explore an engaging JRPG narrative!
It’s your first day as a Battle Researcher in the land of Velua. Everything is going smoothly until a mysterious force attacks. Build up a squad of Coromon, track down the invaders, and grapple with a rising threat that endangers everyone on Velua!
When you aren’t adventuring, challenge other Battle Researchers in head-to-head battles to improve your skills. How high can you climb on the leaderboards?
TACTICAL TURN-BASED BATTLES
• Build a team from more than 120 charming creatures.
• Master a battle system where every action costs resources, so choose skills, status effects, and attacks carefully to overcome your enemies.
• Challenge friends online and see whose Coromon squads are the best of the best.
A COMPELLING STORY
• Explore 6 major zones and cities with dozens of interconnecting routes to traverse.
• Travel across frozen glacial caverns to the depths of blistering deserts.
• Play a key role throughout a fully-fledged classic JRPG narrative, complete with plot twists, turns, and revelations.
PLAY THE WAY YOU WANT
• Immerse yourself in the story on the easiest setting without hassle, or focus on tactics, number-crunching, and resource management.
• Use the built-in Randomizer and Nuzlocke modes to put fan favorite twists on the creature catching experience.
• Create the trainer you want, using hundreds of customizable elements like hair, fashion, and more.
NEW FEATURES FOR MOBILE
• Titan Rush mode will challenge your teams in new and unique ways. How many can you conquer?
• Daily and weekly challenges will give you more ways to unlock rewards just for playing.
• New minigames have been added that have been tailor-made for on-the-go gaming.
• And more!
UPGRADE YOUR ADVENTURE
• One-time purchase luxury items enhance your experience, including the Fruit Drone, Remote Storage, Battle Reader 2.0, and Recall Premium
• Purchase style gems to customize your Battle Researcher’s unique look.
• Unlock and purchase premium Coromon skins for even more exotic creatures.
• And more!
Your Coromon adventure awaits. What will you discover?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/coromonthegame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coromonthegame/
Discord: https://discord.gg/coromon

bluejetty:00145871:ios.name: AI Storage Optimizer App
bluejetty:00145871:ios.summary: Now fully embracing iOS 26 Liquid Glass — every surface, every transition, every interaction redesigned with clarity and resonance. This version marks a new chapter: not just a tool, but a crafted environment for how you perceive and mainta
bluejetty:00145871:ios.description:
Now fully embracing iOS 26 Liquid Glass — every surface, every transition, every interaction redesigned with clarity and resonance. This version marks a new chapter: not just a tool, but a crafted environment for how you perceive and maintain your digital landscape.
AI Storage Optimizer App reimagines everyday data care into a series of intuitive gestures:
 • Photo Metadata Presence: Engage with the hidden layers of your images — dates, locations, formats, and device details — through a minimalist lens that makes the invisible visible. Batch editing flows seamlessly, giving you agency over your collection without losing aesthetic balance.
 • Space Awareness: Remove unused traces and lighten your iPhone with purposeful choices. Rather than focusing on speed or utility alone, the process is designed as a mindful dialogue with your device’s memory.
 • Media Compression with Elegance: Photos and videos can be condensed, not diminished. With flowing interactions, the app allows storage savings while preserving the sensory integrity of your memories.
 • Mail Integration with Clarity: Connect to your inbox and let the interface classify messages into gentle categories — promotional bursts, forum echoes, or conversational fragments — so your attention remains where it matters.
 • AI Albums as Digital Rituals: Collections of people, pets, trips, or moments unfold as curated pathways, offering you an elegant way to revisit the rhythms of your digital life.
What sets it apart is not the checklist of functions, but the design ethos:
 • Ritualized Interaction: Each tap and slide is framed as part of a daily ceremony of digital upkeep.
 • Data as Material: Metadata is not hidden utility, but sculpted information presented with visual dignity.
 • Modern Aesthetics: Inspired by liquid transparency, the interface resonates with restraint and light, emphasizing calm presence rather than urgency.
It is not about chasing "faster" or "cleaner," but about experiencing your device's memory as a living space — one that can be tended to, refined, and appreciated with composure.
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase (After free trial period if offered).
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00142157:ios.description:
Our app turns your iPhone into a smart TV remote, so you can control your TV without the original remote. It works with Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic, TCL, Roku TVs and Roku sticks, Hitachi, Telefunken, Grundig, Continental Edison, and many other brands.
Quick and Easy Setup
Connect your iPhone and your TV to the same Wi-Fi network, and the app will find your TV automatically. On some models, you just need to confirm the connection on your TV screen.
The app works over Wi-Fi, so you can control your TV from anywhere in the room, no need to point at the screen.
Familiar Remote Design
A realistic, easy-to-use layout gives you access to all the main functions of your original remote.

bluejetty:00128526:ios.description:
Turn your photo in a vibrant HDR with unparalleled ranges of light and detail
--- Top Selling App in All Countries ---
Simply HDR is a powerful HDR tool that instantly creates stunning and mesmerizing imagery from otherwise bland subjects or compositions. 
Have you ever looked at a well-executed HDR photo with a dramatic sky and wish you could take a shot like that? Now you can! With Simply HDR this stunning art form is now accessible to everyone.
Simply HDR comes with a powerful HDR engine, an easy-to-use interface, options to choose HDR presets for quick one-click results and the ability to experiment with the controls to evolve your own photographic style. Once you’ve found the settings that work best for you ‘save preset’ for future projects. This cool features allows you to maintain a consistent HDR workflow.
With six HDR Styles and a library of artistic content you can create both realistic HDR photos or stylized ones—the result will be outstanding work that is captivating, mesmerizing, revealing and beautifully detailed. 
HDR STYLES
• High Dynamic Range (HDR)
• Black and White HDR
• Contrasted HDR
• Shadows and Lights
• Contrasted Light
FEATURES
Fully adjustable control on all aspects of the process: HDR, Color Gradients, Vignette, and Grain.
INCLUDES
A library of HDArt Color Gradients
UNIVERSAL FEATURES
All JixiPix Apps come with: Superior Customer Service, Support for High-Resolution Images & Output, Undo, Randomize Button, Quick Presets and the ability to create Custom Presets, Cropping with the ability to specify aspect ratio, Quick Preview, Email, Print, and the ability to post directly to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and Tumblr. We also have an online art gallery and invite our user’s to display their artistic creations on it: http://www.flickr.com/groups/jixipixcreations/

Photography | Artistic | Graphic Apps

bluejetty:00047863:ios.description:
«Vive le Roi 3» is a puzzle and anticipation game, without chance or timing, based on mini puzzles to be solved by choosing the right ladder on each floor to reach the king and save him from his executioner.
Inspired by the concept of labyrinths, the originality of «Vive le Roi 3» is to be able to modify the state of the active elements of the levels according to your choices.
The levels are made up of numerous obstacles, such as doors, monsters, moving guards, tunnels… They are also made up of multicolored switches allowing to invert the states of the obstacles in order to clear a path.
Crowns are placed at the end of the level and the player will have to collect them in order to collect all the cards of the kings of France.
The game features 1000 levels and 66 kings to collect.

bluejetty:00161812:ios.name: LetterGrid: PvP Word Battle
bluejetty:00161812:ios.summary:
LetterGrid is a competitive word strategy game inspired by WordBase.
Find words on the board. Capture territory. Attack your opponent. Block their path. And plan several moves ahead to conquer the board. Strategy is key!
LetterGrid is a m
bluejetty:00161812:ios.description:
LetterGrid is a competitive word strategy game inspired by WordBase.
Find words on the board. Capture territory. Attack your opponent. Block their path. And plan several moves ahead to conquer the board. Strategy is key!
LetterGrid is a multiplayer turn-based word game inspired by Wordbase that requires the use of vocabulary and strategy to win against your opponent. You can play with friends and strangers online or practice with AI bot. The game is a combination of word search and territory control. The tiles of the words you find become yours. Use strategy to beat your opponent by reaching the goal of two game types:
1) Invasion - you have to build a chain of words from your border to your opponent's border starting each word from a tile that is already yours. 
2) Territory - occupy a set number of tiles before your opponent by making words that use at least one tile that is already yours. 
As you play the match, you must use strategy to find such words that will let you win against your opponent by expanding your territory to reach the goal of the game, stealing the tiles of your opponent and even cutting them off!
Game Features:
• Interactive tutorials
• Play against other people or computer
• Player rating system (Elo)
• Leaderboards based on recent wins as well as overall rating.
• Extensive player statistics and graphs of progress.
• 11 languages: English, Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Portugues, Italian
• Automatic check for valid words. You can play by trial and error and discover and learn new words!
• Word definitions and quick links to word information on the web.
• Exchange messages with your opponent with build-in chat.
• Timed mode
• Built-in chat
• Daily Puzzles with leaderboards
If you like word games such as crossword puzzles, scrabble, boggle, wordle and you are a competitive player, LetterGrid is the game for you!
If you have any problems with the app or for any questions please contact the developer via WhatsApp: +1.917.267.8497 (preferred) or email: info@punginsoft.com.
Privacy Policy: https://LetterGrid.app/privacy_policy
Terms Of Use (EULA) https://LetterGrid.app/eula

•Receive account notifications

New Clients

bluejetty:00183002:ios.description:
Classic cribbage (Crib) where 2 players race to 121 points with single player or online multiplayer! This isn't a casino game like poker, bingo, or blackjack, as cribbage is a unique mix of chance and strategy. Each game has its own fun challenges and rewards, with this version including Contests to compete in.
Play the powerful computer opponent or go online with other players worldwide in the ultimate cribbage experience! If you’re a fan of Solitaire, Uno, Backgammon, Phase 10, Gin Rummy, Yahtzee, Skip Bo, Euchre, or Hearts, try this free classic cribbage now!
Features:
* Single player or Online Multiplayer (Cross-Platform)
- Play cribbage with grandpa, your kids, just your friends or against the computer
* Cross-Platform Multiplayer
- iOS/iPod/iPhone/iPad & non-iOS devices
* Multiplayer "tournament" style options
- Play best of 1, 3, 5 or 7 games to win
* 3 single player difficulty levels
* True random shuffle at all times!
* "Daily Cribbage Scrimmage" Challenges! - Take on a fresh daily challenge, then share with friends to compare your results!
* Leaderboard Friend Groups! - Filter the Leaderboard to show just your friends and your relative ranking!
* Play in the largest online multiplayer cribbage tournament, now officially sanctioned by the American Cribbage Congress. Open to all players, with ACC membership entirely optional.
* 80+ single player achievements possible
* Simple and intuitive game play
* Shuffle, scoring & other sound effects
* Detailed stats & "Top 50" leader-board
- Separate for single player & multiplayer
* Over 50 in-game avatars to choose from
* Custom avatars
* Manual counting option w/ muggins
* Single player hints to learn cribbage
* "Cut for first deal" to balance the odds
* Multiple game boards, backgrounds & card styles
* Options for auto-play on selection or confirm, auto-cut the deck and more!
* Add a friend, send private messages or chat
* VoiceOver Accessibility
* Remove ads with in-app purchase option
- Keep cribbage free, or if you would like to disable the advertising in this free cribbage game, please purchase using the option available inside the game.
Cribbage is sometimes called just Crib, Cribble, and Noddy, but it is always a fun and interesting alternative to Pinochle, Old Maid, Canasta, Catan, Whist, Brainium or Yahtzee. Try a classic cribbage game instead!
*Apple is not a sponsor of any ad or promotion*
Please Email issues/ideas to support@FullerSystems.com
Terms of Service & End User License Agreement: http://www.cribbagepro.net/eula.html

Circle o Fifths is the fastest way to find the chords in any key, learn the scales to solo over them, and write your own songs. A handy practice tool that's a gam
bluejetty:00073930:ios.description:
Turn music theory into something you can actually play — on guitar or piano.
Circle o Fifths is the fastest way to find the chords in any key, learn the scales to solo over them, and write your own songs. A handy practice tool that's a game changer for learning songs, writing your own, and finally understanding how chords fit together.
NEW in 2.2: A Scales tab — see any scale on the guitar fretboard or piano keyboard, color-coded by degree, with the five CAGED shapes, full-neck patterns, and a Licks Library of ready-made riffs (blues, rock, metal, country, bluegrass, jazz, and worship). Plus guitar chord charts that flip vertical or horizontal.
NEW in 2.1: 21 color themes — tap the palette to redress the entire app; a few are suspiciously reminiscent of your favorite films, albums, and bands.
NEW in 2.0: Piano mode and a chord progression builder.
Switch between guitar and piano on the fly — chord diagrams, sounds, and strumming all swap to match. Head to the new Scales tab to see any scale light up on the fretboard or keyboard, work through CAGED shapes and full-neck patterns, and learn ready-made licks note for note. Jump to the Progressions tab to build your own chord progressions, pick a tempo, and hear them played back with realistic strumming patterns. And tap the palette to recolor the entire app — wheel, badges, and chord charts — with 21 handpicked themes.
Features: 
• 3 full rings with support for all major and minor keys
• 36 interactive notes/chords on the circle
• NEW! Scales tab — see any scale on guitar or piano, color-coded by degree
 - The five CAGED shapes plus full-neck patterns (Diagonal, 3 notes/string)
 - Chord-tones view to spotlight the root, 3rd, and 5th
 - Licks Library — ready-made riffs in blues, rock, metal, country, bluegrass, jazz, and worship
 - Tempo control to run any scale up and back
• NEW! Guitar chord charts flip vertical or horizontal
• 21 color themes — personalize the wheel, badges, and chord charts (just tap the palette icon)
• Key badge in the center of the wheel — your current major and relative-minor key, plus its key signature, at a glance
• Toggle between guitar and piano modes — affects both sounds and diagrams
• Synthesized piano with rich, multi-voice triads
• 36 real guitar audio recordings of every chord on the circle
• 36 guitar chord charts — drawn right in the app and themed to match; just tap and hold to learn
• Piano chord diagrams with highlighted notes on a keyboard
• Color coding to help you reference and learn the note/chord you're playing
• Chords tab to see all chords in each key, with major/minor relationships
• Progressions tab — build your own progressions and hear them play back
 - Pick any major or minor key (24 total)
 - Tap I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii° to add chords to your track
 - NEW! Follow along — see the current chord and what's next as it plays
 - Tempo control and loop for practice
 - Strum patterns: Whole, Quarter, Eighth, Folk, Rock
 - Built-in metronome
The outside ring of the circle has all the major keys. Tap any of them to hear and change the key. The color coding tells you which number each chord is. The middle ring has all the minor keys, and the inner ring has the diminished chords. Tap any chord to hear it, or tap and hold to see how to play it on guitar or piano!
If you're playing in a major key, use the color coding up top to understand the chord relationships. If you're playing in a minor key, use the color coding on the bottom.
Use the Chords tab to play songs in any key, transpose on the fly, and see major/minor key relationships. Use the Progressions tab to compose, practice over a loop, or hear common progressions like I-IV-V or ii-V-I in any key. listings.description:
Turn music theory into something you can actually play — on guitar or piano.

Circle o Fifths is the fastest way to find the chords in any key, learn the scales to solo over them, and write your own songs. A handy practice tool that's a game changer for learning songs, writing your own, and finally understanding how chords fit together.

NEW in 2.2: A Scales tab — see any scale on the guitar fretboard or piano keyboard, color-coded by degree, with the five CAGED shapes, full-neck patterns, and a Licks Library of ready-made riffs (blues, rock, metal, country, bluegrass, jazz, and worship). Plus guitar chord charts that flip vertical or horizontal.
NEW in 2.1: 21 color themes — tap the palette to redress the entire app; a few are suspiciously reminiscent of your favorite films, albums, and bands.
NEW in 2.0: Piano mode and a chord progression builder.

Switch between guitar and piano on the fly — chord diagrams, sounds, and strumming all swap to match. Head to the new Scales tab to see any scale light up on the fretboard or keyboard, work through CAGED shapes and full-neck patterns, and learn ready-made licks note for note. Jump to the Progressions tab to build your own chord progressions, pick a tempo, and hear them played back with realistic strumming patterns. And tap the palette to recolor the entire app — wheel, badges, and chord charts — with 21 handpicked themes.

Features: 
• 3 full rings with support for all major and minor keys
• 36 interactive notes/chords on the circle
• NEW! Scales tab — see any scale on guitar or piano, color-coded by degree
   - The five CAGED shapes plus full-neck patterns (Diagonal, 3 notes/string)
   - Chord-tones view to spotlight the root, 3rd, and 5th
   - Licks Library — ready-made riffs in blues, rock, metal, country, bluegrass, jazz, and worship
   - Tempo control to run any scale up and back
• NEW! Guitar chord charts flip vertical or horizontal
• 21 color themes — personalize the wheel, badges, and chord charts (just tap the palette icon)
• Key badge in the center of the wheel — your current major and relative-minor key, plus its key signature, at a glance
• Toggle between guitar and piano modes — affects both sounds and diagrams
• Synthesized piano with rich, multi-voice triads
• 36 real guitar audio recordings of every chord on the circle
• 36 guitar chord charts — drawn right in the app and themed to match; just tap and hold to learn
• Piano chord diagrams with highlighted notes on a keyboard
• Color coding to help you reference and learn the note/chord you're playing
• Chords tab to see all chords in each key, with major/minor relationships
• Progressions tab — build your own progressions and hear them play back
   - Pick any major or minor key (24 total)
   - Tap I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii° to add chords to your track
   - NEW! Follow along — see the current chord and what's next as it plays
   - Tempo control and loop for practice
   - Strum patterns: Whole, Quarter, Eighth, Folk, Rock
   - Built-in metronome

The outside ring of the circle has all the major keys. Tap any of them to hear and change the key. The color coding tells you which number each chord is. The middle ring has all the minor keys, and the inner ring has the diminished chords. Tap any chord to hear it, or tap and hold to see how to play it on guitar or piano!

If you're playing in a major key, use the color coding up top to understand the chord relationships. If you're playing in a minor key, use the color coding on the bottom.

Use the Chords tab to play songs in any key, transpose on the fly, and see major/minor key relationships. Use the Progressions tab to compose, practice over a loop, or hear common progressions like I-IV-V or ii-V-I in any key. Use the Scales tab to find the notes to solo over any chord — pick a pattern, target the chord tones, and grab a lick to get you started.

Players move the cards by clicking or dragging, and place all the cards into the four "card base areas" in the order of A~K. Each "card base area" can only have one suit. bluejetty:00162206:android.description:
Home Credit app supports fast loans with simple procedures and ensures absolute information security. Additionally, Home Credit offers a wide range of financial products, including Credit Cards, Home PayLater accounts, and 0% installment plans for electronics and motorbikes, helping you achieve your dreams.
Benefits of Using the Home Credit App:
· 100% online registration for financial products.
· Loan approval within 3 minutes.
· Quick loans with easy steps.
· Online loans with attractive interest rates using just your ID card.
· Loan limits range from 5 million to 250 million VND.
· Flexible repayment terms from 3 to 57 months.
· Flat interest rates range from 8.99% - 33.94% per year.
Example Calculation:
· Loan Amount: 40,000,000 VND
· Loan Term: 12 months
· Flat Interest Rate: 8.99%/year (depending on the product policy)
· Monthly Payment: 3,651,000 VND (includes a 11,000 VND bank fee per month)
· Total Payment Amount: 43,812,000 VND
· Total Interest: 3,812,000 VND
Eligibility for Online Loans, Fast Loans, and Credit Cards with Home Credit:
· Must be a Vietnamese citizen.
· Aged between 20 to under 60 years.
· Possess an ID card or Citizen ID.
About Us
Home Credit Vietnam Finance Company Limited is a leading company in the fast online loan sector. With over 16 years of operation, we have established a presence in 63 provinces and cities across the country and gained the trust of more than 16 million customers.
Through the Home Credit app, we provide:
· Fast online loans.
· Buy Now, Pay Later services.
· Installment loans and credit solutions.
· Loan management, bill payments for electricity, water, and phone top-ups.
· Financial literacy resources.
Why Choose Home Credit’s Fast Online Loans?
· Over 16 million satisfied customers.
· Secure online processes with high confidentiality.
· Diverse loan options, including consumer loans, installment loans, and no-income-proof loans through the app.
· Quick re-loan options tailored to meet all customer needs.
· Professional, dedicated support staff.
· Privacy and data security are top priorities.
Privacy & Security
Customer privacy is a top priority at Home Credit. We comply with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, ensuring that customer information is safeguarded. Learn more about our privacy policy on our website.

Your Feedback Matters
