bluejetty:00135862:ios.description:
The AI Trading bot - Market watch is an advanced tool designed for investors who want to stay ahead in the stock market. This app provides real-time investment signals and market analysis to help users make informed investment decisions.
With the AI Trading bot - Market watch, users can access a wide range of investment signals, including buy, hold and sell signals, as well as technical indicators and market trends. The app uses advanced algorithms and machine learning technology to analyze market data and generate signals, giving users a significant advantage in their investment strategies.
The app distinguishes between closed signals and active signals. Closed signals provide valuable insight into past market performance and the app's analytical capabilities. Active signals represent current opportunities to buy stocks and potentially profit from market movements. However, access to these valuable, real-time active signals requires a subscription. Without a subscription, users can only view the closed signals.
The app also provides users with an investment dashboard where they can monitor their investments and track their performance. The dashboard includes real-time updates and alerts on significant market events, allowing users to always have the most up-to-date information at their fingertips.
The AI Trading bot - Market watch is easy to use, with its intuitive interface allowing users to quickly navigate through the app's features. The app also offers users an article of analytics on each signal, making it a great tool for beginners and experienced investors alike.
Whether you are an experienced investor or just starting out in the stock market, with the AI Trading bot - Market watch it is very convenient — it is an indispensable tool for those who want to make smart investment decisions. With powerful investment signals and comprehensive market analysis, this app is the key to success in today's fast-changing stock market.
Features:
- Signals for stock trading
- Fundamental and technical analysis
- Two signals per day on average

Transform Your Body with Your Personal Training Coach - In Your Pocket!
Looking for a personal training coach to guide you towards your fitness goals? Look no further! This app is your all-in-one solution for strength training, muscle building, and fat loss, providing personalized workout plans and expert guidance right at your fingertips. Whether you're a beginner taking your first steps towards a healthier lifestyle or an experienced lifter aiming to shatter plateaus, the Personal Training Coach app is designed to help you achieve your full potential.
Here's what users say:
"This is the best weightlifting app I’ve ever used. The preset programs are great but the customization options and how easy it is to use really set it apart!"
"Hands down one of the best workout logging applications I have ever used."
"This app is fantastic is you want to track your training progress. The app is simply and user and the best of all is that it offers endless customisation so you can always adjust your program based on your training needs. Highly recommend this app"
"I’ve been using this app for years and in that time I’ve tried plenty of others but I always come back to this one as it’s the most user friendly and best value app out there."
This app acts as your dedicated personal trainer, providing structured workout programs tailored to your fitness level. Choose from a vast library of proven programs like StrongLifts 5x5, Wendler 5/3/1, GreySkull LP, and many more, or create your own custom workout routines from scratch. We'll guide you on which exercises to do, how much weight to lift, and how many sets and reps to perform, ensuring optimal results.
Free Features to Empower Your Training:
• Proven Workout Programs: Get started immediately with popular programs like StrongLifts, GreySkull LP, Wendler 5/3/1, and Push Pull Legs.
• Automatic Tracking: Effortlessly track your weights, sets, and reps, leaving you free to focus on your workout.
• Visualize Progress: Monitor your gains with intuitive graphs and charts, showcasing your strength and muscle growth.
• Smart Progression: Benefit from auto weight increments and deloads, ensuring continuous progress and preventing plateaus.
• Exercise Guidance: Detailed exercise descriptions and progress tracking help you perfect your form and maximize results.
• Personalized Experience: Choose between kg/lb, light/dark mode, and even track your Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE).
- Flexible Workouts: Start an empty workout and add exercises on the fly, adapting to your needs and preferences.
• Apple Watch app: Fully-featured Apple Watch app to log workouts with or without your iPhone
Unlock Pro for the Ultimate Personal Training Experience:
• Warmup sets
• Custom Workout Creation: Design personalized workout routines tailored to your specific goals and preferences.
• Smart Warm-ups: Prepare your body for peak performance with personalized warm-up routines.
• Program Modification: Adapt any built-in program to suit your individual needs and preferences.
• Enhanced Customization: Edit and reorder exercises within a workout for maximum flexibility.
Your Personal Training Coach is here to support you every step of the way. Download now and start your transformation today!
Contact Us: We value your feedback! Reach out to us directly through the app with any suggestions or ideas.

bluejetty:00130156:ios.description:
Get ready for a thrilling base defense experience in Ammo Fever, the ultimate defense game! You're a little stickman with a big machine gun, waiting for the bullet stack supply to defend yourself against the incoming riot. Will you survive the base attack and become the ultimate stickman defender?
As the enemies approach, you'll need to rely on your quick reflexes to shoot them down and protect your base. But with limited bullets, you'll have to make every shot count. That's where merging ammo boxes with weapons comes in handy - the more you merge, the bigger your bullets become, allowing you to take down enemies with greater ease.
But the challenge doesn't end there. As you progress through the levels, the enemies become stronger and more challenging to defeat. You'll need to upgrade your weapon and fireline, and improve your bullet rush, to keep up with the increasing difficulty. And with each upgrade, you'll see your ammunition evolve and your gunpowder become more powerful, leading to a fascinating weapon evolution.
Features:
-Engaging base defense gameplay that will keep you hooked for hours.
-Merge boxes with weapons to upgrade your firepower and get bigger bullets for your machine gun.
-Upgrade your weapon and fireline to keep up with the increasing difficulty of your bullet stack.
-Improve your bullet rush to take down enemies with greater ease.
-See your ammunition evolve and your gunpowder become more powerful, leading to a fascinating weapon evolution.
-Intuitive controls for easy gameplay.
Are you ready to become a military tycoon and defend your base from the riot? Download Ammo Fever now and start your base attack battle today!

bluejetty:00187435:ios.description:
MyAlarm — mobile app for security alarm management and video surveillance.
— Wherever you are, arm and disarm the security system in your house, office, shop, or storage with just one click.
— Event feed shows what is happening at your site: when the children came home from school, employees disarmed the security system in the office, the power went off in your country house.
— Watch video from the cameras both online and from archive, save video fragments and share them right from the app.
— In case of smoke blanketing, water leakage or gas leakage, if the site is equipped with appropriate devices, alarm notifications will be sent to the application.
— Manage the devices connected to the security system: lights, gates or gas-fired boiler.
—You have no need to watch notifications on the phone screen if you choose the sound scheme "Rita". Notifications will be sounded by a pleasant female voice.
— With administrator privileges you can invite colleagues and relatives to manage your sites. As well you can disable access to your sites for any members.
The app is available for the clients of security companies and for the clients of the MyAlarm system. 
The app requires an internet connection. The range of features in the app depends on the type and configuration of the installed security devices.

bluejetty:00159793:ios.description:
Silencio is the leading app to earn crypto by mapping noise levels. Join the largest noise data network to track, share, and monetize your noise data, contributing to healthier cities. Start earning today by sharing noise levels with your community and being part of the measuring network. In addition to earning rewards, Silencio helps you make informed decisions by offering insights into noise levels at millions of locations. Find quieter homes, restaurants, hotels, and venues, or submit and view noise complaints worldwide to help reduce noise pollution.
New Features:
 • Earn Crypto: Share noise data and get rewarded with crypto and $SLC tokens. You can now participate in the largest noise measuring network and gain more rewards.
 • Track Noise Levels: Use our advanced noise meter to track noise pollution and contribute to the noise data network.
 • Find Quiet Venues: Discover quieter homes, restaurants, and hotels by exploring real-time noise data for millions of locations worldwide.
 • Create & View Noise Complaints: Submit noise complaints or explore complaints from over 180 countries to help reduce noise pollution globally.
 • Monetize Your Data: Earn passive income by sharing data that is valuable to industries like real estate, hospitality, and urban planning.
 • Join a Global Community: Connect with hhundred of thousands of community members worldwide and help build quieter, smarter cities.
 • Real-Time Data Sharing: Share real-time data and see urban noise levels across the world.
Core Benefits:
 • Noise Pollution: Help reduce noise pollution while earning rewards. Your data supports smarter urban planning and contributes to the largest noise measuring network.
 • Passive Income: Earn crypto and passive income for sharing your environmental data. Participate in our measuring network and be rewarded for your efforts.
 • Find Quieter Spaces: Use Silencio to discover quieter venues, homes, and businesses based on real-time noise data.
 • Community Impact: Join a global community dedicated to fighting noise pollution and shaping healthier cities.
 • Privacy-First: We prioritize your privacy by ensuring your data is protected and shared only with consent.
Why Choose Silencio?
 • Earn Crypto: Gain rewards with crypto and $SLC tokens by contributing data to the noise data network.
 • Broad Industry Impact: Your noise data supports industries that help build smarter, quieter urban environments.
 • Find Quiet Venues & Homes: Make better living and travel decisions by checking noise levels in homes, hotels, and restaurants.
 • Privacy and Security: Your data is encrypted, decentralized, and protected to prioritize your privacy.
Join Silencio Today!
 Download Silencio now and be part of the solution. Earn crypto, find quieter venues, help shape healthier cities, and join the largest noise data network today.

bluejetty:00025873:ios.description:
Arcadia Sports is a collection of arcade games with a sports theme for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.
The collection consists of 12 games (with many more to come):
- Beach Ball
Match similar balls to form larger ones. Keep them in the box.
- Formula Race
Compete in the premier racing series and outpace your opponents with skillful overtaking maneuvers.
- Hoop Fever
Dribble, shoot and score. All with just one finger.
- Basket
Getting the ball in the hoop is a given. But what if the hoop had to target the ball instead?
- 8-Ball Pool
Classic 8-Ball in solo mode. Sink balls of one type (solid or striped) first and then the rest, culminating in the 8-ball.
- 9-Ball Pool
Hit the lowest numbered ball first, but numerical order isn't necessary for pocketing.
- Air Hockey
Similar to hockey, minus the ice and Zamboni. First to reach 10 points wins.
- CyberSoccer
Turn-based soccer, a new twist.
Each CyberPlayer manages a zone on the field. If the ball lands there, it's their turn.
- MiniGolf (Course A)
Golf, but downsized with compact courses full of obstacles and challenges.
- MiniGolf (Course B)
Similar to before, but with different courses (and challenges).
- Bowling
A classic! Knock down all the pins, preferably in one roll. Easier said than done, right?
- RainBowling
Bowling meets a rainbow, with explosive pins and obstacles. Not quite the rainbow we remember.
Is this a small offering? Don't worry!
This is just the beginning.
We're already working on new games that will be added to the collection over time.
Additional Features:
- Advanced support for Apple Watch (Series 3 and later, Ultra and later)
- 120 fps support on compatible devices
- iCloud support for saving progress
- Game Center support for online leaderboards
- No advertisements
- No tracking

BATTLES OVER DOZEN GIANT BOSSES
Summon hundreds of epic heroes through gacha collecting in the Tavern.
Unlock hero images from the five factions (Justice, Evil, Neutral, Holy and Corrupt) in your Gallery.
DOMINATE IN PVP AND PVE
Story Campaign, The Heroic Crusade, Arena, Stonehenge, Nightmare Challenge, The Trial of Truth, and Guild Bosses, Dragon, among all other gods. Rich gameplay and various battlefields await you.

bluejetty:00065242:ios.description:
As a digital-first credit union, we use the latest (and most secure!) technology available to meet your banking needs on your terms. The PSECU Mobile app provides everyday convenience, real-time access, and top-notch features for our members.
Get Your Money Where It Needs to Go
- Instantly move money between PSECU shares and loans.
- Bring money into your PSECU account with our external account transfer service.
- Send money to people you know and trust, typically in minutes between enrolled users, with Zelle®.
- Snap and go! Use mobile deposit to easily deposit checks and save a trip to an ATM or branch.
Control Your Cards with Just a Few Taps
- Misplaced your card? Lock it the moment you notice it's missing. You can also order a new one!
- Planning a trip? Enter travel plans to avoid interruptions in service. 
- Making a large purchase? Temporarily increase your daily limit for ATM withdrawals or purchases.
- Transfer high-interest debt to a PSECU credit card to save on interest with our Visa® Balance Transfer rates.
Members Can Take Advantage of Free Services
- Enroll in our free credit score service* to receive monthly updates on your score.
- Sign up for free account alerts to stay on top of account activity.
- Automate bill payments using our free bill payer service.
- Find surcharge-free ATMs near you.
Add Additional Savings Products
- Take advantage of our competitive savings rates and add a certificate or other savings share to your PSECU account.
Enjoy Banking That’s Focused on YOU
- As a not-for-profit credit union, we exist to serve our members. That means listening to your feedback and ensuring you have the best banking experience possible.
Zelle® and the Zelle® related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are used herein under license. 
* PSECU is not a credit reporting agency. Members must have PSECU checking or a PSECU loan to be eligible for this service. Joint owners are not eligible.
Insured by NCUA.

bluejetty:00079846:ios.name: Urent: e-scooter rental
bluejetty:00079846:ios.summary: Urent – e-scooter and bike share app. If you want to go for a ride with friends or get to your favourite coffee shop quickly and easily – Urent is a service for you! Fast and convenient way to move around the city, hundreds of parking lots
bluejetty:00079846:ios.description:
Urent – e-scooter and bike share app. If you want to go for a ride with friends or get to your favourite coffee shop quickly and easily – Urent is a service for you! Fast and convenient way to move around the city, hundreds of parking lots where you can rent an electric scooter and leave it afterwards.
It’s simple!
- Download the app and register – it takes a couple of minutes, only a phone number and a bank card are needed.
- Find the nearest e-scooter on the map in the app.
- Scan QR-code on the wheel, choose tariff plan and press "Start"
- Unlock the scooter, push off and press the gas – the lever on the right side of the wheel.
- Hundreds of parking lots to lock the scooter easily and finish the rent.
- Keep an eye on the charge of the scooter to find parking complete the rent in time.
MULTI-RENT
Take up to 5 scooters and/or bikes per one account – just rent a few e-scooters or bicycles by scanning their QR-codes.
BOOKING AND STANDBY MODE
Book a bike or electric scooter in the app, and it will wait for you for 10 minutes.
You can close the lock and put the e-scooter in standby mode during rental – rent continues, but the lock will be closed, you can leave for a few minutes without worrying about your scooter safety.
More information about service use terms on our website https://urent.ru/rules/
Service is available in Moscow, St. Petersburg, Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk and the largest cities in the South of Russia, such as Sochi, Krasnaya Polyana, Anapa, Krasnodar, Rostov-on-Don and others. The rental rules may differ for each city, so we recommend checking them before renting. In general, sharing is similar to Whoosh, Eleven, Lite, Busyfly, YES Sharing, Lime, Bird, Dott, Voi, Tier, Circ, EnerGo and others.
E-scooter and bike sharing Urent – simple, pleasant and fast way to get wherever you want!

bluejetty:00136945:ios.description:
Welcome to the Wild West! Immerse in the atmosphere of western shooter games with a variety of weapons: rifles, pistols and other guns you can get your hands on. Incredible survival action shootout against cruel bandits and other dangerous enemies! Load up your gun and get ready to shoot in this exploding action FPS!
Epic western story with the true hero - a brave cowboy gunslinger who protects the Wild West from criminal gangs, roaming bandits and mafia clans. To survive this dangerous environment, you must be one step ahead of your enemy. Challenge most wanted bandits, survive Wild West heat and complete your adventure as a true bounty hunter!
Brigands led by their bosses set out to seize western land. They are cruel and merciless and armed to the teeth with weapons and bullets. Just the Cowboy Sniper is able to push them back from his lands. Take the gun and fight! 
 The game is full of chases, shooting, fights and gunfights. Your weapon is your best friend and the only way to win in a tough fight! Aim, shoot and hit a target. The gun is the best tool in the fight for justice. You should be a sharpshooter to save your life. FPS in the Wild West! Bang, bang, bang...
Cowboy sniper: western gun features:
- Nonstop action FPS with shooting and chases
- Western atmosphere in Wild West setting
- Charismatic hero - a brave Cowboy Sniper
- Variety of weapons: rifles, pistols and other powerful guns
- The simple vital rule - shoot, shoot and shoot
- Immersive sounds effects
Cowboy sniper: western gun - exciting game with cool ragdoll graphics, clear mission and charismatic main character. It’s a new generation mobile shooter which you can play anywhere you like, online or offline - it’s up to you. Explore various locations and be ready to shoot down the bandits! Feel the spirit of the Wild West and come to realise that only you - the brave cowboy - could secure this land even if you need to confront the endless gangs. Sometimes Shooting is the only way to get justice and survive.

bluejetty:00039811:ios.description:
Breath training has been under-prioritized in sports for too long, though scientific studies continuously prove its multiple benefits. Airofit has developed the first-ever breathing trainer that connects respiratory training with state-of-the-art app technology. Once the app is paired with the Airofit breathing trainer, you will need to take a lung test to measure your respiratory strength. After taking the lung test, you will have the option to choose one of the many programs to train your breathing. The programs will be customized according to your preference and physical condition. As a result, you can practice your breathing and keep track of your progress to see your improvements.
The Airofit app is packed with loads of features, including:

bluejetty:00174727:ios.description:
Get all the power you need in vector design with Amadine. An intuitive vector design, drawing and illustration app with a clean and simple UI. Perfect for aspiring artists and designers, indispensable for professionals. 
With Amadine you will be able to create designs of any complexity, including illustrations, logos, icons, UI designs, brandbooks, art and more.
Want to know what Amadine has in stock?
• App Showcase:
Workspace allows to freely rotate canvas and supports all native Apple gestures, thus providing for a seamless experience.
Thanks to the zipped storage format оf document (amdc), you can save your graphics in different cloud storages without data loss.
Recolor panel lets you easily make large color changes to your artwork.
Fusion tool offers you a totally different approach to creating vector objects based on combining multiple objects into one.
Flowing Text feature allows users to create and modify linked text boxes where text can flow from one text box into another.
Built-in vector shape libraries provide a large number of vector objects while you can also save Amadine shapes into your own libraries to create your custom sets.
Vectorize any bitmap image with the Image Trace tool. Choose Monochrome or Colored mode and fine-tune Brightness Threshold, Number of Colors, Level of Detail and Smoothness to balance accuracy against output complexity. 
• Powerful vector tools:
Work with more than 30 tools for selecting, drawing, editing and typing.
Select and modify objects: Move, Selection, Lasso, Eyedropper, Scissors, Eraser, Knife, Free Transform tools.
Draw and edit paths: Pen, Draw (combines Pencil and Brush), Width, Gradient, Path Width, Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Line, Arc.
Create an evenly spaced outline around any shape or complex path with the Offset Path tool. 
Transform shapes: Free Transform, Symmetrical Distortion, Free Distortion.
Clipping Mask allows to mask objects and perform the best visual result by creating a Clipping Group with all the masked objects still being editable.
• Workflow:
Store multiple artworks in one document.
Create multiple layers and sublayers.
More than 15 different layer blending modes.
View options: pixel preview, outline, guides and grid.
• Impeccable colorwork:
Color Wheel provides the perfect color picking and application.
Full support for both RGB and CMYK color modes.
Color profiles support for accurate display of colors on different devices.
• Pro level text editing:
Type and edit text: Text tool (combines distortable text and text in box), Text on Path tool, Text in Shape tool.

You can order both burgers and steaks, as well as products from grocery stores. Free delivery for your first order!

In the app, you can find out the status of the order and the location of the courier.

In the section "Promotions" we collect the best offers from shops and restaurants every day.
Menu.am is an information service. Delivery zones, delivery times, and restaurant offers are limited.

bluejetty:00018229:ios.description:
Monthly Expenses Tracker: NEKO allows you to organize your bill payments, spending and income in a calendar with account balance forecast and bill reminders, so you stay on top of your finances.
NEKO comes with great features such as:
Safe to Spend
The safe to spend calculator will make your life easier when budgeting and avoid overspending. It takes into account your upcoming bills, expenses, credit card payments and transfers, and based on your current account balance and income, will tell you how much money you can spend on a given date without worrying you are short for paying a bill. 
Calendar
The calendar is the best bill payment organizer tool since it helps you visualize what bills are coming up and pair them with your paydays. This way you can manage your money and transactions easily. When you select a date in the future, the calendar gives you the projected balance, projected money in and projected money out. Now you don't have to worry about accounts being overdraft and transfer money as needed ahead of time. 
Easy Expense Tracking
Monthly Expenses Tracker: NEKO allows you to record your expenses and categorize them to understand your spending patterns better. Stay on top of your budget and identify areas for potential savings.
Stay on Budget
Utilize our chart feature to compare income, expenses and every bill payment, ensuring you avoid overspending.
Income Management
Keep track of your earnings and manage multiple income sources effortlessly. Monthly Expenses Tracker: NEKO helps you track your income and plan your spending easily.
Bill Payment Organizer
NEKO sends timely reminders for upcoming bill payments, ensuring you never miss a due date. Now, track every bill and get reminders to pay on time.
Insights with Helpful Reports
Get a clear overview of your financial health with comprehensive reports. Analyze your spending habits, saving patterns, and more to make informed decisions and manage your money like a pro.
Currency Support
Monthly Expenses Tracker: NEKO supports multiple currencies, allowing you to effortlessly manage your finances.
NEKO is the perfect money manager that will help you build the habit of tracking and controlling your bills and spending. It tells you how much money you have left after paying your bills so you can start saving or spend it however you want without worries.

bluejetty:00153787:ios.description:
Hexa Crush — a fun and addictive hexa puzzle and color sort game! 
Sort and stack colorful hexagon blocks with simple drag-and-drop controls. With smooth 3D visuals and satisfying mechanics, Hexa Crush sharpens your mind while still offering a relaxing hexa sorting experience. Perfect for casual players and puzzle-solving lovers.
FEATURES:
- Vibrant Gameplay: Colorful visuals with smooth 3D animations bring each hex tile to life.
- Dynamic Sound Effects: Relax with immersive ASMR-style audio that enhances every move.
- Power-Ups & Combos: Unlock boosters to clear tough puzzles and trigger chain reactions.
- Thousands of Levels: Enjoy colorful sorting puzzles with fresh challenges for all ages.
- Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Progressively harder levels that constantly test your strategy.
- Relax or Compete: Play casually or Challenge friends to climb the leaderboard.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Drag and drop hexagonal tiles to sort and stack them on the board.
- Merge hexagons of the same color to eliminate them.
- Plan your moves carefully to avoid running out of space.
- Create combos and chain reactions for bonus points and high scores.
- Collect points to unlock decorations and customize your buildings!
If you love clever stacking games and satisfying puzzles, Hexa Crush is your next favorite pick. With a fresh spin on classic sorting games, it offers the perfect mix of focus, fun, and strategy. Step into the world of Hexa Crush and become a true hexa master. Download now and conquer the ultimate hexagon puzzle experience!

bluejetty:00175017:ios.description:
Meet your Kauai tour guide. Discover GPS audio tours that turn your drive into a guided adventure with stories, directions, and local insights.
Imagine driving past a scenic beach or heading into Waimea Canyon when your phone starts telling you exactly what you’re looking at — a cultural site, a scenic overlook, a story you would’ve missed — that’s how Shaka Guide works.
Explore Kauai with Shaka Guide, a 4.9-star GPS audio tour app trusted by thousands of travelers and made in Hawaii.
Our GPS audio tours play automatically as you drive, guiding you with stories, directions, and local insights, completely offline.
WHY SHAKA KAUAI
• GPS audio tours that play based on your location
• Works 100% offline — no cell service needed
• Built-in maps with preplanned routes and navigation
• Explore at your own pace — no schedules or groups
• Stories, Hawaiian music, and local travel tips
• Visit beaches, waterfalls, scenic drives, and hidden gems
It’s like having a tour guide in your car. No crowds or time limits. 
HOW IT WORKS
Download a tour, start driving, and go.
• Audio plays automatically along your route
• Get directions, stories, and recommendations in real time
• Stop where you want, skip what you don’t, or explore over multiple days
No rushing. No rigid plans. Just a better way to explore Kauai.
KAUAI TOURS
NORTH SHORE KAUAI DRIVING TOUR
6+ hours • 18 stops
• Moloa’a Beach & Secret Beach
• Kilauea Lighthouse
• Anini & Tunnels Beach snorkeling
• Kalalau Trail (Na Pali Coast)
• Hanalei Town
WAIMEA CANYON & NA PALI COAST
6+ hours • 19 stops
• Waimea Canyon viewpoints
• Kalalau Lookout
• Kauai coffee stops
• Hanapepe Town
• Scenic hikes and overlooks
WAILUA VALLEY & WATERFALLS
6+ hours • 19 stops
• Wailua & ‘Opaeka’a Falls
• Hindu monastery & sacred forest
• Lydgate Beach Park
• Ho’opi’i Falls hike
• Kapa’a food stops
POIPU & KOLOA DRIVING TOUR
4+ hours • 15 stops
• Spouting Horn blowhole
• Poipu Beach
• Shipwreck Beach
• Ancient Hawaiian sites
• Koloa Town
SAVE WITH THE ISLAND BUNDLE
Get all 4 tours for over 50% off.
TRUSTED BY TRAVELERS
What travelers say:
“Must-have app for exploring Kauai on your own.”
“We saw so many places we would’ve missed otherwise.”
“It felt like having a tour guide in the car with us.”
PLAN LESS. EXPERIENCE MORE.
Skip the research. Travel smarter. Discover more along the way.
IMPORTANT NOTES
• Download tours on Wi-Fi before your trip
• Continued GPS use may drain battery — bring a charger
• Wi-Fi-only iPads are not supported

bluejetty:00166928:ios.description:
WashKit finds what fills up your iPhone — duplicate photos, huge videos, old screenshots — and helps you clear it in a few taps. Swipe through your camera roll, keep what matters and get gigabytes back.
SWIPE TO CLEAN UP
• Swipe right to keep, left to delete: recent photos, a random mix, any month or On This Day.
• iOS asks you to confirm every deletion, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
DUPLICATES
• Find duplicate photos and videos, including near-identical shots.
• Compare the copies and choose which one to keep.
• Find duplicate contacts for free, then merge them into one or delete the extra copy with Premium. A backup is saved before every change.
SMART SCAN
• One scan shows duplicates, screenshots and large videos together, with the space you can free.
LARGE VIDEOS AND COMPRESSION
• See your biggest videos sorted by size.
• Compress videos and photos into smaller files to save space.
SCREENSHOTS AND MORE
• Clear old screenshots, imported photos and videos, and recent videos.
• Browse your albums and your library month by month.
SECRET VAULT
• Keep private photos and videos in a vault inside WashKit, locked with a PIN, Face ID or Touch ID.
• Export them as a ZIP file at any time.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• See how much space you have freed this month, keep a daily swipe streak and get a recap of your year.
IPHONE DUO
• On iPhone Duo, WashKit uses the whole inner display: compare duplicates side by side and swipe on the big screen.
PRIVACY
• WashKit scans your library on your device and never uploads your photos or videos.
• No ads and no account needed.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: duplicate photos and videos, screenshots, swipe cleanup, photo compression, albums, the monthly view and your storage overview.
WashKit Premium adds: deleting everything Smart Scan finds in one tap, deleting and compressing large videos, swiping through your largest videos, On This Day for any date, merging and deleting duplicate contacts, and Secret Vault.
Premium is available as an auto-renewable subscription or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. If an offer includes a free trial, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://cleankit.app/privacy_policy

The Ultimate Dog Breed Guide in the Palm of Your Hand!
Do you want to know more about dogs? Looking for a dog that best fits your family?
NATURE MOBILE introduces iKnow Dogs 2 PRO, an ideal guide to the most popular dog breeds. Finally, you have a direct option to identify different breeds without a book. Identify dogs by their look, purpose, temperament, and origin. You get a comprehensive library full of facts, figures, and images. Find the perfect dog for you and your family, or find the biggest, friendliest, most energetic, or any other type of dog that you like!
"Bo" Obama, "Tinkerbell" Hilton, "Butkus" Stallone, "Blondie" Hitler; Scooby Doo, Pablo Picasso, and many others are referenced, too.
CONTENT
 • 350 breeds (AKC and FCI)
 • 3000 images

 • Common dog sounds (growling, barking, howling, etc.)
 • Capture and share your photos
 • Online Breed Consultation
 • Quiz game

 • APPEARANCE
 • weight, height, ears, coat, etc.
 • TEMPERAMENT
 • playfulness, friendliness, etc.
 • PURPOSE
 • sporting, herding, toy, etc.
 • COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
 • England, Germany, USA, etc.
COMMUNITY
 • Sightings: add your photos, like and comment on others

 • Guess breeds from pictures

USER HINTS

 • Click on the photo to open it in fullscreen

LUT Studio - Cinematic Video LUTs & Film Look Editor
Transform your footage with cinematic color grading using LUT Studio - the ultimate video color correction and editing app for creators, filmmakers, and mobile videographers. With just a few taps, you can apply beautiful, professional-grade video filters and give your videos a stunning film look. Whether you're shooting vlogs, short films, or social media clips, LUT Studio brings the power of DaVinci Resolve - style color correction to your phone.
Cinematic color grading made it easy.
Import your clip, browse through our 90+ built-in LUTs, and instantly apply rich, moody, or vibrant tones. Our filters are optimized to match the color of a wide variety of footage styles. Whether you're aiming for a bold look or subtle enhancement, cinematic camera effects are now mobile.
LOG profile support
Take complete control over your dynamic range with support for major flat color profiles, including:
• Apple Log
• DJI Osmo Pocket 3 D-Log
• DJI Mini 4 Pro
• And more coming soon
These profiles give you the power to push your video color grading further than ever before. Whether you're using a phone, drone, or mirrorless camera, LUT Studio helps you maximize every pixel.
True film emulation
Go beyond standard filters for videos. Add a cinematic touch with real film-inspired effects:
• Halation - replicate glowing highlights for a dreamy, analog vibe
• Bloom - soften light sources for a natural film glow
• Grain - add rich texture and vintage aesthetics to your footage
Our film editor tools make your footage feel like it came straight from a high-end post-production suite.
Key Features:
• Real-time LUT preview on video clips
• Built-in and custom .cube LUT support (from DaVinci Resolve and more)
• Halation, bloom, and film grain effects
• Support for 4K export

bluejetty:00074395:ios.summary: Have you ever forgotten someone special's birthday? Do you remember that rush of panic when you realize that today is your anniversary and you don't have any present or plans? And what about those times when you should have made that call t
bluejetty:00074395:ios.description:
Have you ever forgotten someone special's birthday? Do you remember that rush of panic when you realize that today is your anniversary and you don't have any present or plans? And what about those times when you should have made that call to comfort a loved one on the anniversary of someone's passing? With Birthday Boss it will NEVER HAPPEN AGAIN.
* Keep all of your important birthdays, anniversaries, deaths, and other annual events in one place, and see what’s coming up next in a simple scrolling list or traditional calendar-style display.
* Import events quickly from your address-book contacts or add events manually for people who are not in your contacts; all you need is a name, month, and day.
* Group your items using the built-in ‘Family’, ‘Friends’, and ‘Work’ groupings or create your own custom groups.
* Get pop-up reminders on the day of each event and add additional advance notifications as needed.
* Add yearly history logs for events to help with advance planning or recording previous gifts and activities.
* See how old someone will be on their birthday or what anniversary it is, with configurable milestones to highlight those extra-special times.
* Easily share event details with standard sharing tools for email, text, print, and more.
* Send a quick ‘Happy Birthday’ email or text message directly from within the app.
* Find items quickly with search or use the assigned groups to filter what items are shown.
* Use the included Home Screen widgets to customize your device display and make your entered events available at-a-glance without even launching the app!
Birthday Boss makes staying on top of all of those birthdays, anniversaries, and deaths a breeze.

bluejetty:00165796:ios.description:
FerryFriend is the ultimate tool for ferry riders in the Puget Sound! Includes schedules and so much more for Washington State Ferries, Kitsap Transit Fast Ferries, and King County Water Taxi.
Features:
 • Brand new Apple Watch app with schedules, predictions, and your favorite routes on your wrist.
 • CarPlay support so you can check sailings, predictions, and favorites without picking up your phone.
 • Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for one-glance access to your favorite routes and ferry tickets.
 • Drive-time ETAs to the terminal from your current location, so you know how long it'll take to reach the dock.
 • Real-time delay predictions and demand forecasts so you know when sailings will be delayed and how full they'll be.
 • Sailing notifications for delays, departures, arrivals, loading, and reservation availability.
 • Cached schedules available offline, even when the WSF servers are down.
 • Inline reservation availability with quick booking from the app.
 • Drive-up space availability with historical filling trends.
 • Live vessel map with detailed status, departure/arrival times, and vessel specs.
 • Ferry line cameras on a map so you can check the line before you arrive.
 • Travel alerts with push notifications, snoozing, and day-of-week filtering.
 • Scan, save, and share your WSF ferry tickets right from the app.
 • Tide warnings and vessel load indicators in the schedule.
 • Heads-up on Kingston to Edmonds schedules when the terminal's new boarding-pass system is active, so you don't miss a
 stop at the kiosk near Lindvog Road.
 • Customizable delay display, projected departure time or time-late duration, whichever you prefer.
 • Dark mode and 24-hour time support.

bluejetty:00040404:ios.description:
Nascemos há mais de 30 anos, no bairro de Moema, em São Paulo, sempre prezando pela excelente qualidade, preço justo e variedade de modelos, cores e estilos. Como resultado, em pouco tempo já éramos consideradas sinônimo de paraíso para as amantes de calçados, com clientes fiéis e nos tornamos uma das marcas de calçados e acessórios mais tradicionais e adoradas. 
Sempre estivemos atentas às mudanças de mercado e consumo, buscamos nos manter atualizadas com o crescimento do espaço digital. E em 2021, agora como uma marca própria do Grupo Magalu, assumimos a estratégia de ampliar sua presença digital e operar 100% online, podendo atender as mulheres de todo o Brasil.
Perpetuamos a Moda como ferramenta de comunicação, expressão e autoconhecimento, fazendo do vestir-se um processo libertador. Nosso objetivo é proporcionar o melhor do universo das tendências para empoderar mulheres, através do melhor de cada uma, a seguirem novos caminhos.
Nossa missão é fazer com que todas as gerações encontrem inspiração, experimentem novidades e troquem experiências, formando assim um coletivo de mulheres autênticas e criativas. 
Shoestock é autonomia nas escolhas, quando e onde quiser.
A cada estação, apostamos em vários estilos, modelos, formas e cores, em várias numerações, para todas as ocasiões, para você se entregar à paixão por sapatos e ter a melhor experiência de compra! Caprichamos nas linhas básicas e clássicas também, para proporcionar a você uma coleção completa e funcional.
Buscamos sempre oferecer a melhor experiência de compra da internet. No aplicativo, você pode facilmente escolher seus novos sapatos, bolsas e acessórios de acordo com as categorias de produtos, de maneira prática e rápida.
No app você também pode acompanhar os seus pedidos, consultar o frete, conferir as parcelas da sua compra e ativar notificações de push para receber em primeira mão os últimos lançamentos e promoções. 
Além disso, ao se inscrever em nossa newsletter, você fica por dentro das últimas tendências e lançamentos, os best sellers de cada estação, além de dicas de calçados e acessórios para ajudar a compor seus looks! Você também recebe alertas para as melhores promoções. São muitas ofertas especiais durante todo o ano e presentes baratos que cabem em todos estilos!
Baixe agora mesmo o app e tenha as novidades da Shoestock na palma da mão!

bluejetty:00039741:ios.description:
Planeje sua viagem dos sonhos com o novo app da Smiles!
Transforme suas viagens em experiências memoráveis com o novo app Smiles. Com ele, você tem o mundo na palma da mão!
Encontre mais de 50 companhias aéreas parceiras para reservar sua passagem, além de serviços como reserva de hotéis, aluguel de carros, créditos Uber, seguro viagem e muitos outros benefícios na Smiles, o programa de fidelidade para quem é feito de viagens. Conte com ofertas exclusivas em todos os serviços Smiles e tenha acesso as melhores promoções de passagens baratas em um só lugar. 
APROVEITE OS BENEFÍCIOS DE ACUMULAR, RESGATAR E TRANSFERIR MILHAS:
- Escolha passagens aéreas para mais de 1600 destinos;
- Explore uma seleção de mais de 400 mil hotéis para reservar e acompanhar informações sobre hospedagem;
- Alugue carros dentro e fora do Brasil;
- Compre créditos Uber e acumule milhas;
- Conte com o seguro viagem para ter mais tranquilidade;
- Aproveite shows e teatros para viver cada destino;
- Descubra o Shopping Smiles e faça compras com milhas nos maiores varejistas do país;
- Solicite seu Cartão de Crédito Gol Smiles para acumular milhas em todas as suas compras.
PASSAGEM AÉREA COM MILHAS
Pesquise voos da GOL ou das mais de 50 companhias aéreas parceiras e reserve sua passagem utilizando milhas. Garanta os melhores preços em passagens baratas no app. São diversos destinos nacionais e internacionais incríveis esperando por você!
TUDO SOBRE A SUA VIAGEM EM APENAS UM LUGAR
Em nosso aplicativo você pode conferir todas as informações sobre voos, estadias, aluguel de carros, passeios e tudo mais diretamente no app. Praticidade na hora de viajar e mais tempo para aproveitar.
CARTÃO DE CRÉDITO GOL SMILES: MILHAS PARA QUEM É FEITO DE VIAGENS
Com o cartão de crédito Gol Smiles, você consegue acumular milhas na compra de passagem e também em compras do dia a dia. As milhas vão direto para a sua conta! Fique livre para usar suas milhas acumuladas em compras no Shopping Smiles, passagens baratas e outros serviços exclusivos que só o programa de fidelidade Smiles oferece para uma viagem perfeita.
CONHEÇA AINDA MAIS BENEFÍCIOS NO CLUBE SMILES
No app, você também poderá conhecer outras vantagens em fazer parte do programa de fidelidade: o Clube Smiles é um acelerador de acúmulo de milhas onde você tem acesso a benefícios e condições especiais: você pode acumular milhas em todas as compras que fizer no dia a dia e pode planejar as melhores viagens com preços exclusivos.
Além de comprar passagem com milhas, você também usa suas milhas no Clube para aproveitar todos os serviços disponíveis: reservar hotéis, alugar carros, garantir ingressos de shows, parques e eventos e também agendar passeios.
BAIXE O NOVO APP E COMECE A PLANEJAR
Com o app Smiles, você se conecta a uma plataforma de viagens completa, onde cada serviço é pensado para proporcionar experiências inesquecíveis.
O novo app Smiles está pronto para ser seu parceiro ideal em viagens. Baixe agora e comece a jornada dos seus sonhos com facilidade e estilo!

From casual to chic. Any color, pattern, shape. Create the look of your dream!

A perfect way to make sure you buy something that suits you.

Recreate an outfit you liked or make your own one from scratch. Unleash your creativity!

Look up the stores that sell outfits similar to the ones created.

– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. “Free trial” > $9.99 USD/week, or renewal equals the initial subscription chosen and its current price unless a special price is offered.
– You can cancel a free trial, manage your subscription and turn off the auto-renewal anytime through your Account Settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged.
– The guide to canceling your subscription: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
– Privacy Policy: https://irontech.mobi/stylelab/ios/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://irontech.mobi/stylelab/ios/terms
– Please note: as per Apple’s Price Matrix, the USD price is equivalent in value across different countries and is converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
– As soon as you purchase a subscription, any unused part or time-span of a free trial period will be forfeited.

bluejetty:00128307:ios.description:
The Variable Color app assists consumers, DIYers and professionals (such as interior designers, architects, paint contractors and material specifiers), streamline the color selection process. 
Scan color, find products that match, coordinate and complement. Color referencing, collecting, organizing and sharing has never been easier and more efficient. 
Variable Color offers:
 • Instant color match to exact colors
 • Speed up the color selection process
 • Share color palettes with friends, clients & colleagues
 • Material & paint libraries on your mobile device
 • Cross reference colors between brands & materials
Color referencing, collecting, organizing and sharing has never been easier, more accurate and more efficient.
A Color Reference System of a Different Color
The Variable Color system changes the way modern color management systems operate. The compact size and mobility allow for easy collection and identification of color, which is critical, as you may never know when a color will inspire you. The COLOR MUSE system gives you the ability to match these colors to color and material libraries.
Making color matching more black and white
The Variable Color system can differentiate colors the human eye isn’t able to. Our technology can be broken down into three essential components. 
The Variable Color app allows color referencing, selection and inspiration collection to streamline the color selection process.
Features:
 • Scan, store, file and reference colors
 • Reference scans against color libraries
 • Scan colors and store them in your custom palettes
 • Remembers device connections for connecting with ease during later usages
 • Provides paint and material matching for leading U.S. and International paint companies
 • Browse full color libraries of paint and material manufacturers
 • Attach pictures to your inspirational palettes
About Variable Inc.
Variable, Inc. is an industry leader in color hardware technology, color mobile app development, digital color referencing and color library management across multiple industries throughout the world.

bluejetty:00068916:ios.description:

An app designed from the concept of the Apple Watch's app to give you the best mobility in the gym, without the need to lug around the smartphone. It's all on your wrist. With CareKit and HealthKit integration, your workout will never be interrupted if your Apple Watch goes into standby mode.

With Gym Timer, you just set the number of sets and the rest time between one set and the other, then you just need to start the timer at the end of each set.
When is time to start to train again, it will alert you.
Follow us on our social media to be the first to know about new features we're developing, to get in touch with our community and give us a feedback.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gymtimer/
Instagram: @gym_timer
Twitter: @gym_timer

bluejetty:00032550:ios.description:
Voiceberry: easy-to-use and reliable app for recording business and private calls or voice memos!
Voiceberry offers a seamless and intuitive experience for capturing your important business calls or personal voice memos. With its exceptional features and user-friendly interface, recording and managing your audio files has never been easier.
Discover the remarkable capabilities of Voiceberry:
‣ Effortlessly record incoming and outgoing calls
‣ Capture your voice memos with utmost convenience
‣ Seamlessly manage your recordings with unlimited storage capacity
‣ Play, organize, share, and delete recordings effortlessly
‣ Harness the power of unlimited cloud storage for your valuable audio files
‣ Share your recordings via various platforms like text messages, email, social media, and popular cloud services such as Dropbox, WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, and more
‣ Quickly download recordings for offline access
‣ Benefit from reliable and responsive customer support whenever you need assistance
Unlock the full potential of Voiceberry with a subscription to Voiceberry Premium, offering unlimited call records and more!
Please note that your free trial subscription will automatically convert to a paid subscription unless you disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the trial period ends. If you choose to purchase a premium subscription during the trial period, any remaining unused portion of the trial will be forfeited.
You can cancel your free trial or subscription anytime by adjusting the auto-renewal settings in your iTunes account. To avoid charges, make sure to cancel 24 hours before the current subscription period expires. Upon cancellation, you will be downgraded to the free version of the app.
Recording an active call is as simple as 1-2-3:
1) Launch the Voiceberry app and tap the circle button located at the center of your screen.
2) Your ongoing call will be momentarily placed on hold while your device dials our recording service.
3) Once connected, press the "Merge Calls" button on your screen to establish a conference call between your active conversation and our recording line.
To record an outgoing call, follow these easy steps:
1) Open Voiceberry and tap the circle button in the center of the screen.
2) Choose a contact from your list by tapping the Contacts button, or manually dial the phone number.
3) You will be prompted to call our service number for recording, please tap on the number to connect.
4) After the connection is established, come back to the app – a new pop-up menu displaying your contact's number will appear. Tap the number to proceed.
5) Once the new connection with your desired contact is established, press the "Merge Calls" button for a conference call.
By using VoiceBerry, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. For more information, please review our Terms of Use: https://pelilka-apps.github.io/legal/terms-of-use and Privacy Policy: https://pelilka-apps.github.io/legal/privacy-policy
Make the most of every call and effortlessly capture important voice memos with Voiceberry. Download now and experience the perfect companion for your call recording and voice memos needs.

bluejetty:00157048:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157048:ios.description:
As humans, we’re hardwired for connection. Belonging to a community makes us feel safe and helps us thrive. 
But so often, living with breast cancer (BC) can make you feel physically and emotionally isolated. Not only can it be hard to do things you loved before your diagnosis, but it can also feel like no one understands what it’s like.
Until now.
Our mission is to cultivate a space powered by the BC community and empowered by each other. From one-to-one chats to conversation forums, we make connecting easy. This is a safe place to find and receive advice, to seek and offer support, and to discover the authentic stories of members, just like you.
Bezzy BC is a free online platform bringing new meaning to the word “community.” 
Our aim is to create an experience where:
- everyone feels seen, valued, and understood
- everyone’s story matters
- shared vulnerability is the name of the game
Bezzy BC is a place where you are more than your BC. It’s a place where, finally, you belong.
HOW IT WORKS
Social-first Content
Like all of your favorite social networks, we’ve designed an activity feed to connect you with other members living with breast cancer. We pride ourselves on making Bezzy BC a safe and secure space where you can join live discussions, connect one-to-one, and read the latest articles and personal stories.
Live Chats 
Need to vent? Get advice? Share what’s on your mind? Hop into a daily live chat to join the conversation. They’re often led by our amazing Community Guide, but you can also expect to chat with other advocates and experts, too.
Forums
From treatments to symptoms to daily living, BC changes everything. Whatever you're feeling on any given day, there's a forum where you can connect and share directly with others.
1:1 Messaging
Let us connect you with a new member from our community every day. We’ll recommend members to you based on your treatment plan, lifestyle interests, and needs. Browse member profiles and request to connect with anyone from our community with members listed as “Online now.”
Discover Articles and Stories
We believe that shared experiences empower the kind of belonging that can help people not only survive—but thrive—with breast cancer. Our stories offer perspectives and tips from people who know what it’s like.
Get handpicked wellness and member stories delivered to you each week.
Connect Safely Anytime, Anywhere 
We take thoughtful steps to build safety, security, and privacy into our platform and foster an environment where members feel safe sharing their personal experiences. Check and send messages, see who’s online, and get notified when a new message comes in—so you’ll never miss a thing. 
ABOUT HEALTHLINE
Healthline Media is the top ranked health publisher and number 44 on Comscore’s Top 100 Property rankings. Across all of its properties, Healthline Media each month publishes up to 1,000 scientifically accurate yet reader-friendly articles authored by more than 120 writers and reviewed by more than 100 doctors, clinicians, nutritionists, and other experts. The company’s repository contains more than 70,000 articles, each updated with current protocol.
More than 200 million people worldwide and 86 million people in the U.S. visit Healthline’s sites each month, according to Google Analytics and Comscore, respectively.
Healthline Media is an RVO Health Company

bluejetty:00063759:ios.description:
Welcome to Boo Town! Build your own city and make it the dream place for all the Boos to live! Build houses, public buildings, shops and other fun facilities to make your Boo dwellers feel at home on their new land!
From the creators of Boo, the world’s most beloved virtual pet, comes a new adventure!
Boo Town is the happiest place on earth, and the only neighborhood that you can have Boos all over the place! Build their homes ranging from lovely small cottages to fancy two-story houses! But your city-building tasks do not stop there! Every town needs public buildings in order to be fully functional - and yours is not different! Boo Town rely on hospitals, schools, fire stations, post offices, police stations, and even a planetarium in order to attract more citizens!
Like any other blooming city, you’ll also need to develop and support local businesses and the industrial and agricultural sectors in order to thrive! Be sure to keep an eye on your corn crops on arms, harvest them on time and sell them to your Boos on the local market! You can also produce and sell an array of items, from milk, to eggs, candies, and even some delicious cookies straight from the oven! The market is a great way to earn coins and generate revenue for your town, so that you can build it to the next level and welcome more Boo residents!
Take care of the public areas, keep your streets clean and well kept and take good care of the plants to keep your happiness level of your city high! Then just watch your city flourish! 
HIGHLIGHTS
• DISCOVER dozens of different Boo citizens
• BUILD UP more than 80 kinds of buildings
• BEAT missions to earn incredible rewards
• EXPAND your city with more than 80 plot extensions
Download our game now and start BOO-ilding your new town!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00174856:ios.description:
Grow-Your-Own with the gardening app with details on over 90 favourite vegetables and herbs. 
The planting calendar shows what you can grow at any time – localized to your climate zone. 
Detailed plant descriptions and growing tips gets novices up to speed. 
Packed full of features for experienced gardeners - add new plant varieties, record planting dates, harvest dates, notes, and more. Export your data as spreadsheet files.
Expert or new gardener, Gardenate will help keep your garden growing.
Get started quickly
• Choose your climate zone. Gardenate has climate-zone specific planting calendars for Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa, the UK, and the USA
• See what is best to grow this month in the calendar
• Put plants into your wish list
* Scan seed packet details with your phone camera directly into the app to record plants or add new plant types 
• Plant the seed and record the details in My Garden
• Calendar reminders prompt you to harvest your produce
• Enjoy your garden!
Grow what you like best
• Easily add new plant types to the plant database by scanning a seed packet or by typing in the details. New plant types will show up in your planting calendar!
• Hide unwanted plants so they don’t show in the calendar
• Watch the calendar adapt to show your chosen planting months
Share your garden
• Share your garden to your other phones and devices and they keep in sync. Let the whole family join in the gardening
• Export your plantings and notes to spreadsheet (CSV) files to use on your desktop
All information is contained in the app and no internet is needed unless you choose to sync your garden with other devices.

bluejetty:00114814:ios.name: SWORD OF JUSTICE
bluejetty:00114814:ios.summary: Welcome to Sword of Justice, an open-world MMORPG built on high freedom. A new chapter is about to begin. New players can jump right in with ease. Explore a fantasy world of top-tier visuals, with a fair and relaxed Season-based growth syst
bluejetty:00114814:ios.description:
Welcome to Sword of Justice, an open-world MMORPG built on high freedom. A new chapter is about to begin. New players can jump right in with ease. Explore a fantasy world of top-tier visuals, with a fair and relaxed Season-based growth system. Dive into combat, exploration, socializing, farming, fishing, trading, and much more. Mix, match, and dye a vast collection of outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to craft your own ideal look. Whether you go it alone or travel with friends, enjoy a journey that's free, stylish, and full of surprises your way.
A new chapter in Sword of Justice is about to begin! Everyone now stands on the same starting line! A cinematic open-world MMORPG — explore and customize your character as much as you like. Adventure solo or team up, and define your own journey!
[New School: Mystech Unveils]
Mystech, a new Might-based school that benefits from Wind stats, arrives with a flair for aerial combat and agile combos. Its signature weapon, the "Winggear," switches freely between bow, drifting blade, and umbrella for a varied combat experience. The new school also features a dual Talent system and an exclusive storyline, along with unlockable outfits and accessories. School-Change Vouchers will be distributed during this update, allowing you to try the new school with ease. 
[Fresh Seasons, Play Anytime]
The game runs on a Season-based growth system. You can earn core growth resources through a wide variety of gameplay, so you're never tied to just one. Every Season brings new content and challenges, along with new ways to ease the grind. Your character can progress steadily even with limited playtime.
[Creative Studio, Custom Gameplay]
The new version introduces the Creative Studio Editor, unlocked at character level 43, where you can build custom levels and gameplay as you like. You can also try out creations by other players, earn Ingenuity Coins, and exchange them for rewards like outfits and mounts. Join creation and submission events, and you'll have a chance at extra rewards and creator incentives.
[Open World, Immersive Exploration]
Step into a vast and breathtaking world, and roam through mountains and rivers, towns, secret realms, and underground ruins. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden treasures, and stumble upon special encounters and random events. Whether you find joy in the hustle and bustle of city life or in wandering free through nature, a new story unfolds every time you set out.
[Vast Wardrobe, Endless Styles]
Constant updates to outfits, hairstyles, mounts, and accessories add rich flair to your character's identity in the martial world. Adjust colors with smart dyeing, save and share your looks in the Dressing Room, and customize an appearance that's all your own. From classic to modern, switch styles as you please.
[Relaxed Friendships, Comfy Socials]
Make friends with other players and form Mentorship, Kinship, or Love bonds. Visit each other's manors, enjoy duo interactions, drop by parties, and hop into fun mini-games. Or immerse yourself in solo play. Spend your own time fighting, exploring, farming, fishing, and trading.
[Fair Spar, Skill Over Gear]
Jump into fair spar arenas, multiplayer battlefields, and ranked challenges for fast-paced martial world duels. Skill, teamwork, combos, and on-the-spot tactics count for more than gear stats. Tiers reset each Season, with exclusive rewards granted by ranking.
[Epic Dungeons, Cinematic Spectacle]
Take on Team Dungeons and Group Dungeons, face bosses of every style, and experience thrilling fights and immersive story cutscenes. Some dungeons support solo or duo play, so you can enjoy the full challenge even without a regular team. Clear them to earn generous gear, looks, and other growth rewards.
IOS
● Supported Specs
iPhone: iPhone 6s, iPhone 6s Plus or newer
iPad: iPad with A9 processor or newer (iPads released March 2017 or later)
iOS must be iOS 14 or above
● Recommended Specs
iPhone: iPhone XS, iPhone XR or newe

bluejetty:00084121:ios.name: BEEZER GOLF - Golf Scorecard
bluejetty:00084121:ios.summary: Enjoy the most innovative golf scorecard for FREE with 40K golf courses worldwide with GPS mapping on iPhone and iWatch, and advanced stats. Upgrade to Beezer Premium and access 28 side games and group games, keep a WHS based handicap index
bluejetty:00084121:ios.description:
Enjoy the most innovative golf scorecard for FREE with 40K golf courses worldwide with GPS mapping on iPhone and iWatch, and advanced stats. Upgrade to Beezer Premium and access 28 side games and group games, keep a WHS based handicap index, score on your iWatch, and track your bets. The app has everything you need to keep your golf scores, have fun, and improve your game.
Innovative Golf Scorecard
Beezer's unique approach to golf score tracking makes it easy to keep your golf scores and track your golf playing statistics. The golf card interactive interface is intuitive and highly customizable. You can view the full scorecard or a 9-hole version, swipe up/down to navigate, and modify the scorecard’s columns. Golf scoring made easy.
Golf GPS Rangefinder
Our golf course app includes a Golf GPS Rangefinder that allows you to track distances to greens and hazards, and it’s always a click away. See distances in yards or meters; use a graphical hole display or just a numerical reading. If your golf course is not available or has errors, let us know and we will correct it. There is a support feature right in the app to make it easy to contact us.
Golf Analytics
Our advanced golf stats include fairways hit, greens in regulation, putting and scoring insights, recoveries and sand saves. It also tracks your games and bets wins and losses. All packaged in a nice interface with groupings by course and dates. Quick access to your latest golf round or pick a round. View golf statistics trends over time.
Round Leaderboard
All payers and golf betting games have their own scorecard, which gives all scoring details, while our Round Leaderboard feature gives you a quick view on the status of all games and bets. 
Golf Handicap Tracking
The Beezer Handicap Index is an unofficial handicap index based on the World Handicap System.
Golf Bets Tracking
We use Beezer Dollars to keep track of bets —pay with dollars, pounds, quarters or beers. And if you are low in cash or don’t have time for the beer, use our Beezer Bank to save your bets, settle them anytime. This unique feature will make settling golf bets a cinch. 
Golf side games
Add some fun to your round with an extensive library of on course golf betting games. All games include the most popular variations and have their own scorecards to view the game's full details. The app is extremely flexible to allow for score corrections, starting in any hole, skip holes, adding/deleting players or games in the middle of the round, add presses to old holes, etc. Best eraser ever. 
Multi-group games
Play Skins, Best Ball or Stableford with up 120 players in 20 groups with live updates, ideal for your Saturday skins game.

About Premium subscriptions & purchases:
$29.99/year with 2-weeks free trial, $19.99/6 months with 1-week free trial, or $3.99/month with a 1-week free trial.
- Prices are for U.S. customers. Pricing for other countries may vary, chargers may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
- Payments will be charged to your iTunes account at expiration of the trial period.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hrs before the end of the current cycle.
- Manage or cancel your subscription from your App Store user settings at any time.

Military-Grade Encryption:
B-Secure employs state-of-the-art, military-grade encryption protocols to safeguard your internet traffic. Your data is transformed into an impenetrable fortress, ensuring that your online communications remain confidential and secure.
Anonymous Browsing:

Public Wi-Fi networks can be a breeding ground for cyber threats. B-Secure acts as your vigilant guard, securing your connection whether you're at a coffee shop, airport, or any public space. Browse, shop, and bank with confidence.

B-Secure is designed with user-friendliness in mind. Connect with just a tap, and let the app handle the rest. Security doesn't have to be complicated.

bluejetty:00119158:ios.description:
What is GigSpot?
GigSpot connects you with mystery shopping and market research companies. GigSpot is the place where these companies compete for your service, offering you tens of thousands of job opportunities. You decide which jobs you want, where, and when.
Get Paid to Shop and Eat? Really?
Yes, each listed job is a paying opportunity. Payment is handled by the mystery shopping or market research company posting the job. GigSpot lists the information you need to take or apply for the opportunity, including:
* Compensation and Reimbursement
* Start and End Date
* Distance
Already a Mystery Shopper? You should sign up with GigSpot!
* One simple signup gives you access to thousands of mystery shopping jobs from dozens of mystery shopping provider companies
* Manage one profile across all companies
* Easily get more jobs than ever
* Receive push notifications for new jobs - fewer emails!
* Complete certifications directly on your mobile device
- Disclaimer: This application will work best on the iPhone and iPad family of devices. iPod Touch users may experience slowdowns or random crashes.

※몰테일 앱을 최신버전으로 업데이트 하셔야 최적의 상태로 서비스 이용이 가능하니, 항상 최신 버전으로 업데이트 해주세요!
■ 앱 접근 권한에 대한 안내
「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」제22조의2에 따라 아래와 같은 목적으로 ‘앱 접근 권한’에 대한 동의를 이용자에게 받고 있습니다.
서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있으며, 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.
[필수접근에 대한 내용]
* 필수적 권한
- 없음
* 선택적 권한
- 사진 : 배송신청서, 1:1문의, 핫딜, 후기 등 이미지 첨부
- 카메라 : 배송신청서, 1:1문의, 핫딜, 후기 등 촬영 후 이미지 첨부
- Push Notification (알림) : 푸시 알림기능에 사용
※ 선택적 접근 권한은 동의하지 않아도 앱을 사용하실 수 있습니다.
※ 선택적 접근 권한 미동의시 서비스 일부 기능의 정상적인 이용이 어려울 수 있습니다.

해외 직구 주류를 관부가세, 주세, 교육세 포함된 가격으로 한 번에!

• 신용카드 할인으로 최저가 보장
• 구매한 상품의 배송현황을 실시간으로 알림 제공
• 실시간 인기 상품, 인기 스토어 제공으로 해외직구를 한눈에
• 해외직구 상품 구매 시 배송신청서 자동작성
• 직구페이 충전 시 배송비 자동결제 가능
• 생생한 후기 제공

나이키, 아디다스, 자라 등 해외 주요 상점은 물론,
다양한 해외 직구 상품과 서비스들이 준비되어 있답니다.
지금 바로 몰테일 앱을 다운로드 받아보세요.

bluejetty:00088640:ios.description:
Quetta Video Browser delivers a secure, seamless, and distraction-free browsing experience with a strong focus on privacy, speed, and useful browsing features. Enjoy fast browsing, powerful privacy protection, convenient media organization, and a cleaner web experience designed for modern users.
Download Quetta for a safer, smoother, and more efficient way to browse the web.
Media Playlist
Organize media in your Playlist for convenient playback. Keep your media organized and easily accessible in one place.
Smart Content Filtering
Browse with fewer distractions using Quetta’s intelligent filtering engine. Reduce pop-ups, banners, intrusive overlays, autoplay interruptions, and unwanted page elements for a cleaner browsing experience across the web.
Advanced Privacy Guard
Quetta includes powerful privacy protection features such as tracker prevention, fingerprinting protection, third-party cookie controls, and enhanced permission management to help keep your browsing activity private.
Quetta also helps limit tracking and unnecessary background requests from advertisers and analytics providers.
Data Vault Secured by Biometrics
Your browsing data and files stored in Data Vault can be encrypted and protected with biometric security, helping keep your private information protected from unauthorized access.
Stay on the Web, Not Forced Into Apps
Quetta helps prevent unwanted redirects that push you into external apps when browsing websites. Choose when you want to remain on the web experience instead.
Additional Features
Private file storage: Keep supported files organized in a private space for added privacy.
Magazine-style reader: Transform articles, blogs, and documents into a clean reading layout.
Enhanced screenshots: Capture webpage sections or full pages as images or PDF files.
About Quetta
Quetta is built by a team passionate about creating a faster, cleaner, and more private web experience. We believe browsers should give users more control, stronger privacy, and fewer distractions while exploring the internet.
Find more on quetta.net or follow @QuettaBrowser on X / Twitter.

Welcome to "Crime City: Bank Robbery," the ultimate shooting game that will immerse you in the thrilling world of criminal gangs and daring heists. An adrenaline-pumping shooter where you play as an FBI agent tasked with taking down a notorious gang of bank robbers in armed heist. Dive into the dangerous underworld of crime and test your skills as a sharpshooter and member of the police SWAT team.
In this action-packed game, you will face intense challenges and thrilling missions as you go head-to-head with the mafia gangsters and their powerful criminal organizations. Your objective is to prevent successful bank heists and restore law and order to crime city.
Equipped with state-of-the-art weapon, including sniper rifles, guns, pistols and advanced tactical gear, you'll engage in exhilarating shootouts and strategic battles against the gangs. Use your sharpshooting skills to take out enemies from a distance or go in guns blazing for close-quarter combat. The choice is yours.

As you progress through the game, you will uncover the dark secrets of the criminal underworld, infiltrate gang hideouts, and gather vital intel to bring down their sprawling network. Immersive visuals, realistic sound effects, and gripping storyline will keep you engaged in this thrilling crime-fighting journey and bank heists.
Prepare yourself for heart-racing action as you navigate through the treacherous city streets, encountering various challenges, and uncovering the truth behind each bank robbery. Gripping PvP battles for ultimate supremacy in crime city.

bluejetty:00029549:ios.name: Pure Upright - Virtual Piano
bluejetty:00029549:ios.summary: An upright piano sits perfectly in pop, R&B, Hip-Hop, and many more modern music genres. That’s why it’s heard in countless iconic tracks throughout musical history with the upright at the heart of the song. You don’t always need the splend
bluejetty:00029549:ios.description:
An upright piano sits perfectly in pop, R&B, Hip-Hop, and many more modern music genres. That’s why it’s heard in countless iconic tracks throughout musical history with the upright at the heart of the song. You don’t always need the splendor of a grand piano but the character and immediacy of an upright piano. Pure Upright captures the uniquely recognizable sound of the upright piano and makes it as wonderfully playable as our acclaimed Pure Piano for iOS. 
Similar to an XY pad in its flat, tactile nature, the Morph Pad offers up nine different core upright piano timbres, including Vintage, Intimate, Reverse, Gated, and Pad, to name a few. The “pure” Upright sits untouched at the heart and center of the space, surrounded by eight more presets for you to explore as you guide your finger seamlessly through the wide-ranging tonal palette of the piano. As you do so, the various timbres blend together, allowing you to create your own sounds comprising combinations of neighboring presets for you to save and recall. 
Pure Upright works as a standalone app or as an AUv3 plug-in within your DAW of choice, and extensive connectivity options allow you to easily connect to your keyboard controller via USB, direct, or Bluetooth MIDI to experience the sound of a professional grand piano through your headphones or speakers. The app also supports a direct connection to your Mac using Inter Device Audio (IDAM). This enables you to easily integrate Pure Upright into your desktop projects by sending MIDI and receiving audio with one single cable, as well as network MIDI and Inter-App Audio for triggering the piano from other apps that you might have installed.
Equipped with customizable reverb, EQ, and delay, sound creation becomes even more creative. Simply unlink any of the audio effects from the Morph Pad to dial in your own settings. Maybe you want to add a long reverb tail to add some extra atmosphere, tweak the EQ a little or add some delay to a particular sound. It’s up to you.
If all that isn’t enough, the app includes sympathetic resonance which you can adjust along with the pedal and key noise to taste, and there’s a host of flexible tuning options for when you need them. The stretched piano tuning is how a piano technician would tune the piano. The equal temperament tuning, on the other hand, is best for when layering Pure Upright with sounds like electric pianos, pads, or strings. Also provided is the ability to transpose the piano which comes in very useful if you are working with a vocalist who wants to sing in a different key!
For the best experience with Pure Upright, we highly recommend using a controller keyboard to trigger the notes so that it feels like you’re playing a real upright piano. The on-board velocity response page allows you to match the dynamic response of Pure Upright to your keyboard controller and your playing style so that you can achieve the right velocity response for you and the song you’re playing. 
Pure Upright is designed and developed by Hamburg-based e-instruments, renowned for their high-end digital recreations of acoustic instruments.
Feature Overview:
- Interactive Morph Pad - Explore the different characteristics of the upright piano 
- Nine different sounds - Navigate and blend between nine core sounds
- Studio Quality Audio at Ultra-low Latency
- Extensive Connectivity - Connect via USB, direct, or Bluetooth MIDI. Inter Device Audio (IDAM), Network MIDI, and Inter-App Audio also fully supported
- Standalone and AUv3 plug-in compatible
- Zynaptiq QREV Reverb - Have fun adding extra atmosphere and depth to your sound
- 3-Band EQ and Delay - Get creative with customizable EQ and Delay, or use the Morph Pad as a macro control
- Save, Load & Share Your Own Sound Presets 
- Sympathetic Resonance 
- Silent Key Press 
- Flexible Tuning Options 
- Customizable velocity curve 
- 24-bit, 44.1 kHz
- 1.1GB installation
