bluejetty:00074409:ios.description:
The smartest app to boost your learning efficiency, streamline homework organization, and simplify exam preparation! Homework Scanner doesn't just scan your homework—it transforms it. Erase handwritten notes, get detailed answers to math problems, and organize mistakes for focused revision—all with a few taps. Parents can also benefit from this tool, making it easier to guide their children through problem-solving and homework tasks.
Key Features:
◆AI-Powered Scanning
- Handwriting Removal: Quickly remove handwritten content and graphics, allowing for a fresh practice sheet or study material.
- Auto-edge Detection: Automatically recognizes and corrects the edges of scanned papers for perfect alignment.
◆AI Problem Solving
Convenience of one-click scanning for test papers, homework, and textbooks.
- Multi-Subject Support: From complex math equations to chemistry formulas, biological diagrams, and even historical dates, Homework Scanner helps you understand and solve problems across various subjects.
- Step-by-Step Solutions: Learn effectively by seeing how each problem is solved in detail.
◆Organize Incorrect Answers
- Erase Mistakes: Scans your test papers and automatically erases incorrect answers, allowing you to reattempt them.
- Personalized Error Sets: Save your mistakes and organize them by subject for easy access and review. You can even export these sets for future practice.
- Efficient Review: Organize errors in custom categories, so revising becomes more targeted and efficient.
◆Save, Export, and Print
- Multiple File Formats: Export scanned papers in PDF, Word, or image formats.
- Direct Printing: Connect to a printer with ease, allowing you to print out your practice sets or clean copies whenever you need.
Why Choose Homework Scanner?
1. Boost Study Efficiency
With Homework Scanner, you’ll be able to manage your study materials in less time and with less effort. Whether you’re organizing homework or prepping for exams, this app helps you streamline the entire process. No more flipping through disorganized notes—everything you need is neatly categorized and accessible at any time.
2. Simplify Revision and Preparation
Revising for exams can be overwhelming, but Homework Scanner makes it simpler. Automatically remove handwritten content from your assignments and test papers, allowing you to start fresh and focus on what matters—practicing and improving. No more hassle of re-writing questions for practice; the app does it for you!
3. Improve Your Weak Points
By organizing incorrect answers into custom sets, Homework Scanner allows you to focus on areas where you struggle the most. This targeted approach makes your study sessions more productive, helping you build confidence before exams.
Download the Homework Scanner: App that Erases Handwriting now to free yourself from study stress and make exam preparation easier.

bluejetty:00043749:android.description:
bit.com is a global cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2020, operating under the premium domain bit.com. Headquartered in Dubai, we have teams across multiple countries and regions, providing trusted services to users worldwide. Our core offerings include spot and perpetual trading, C2C cloud mining, and GoRich — an on-chain crypto trading platform. We are committed to building a one-stop digital asset investment platform that’s simple to use, secure, and accessible to everyone.
Spot & Perpetual Trading
bit.com offers a clean and intuitive trading interface for both spot and perpetual contracts. Whether you're new to crypto or a seasoned trader, you can start trading quickly and confidently.
We support a wide range of major and trending tokens, including BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), BNB (Binance Coin), XRP (Ripple), ADA (Cardano), DOGE (Dogecoin), SOL (Solana), DOT (Polkadot), MATIC (Polygon), LTC (Litecoin), AVAX (Avalanche), LINK (Chainlink), UNI (Uniswap), BCH (Bitcoin Cash), XLM (Stellar), ATOM (Cosmos), ETC (Ethereum Classic), FIL (Filecoin), ICP (Internet Computer), TRX (TRON), NEAR (NEAR Protocol), ALGO (Algorand), VET (VeChain), MKR (Maker), AAVE (Aave), EOS, KSM (Kusama), XTZ (Tezos), THETA, ZEC (Zcash), and hundreds more.
 No matter your style—spot or futures—you’ll find familiar assets and a smooth trading experience on bit.com.
C2C Cloud Mining
In April 2025, bit.com launched the industry’s first C2C cloud mining platform, allowing users to invest in BTC mining with low entry barriers. Miners can list their computing power, and users can purchase directly — with transparent pricing and daily settlements. No platform commission.
No middlemen = lower costs
Enforced fulfillment and 130% compensation guarantee
Supports major PoW coins: BTC, LTC, DOGE, BELLS, and more
On-Chain Asset Trading (GoRich)
No wallet, no private key required — seamlessly trade on-chain crypto assets directly within bit.com. Use USDT to buy trending on-chain tokens with the liquidity of a DEX and the ease of a CEX:
Limit orders, auto-matching, and automatic gas fee deduction
Cross-chain trading via a single account — no network switching
Crypto assets are securely custodied by Cactus Custody, a licensed custodian under Matrixport. All funds are fully transparent and traceable on-chain
What Can bit.com Offer You?
Whether you're buying your first crypto, exploring the hottest on-chain trends, or investing in mining yields, bit.com provides a clear, beginner-friendly path for all users — bridging the gap between centralized trading and on-chain crypto asset management.
Why Choose bit.com?
Secure and Trusted
We partner with Cautus Custody, a licensed custodian under Matrixport, to provide multi-layer asset segregation and real-time risk control. Since our launch in 2020, we’ve maintained five years of zero security incidents, helping you trade and invest with peace of mind.
Beginner-Friendly
No complex steps. No blockchain knowledge required. From buying crypto to trading futures and exploring on-chain crypto assets, our product design focuses on being clean, intuitive, and easy to use, so anyone can get started quickly.
Comprehensive Product Offering
bit.com supports a wide range of services in one place: spot, perpetuals, options, cloud mining, and on-chain asset trading — covering mainstream tokens like BTC, ETH, and trending new assets to meet the needs of every type of investor.
Regulatory Compliance
bit.com has operated legally and compliantly since day one. Our custody partners are fully licensed, ensuring a trusted environment for your digital asset journey. We’ve obtained a VASP license in Lithuania, received initial approval from Dubai’s VARA regulator, and are actively pursuing additional licenses in other jurisdictions.
bit.com is committed to building a safer, simpler, and more reliable investment experience — helping every user confidently step into the world of Web3.

bluejetty:00169407:ios.description:
DISCLAIMER: This game is free to play up to a certain point after which you will have to purchase the game to unlock the full version and continue playing.
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weirdest, wackiest, and most fantastic game show in the universe! Introducing our cast: LADY FEROCIOUS, REGINALD STARFIRE, BOAT HEAD, MR. SHIGOTO, and least of all our most promising contestant yet… YOU!
A CLASSIC REMADE
Super Monsters Ate My Condo is back for a second helping… again! The BAFTA-nominated chaotic action puzzle game makes its glorious return to mobile with updated visuals and original unforgettably addictive gameplay.
The objective is simple — swipe to feed condos to insatiable monsters! Match the correct coloured condos together and score points and create combo condos which can be matched even further to pull off insane score streaks. Feed the wrong condos to the wrong monster too many times and they will become enraged and will topple over the tower — game over! 
Push for high scores by feeding as many combo condos to the monsters as you can, and activate their special abilities to shake up the gameplay and earn crazy multipliers. With only two minutes on the clock, combine quick thinking with strategy to plan your moves carefully to get the highest score while aiming to keep the tower from toppling down!
Key features:
- Fast-paced match-3 style gameplay.
- Compete on a global leaderboard.
- Complete daily goals and earn coins.
- Gain star power to unlock rewards. 
- Meet a hilarious cast of quirky monsters.
- Unlock and collect hats for your monsters.

bluejetty:00085627:ios.description:
Shop smarter. Save more.
With Joko, you save money and earn cash back on every purchase, online and in-store.
Enjoy automatic promo codes, exclusive discounts, instant cash back gift cards, and much more. 
Everything you need to make shopping simple and rewarding, all in one free app.
How does Joko boost your spending power?
1. CASH BACK ONLINE AND IN-STORE
Shop and earn at over 7,500 partner brands and retailers (Walmart, Target, Amazon, Nike, Sephora, Booking.com, Best Buy, Airbnb, Uber, CVS, Walgreens…). 
Every purchase gives you cash back automatically, and your cash back goes straight to your Joko wallet. From there, you can transfer it to your bank, turn it into gift cards, or donate it to charity.
2. GIFT CARDS WITH INSTANT CASH BACK
Buy gift cards from top brands (Amazon, Airbnb, Uber, Target, Walmart, etc.) and get instant cash back credited to your Joko wallet. 
Use them online or in-store, and stack them with existing deals, discounts, or promo codes. The more you shop with Joko, the more you get back.
3. AUTOMATIC PROMO CODES
Tired of searching for discounts? Joko automatically tests and applies the best promo code to your cart. 
In most cases, you can even combine promo codes with cash back for double savings. More deals, less effort! 
4. WHEREVER YOU SHOP
Joko works everywhere: mobile app, website, and browser extensions (Chrome, Safari). 
On iPhone, the Safari extension detects cash back and promo codes automatically. On desktop, Chrome and Safari make sure you never miss a deal.
5. IN-STORE CASH BACK: CONNECT YOUR BANK 
Activate automatic in-store cash back by connecting your bank account to Joko. 
It’s 100% secure and free: bank-grade security, read-only access, no login data stored, and you can disconnect anytime. Joko tracks your eligible purchases and credits your cash back automatically.
6. EVOLVING OFFERS
Cash back rates, promo codes, and discounts change every week. 
Some offers are boosted for even higher cash back and faster rewards, so check back often to maximize your savings.
Thousands of partner stores
- Groceries: Walmart, Target, Aldi, Costco, Walgreens, Trader Joe’s…
- Fashion: Nike, Adidas, ASOS, H&M, Macy’s, Crocs…
- Electronics: Amazon, Apple, Best Buy, Newegg…
- Beauty: Sephora, Ulta, Kiehl’s…
- Home: Wayfair, Bed Bath & Beyond…
- Travel: Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia…
- Kids: Carter’s, LEGO, Disney Store…
Need help?
Our US-based support team is here anytime: https://support.joko.com
Join millions of users already earning cash back and saving money every day.
Download Joko and start earning more on every purchase.

You must be a Velocity Community Credit Union member to use our Mobile Banking app. 
Federally insured by NCUA.

bluejetty:00116561:ios.description:
Welcome to Ring MergeLine: Happy Puzzle, a minimalist puzzle game brimming with creativity and challenge! Here, color and strategy are intertwined, and a mental storm is triggered with a touch of the fingertips. Swipe the screen to move the colored rings, and connect three or more rings of the same color in the same row or column to trigger a beautiful elimination! There is infinite strategic depth hidden under simple rules. Whether it's fragmented time or deep challenges, you can immerse yourself in it and enjoy it!
Swipe your finger across the screen and freely move the colored rings to any space to plan the chain reaction of each step.
If three or more circles of the same color are connected horizontally or vertically in the same row/column, the elimination effect will be triggered instantly!
Accurately predict the moving path, create a domino-style chain elimination, and break the high score record!

bluejetty:00179492:ios.description:
Let's enjoy the farm life with Sumikkogurashi!
- Grow various crops to make snacks and dishes!
- Decorate your farm with variety of decoration items!
- Dress up Sumikkogurashi to suit your mood!
- A new event is being held every month!
[Game introduction]
This is a farm game where you can relax with Sumikkogurashi.
Grow crops with Sumikkogurashi, make your favorite snacks, put up chairs to rest, or just enjoy creating your own wonderful farm and enjoy a your time with Sumikkogurashi.
[How to play]
You grow and harvest a variety of crops on the farm, combine them to make snacks and dishes, and ship more and more.
You will receive experience points (XP) and coins when you answer your orders.
You will level up as your XP increase.
As you level up, you can expand your farm and get variety of decoration items.
Let's make your own cute farm.
This game also has a dress-up function, and you can freely dress up Sumikkogurashi.
Enjoy coordination according to the season and your mood.
Once you've created a farm full of originality, you can easily interact with it using social features.
[Character introduction]
-Shirokuma
Shirokuma is a shy bear who migrated south to avoid the cold.
Shirokuma feels most calm while drinking hot tea in a corner.
-Penguin?
Am I even a penguin? Penguin has no confidence.
In the past, there might have been a plate on Penguin's head...
-Tonkatsu
The end of a tonkatsu.
Made of 1% meat, 99% fat.
Left behind for being too oily...
-Neko
Shy and timid, Neko usually hides in the corner.
Neko worries about its body shape.
-Tokage
Is actually the last of the dinosaurs.
It pretends to be a lizard to avoid being caught.
Slowly warming up to Nisetsumuri.
More characters will be added in the future.

-This app contains paid in-app purchases
-This app requires an internet connection, data rates may apply. Check your internet provider for details.
-This app supports iOS 15 or above
-This app supports iPhone 6s or above, iPad air 2 or above, iPad mini 5 or above, iPod touch 7 or above.

bluejetty:00120331:ios.name: Kids Math Games - Addition
bluejetty:00120331:ios.summary: Math your kids will actually ask to play! Meet Bobo, a cheerful little orange, and join him on an adventure through six colorful worlds. Children learn to count, add, subtract and multiply by playing, with big friendly buttons, a voice that
bluejetty:00120331:ios.description:
Math your kids will actually ask to play! Meet Bobo, a cheerful little orange, and join him on an adventure through six colorful worlds. Children learn to count, add, subtract and multiply by playing, with big friendly buttons, a voice that reads every question aloud, and a reward around every corner.
WHY KIDS LOVE IT
• 90 levels across 6 worlds: a sunny farm, a number forest, candy hills, an ocean, a sky castle and a rocket-ship planet
• Hatch and collect 24 adorable pets, from common to legendary
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level
• Beat Zorb the space monster and the other bosses
• Open a free daily gift: eggs, boosts and a golden egg at the end of the week
• Cheerful music, fun sounds and gentle haptics
WHY PARENTS LOVE IT
• Learning in small steps, from counting to multiplication
• Never any ads
• A Grown-ups area, locked behind a parental gate, with weekly play time, the skills your child is strongest and weakest in, and progress in every world
• Voice, sounds and music can each be switched off
• Available in 12 languages
WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL PRACTICE
• Counting, number recognition and number order, including counting on, back and skip counting
• Addition up to 10 and up to 20
• Subtraction
• Mixed addition and subtraction up to 20
• Multiplication tables, from the easy 2, 5 and 10 up to 6, 7, 8 and 9
• Number bonds: which two numbers make a total
• Balancing the scale, to understand what "equal" really means
• Missing-number equations, where the answer can be anywhere in the sum
HOW IT WORKS
Every world is a path of 15 levels that get a little harder as your child goes. Questions are short and are read aloud. Stars reward getting answers right on the first try, so children love coming back to win all three.
Sunny Farm, the counting world, is free to play. Math Fun Plus is a single one-time in-app purchase that unlocks all 6 worlds and all 90 levels. No subscriptions. More levels are on the way.

bluejetty:00047037:ios.summary:

At the beginning of the game, the app displays 7 letters drawn from the "bag". You then try to find the hig
bluejetty:00047037:ios.description:
With Duplikat you will have fun developing your skills in all those word games where you have to combine letters to form crosswords.
At the beginning of the game, the app displays 7 letters drawn from the "bag". You then try to find the highest scoring word and place it on the game board. When you have decided or at the end of the thinking time (when you are playing a timed game), you tap "Validate" to enter your move. At this point the app announces the "max score", i. e. the word that gives the highest score in context and places it on the board. You only score the number of points corresponding to the word that you have found. The app then draws the new letters from the bag, and the game continues. 
There must be at least two vowels and two consonants up to the 15th move then one vowel and one consonnant from the 16th move. If the seven letters selected do not respect these constaints, they are put back in the bag and seven new letters are chosen. If there are no more consonants or no more vowels in the bag, the game ends.
- The app comes with a small number of prepared games that you can replay in full. But you can also start random games and play them until the 8th move. With Duplikat Pro, this limit disappears and you can continue the game until the end.
- All games can be saved for replay or sent by email (in csv or txt format)
- The app supports several languages: French, English, Spanish, German, Dutch, Italian, Greek and Romanian. 
- Several types of board are available: Scrabble, Words With Friends, Wordfeud, Lexulous
- three dictionaries available in English (Enable, CSW and TWL)
- Display of the current max score on option
- Timed game (15 seconds to 10 minutes)
- Joker game
- Topping mode
- Dark mode support
- The Anagram tab allows you to search for words that can be formed from letters in the current rack, taking into account the constraints specified in the "Filter" area. With Duplikat Pro, you can enter the letters of your choice in the ‘Selection’ field, or even clear this field to extend the search to the entire dictionary.

Good Morning Good Night 2027 is the all-in-one app for warm wishes, beautiful images, inspiring quotes, and heartfelt messages — for every moment of your day in 2027. Greet the people you love in one tap: copy, share to WhatsApp, or save to your gallery.
Start your morning with a smile and end your night with gratitude. Everything is organized by time of day and occasion, so the right greeting is always a tap away.
 FOUR BEAUTIFUL COLLECTIONS
• Good Morning Collection
Fresh good morning images 2027, warm wishes, uplifting quotes, and sweet messages to start the day. Enjoy sunrise and coffee pictures, cheerful flower greetings, motivational lines, and romantic notes for your wife or husband.
• Good Afternoon Collection
Bright good afternoon images 2027, happy midday wishes, positive quotes, and friendly messages to keep the good energy going through the day.

Calm good evening images 2027, cozy wishes, peaceful quotes, and relaxing messages to unwind and reconnect with family and friends.

 WISHES, QUOTES, MESSAGES & IMAGES FOR EVERY OCCASION
Love, romantic, family, friendship, motivation, and blessings — all thoughtfully sorted so the perfect greeting is easy to find.
 CREATE YOUR OWN CARDS
Design custom greeting cards your way: choose a background color or photo, add your text and emojis, set the font size, color, and alignment, then save, share, or download as an image. Every card you make is kept in "My Creations."
 MADE FOR SHARING
• One-tap share to WhatsApp and any app
• Copy any message instantly
• Save images straight to your gallery
• No sign-up required
 THOUGHTFUL FEATURES
• Favorites — save the wishes, quotes, and images you love
• Daily Reminders — gentle morning and night notifications
• Routines & Mood — simple daily routines and mood check-ins
• Fresh Every Day — content reshuffles each time you open the app
• Light & Dark Mode
• Works offline once loaded
 FAMILY-FRIENDLY FOR EVERYONE
Every greeting is positive, wholesome, and suitable for all ages — perfect for parents, partners, kids, friends, and coworkers.
Download Good Morning Good Night 2027 and share a little warmth every day .

bluejetty:00065040:ios.description:
Kualto is like a crystal ball that tells you how much money you will have at any point in time, not just at the end of the month.
Keep organized by tracking your spending, and plan ahead by forecasting your cash flow and account balance.
Pay off your debt. Use our Balance Report to see how long it will take you to do so, and to catch any red flags months before something becomes a problem.
While most budgeting applications focus on your past spending, with Kualto you can focus on your future by projecting your beginning and ending balance each week.
You can afford more than you think. With our forecasting approach you can see how much you can spend, and when you can spend it!
See the consequences of your decisions before you make them. Play with 'what if' scenarios so you can make the right choices.
Always know what's coming up. Use transaction statuses to keep track of what is still due, and what's been paid.
Pay on time. Receive reminders so you know when bills are due, avoid late fees, and pay responsibly.
Your Kualto account can be accessed via the app or with a browser. No need to sync or back anything up. Access your data from anywhere.
How it works:
- Enter your account's current balance.
- Enter your bills and your income and how often they occur ("bi-weekly", for example).
- Track your balance each week and navigate forward or backward up to 30 years.
- Watch how your spending today affects your account balance in the future, and make spending decisions accordingly.
- Get reminders for bills that are due so you never pay late again.
After the 30-day trial, you must subscribe to continue using the app. These subscriptions are auto-renewing. You have the option of an Annual or Monthly subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

From the cheering crowd to the swish of the racket, every detail is designed to make you feel like you're in the game with a chance to score at every turn.

- Choose your favorite character and customise their appearance with different outfits and accessories. As you progress through the game, you can unlock new characters with unique playing styles and abilities. - From rackets to shoes to outfits, there are plenty of items to choose from.
Upgrade to unleash the battle
- Upgrade your Character and equipment to improve your performance on the court. 
- With each upgrade, you'll gain new abilities and bonuses that can help you win matches.

bluejetty:00133568:ios.summary: Enter the enchanting world of Bird Kind and join a spirited forest community, working together to restore bird life to this magical domain. Relax in the tranquility of the forest as you nurture a captivating array of bird species, each with
bluejetty:00133568:ios.description:
Enter the enchanting world of Bird Kind and join a spirited forest community, working together to restore bird life to this magical domain. Relax in the tranquility of the forest as you nurture a captivating array of bird species, each with their own unique charm and splendor. From whimsical hummingbirds to vibrant parakeets, you’ll encounter some of nature's most exquisite birds.
Restore the forest's former glory by helping a lone tree spirit to summon new birds and raise them through their lifecycle. By clearing away the overgrowth and enabling sunlight to dapple the forest floor once more, you'll provide the ideal habitat for birds to flourish. Delight in the thrill of discovering new bird species and raising them to adulthood, while uncovering facts and learning more about the world of birds.
Progress from humble beginnings to establish a wondrous forest. Level up birds, collect feathers to summon new bird species, and meet a charismatic ensemble of forest dwellers as you complete missions and events that bestow valuable rewards!

bluejetty:00144473:ios.description:
«Аптека АНЦ» — це онлайн пошук ліків з можливістю бронювання медикаментів в аптеці або доставкою, а також повний список аналогів і замінників до кожного препарату.

Додаток АНЦ — це:
• Простий, дружній інтерфейс. Нічого зайвого, лише традиційна форма пошуку та бронювання ліків та інших товарів із підказками назв.
• Можливість здійснювати бронювання у зручному онлайн-форматі. Бронюйте товари та ліки з будь-якого куточка міста та забирайте їх у найближчій до вас аптеці або з доставкою. 
• Можливість заощаджувати. Бронюйте медичні товари вигідно: отримуйте бонусні бали щоразу, коли робите замовлення в аптеках «Аптека АНЦ», «Аптека Копійка», «Аптека Шара». Використовуйте бонуси при наступному візиті в аптеку та отримуйте ще більше економії!
• Можливість швидко знайти найближче аптечне відділення. Додаток допоможе швидко зорієнтуватися на місцевості та вибрати зручну аптеку за адресою або геолокацією. Для швидкого бронювання виберіть улюблену аптеку.
• Можливість швидко отримати інформацію щодо медичних засобів та аналогів різних препаратів. У списку — вибір лікарських засобів від різних виробників і в упаковках різного об’єму. Ви можете переглянути інструкцію, а також порівняти ціни ліків в аптеках.
• Можливість відстежити наявність ліків. Додаток покаже кількість упаковок в аптеках міста.
• Можливість переглянути історію замовлень із зазначенням дати, адреси, вартості та переліку товарів дасть змогу швидко згадати назви потрібних медичних препаратів, косметики, БАДів, вітамінів тощо.
• Можливість контролювати бонусні бали. У вас під рукою завжди буде інформація щодо балансу бонусів.
• Можливість першими дізнаватися про знижки. Сповіщення дадуть змогу отримувати інформацію про зроблені покупки та нові акції в онлайн-аптеці.
Залишайте у додатку свої відгуки — це допоможе нам поліпшувати сервіс, щоб зробити пошук та бронювання ліків для кожного клієнта максимально зручним.
Персоналізуйтеся! Заповніть профіль, щоб отримати індивідуальні пропозиції та користуватися всіма перевагами онлайн-бронювань.
Будьте здорові! Заощаджуйте час та гроші!

bluejetty:00045732:ios.name: McLeod Driver Sidekick
bluejetty:00045732:ios.summary: Driver Sidekick is an all-new app connecting drivers to the back office, expediting billing, and enhancing driver satisfaction. It features an updated, intuitive look and feel, a home screen “dashboard” view, and a dedicated set of permissi
bluejetty:00045732:ios.description:
Driver Sidekick is an all-new app connecting drivers to the back office, expediting billing, and enhancing driver satisfaction. It features an updated, intuitive look and feel, a home screen “dashboard” view, and a dedicated set of permissions to ease implementation. Driver Sidekick is designed for drivers. They can easily see their current assignment and can use the filterable list views to quickly locate the information they desire.
Home Screen 
On the Home Screen, the Current Assignment card welcomes the driver and provides load details, stop information, and appointment details and mileage to the next stop. The buttons visible beneath the card allow drivers to scan a document, create a new message, request time off, or run a Driver History Report. Drivers can review their most recent settlement details. Custom links allow the home office to curate employee communications, safety videos, links to vendor partners, benefit providers, and more.
Messages 
Sidekick’s Messages center makes it easy to filter messages sent and received, read and unread. The app sends confirmation messages with tappable thumbnails to review scanned images for easy reference.
Loads 
In the Loads section, Sidekick allows you to filter loads based on whether they’re available, in progress, or delivered. Each load type is color coded for consistency. The detail view for each load includes the following tabs: Stops, Map, Freight, and Images. The Stops tab displays key information about each stop on the load along with the load’s total miles. Drivers can see the stop’s average location rating and review the location after a visit, answering your custom questions. If freight is damaged, they can submit an OS&D claim, capturing photos of damaged freight and providing details as needed.
The Map tab allows drivers to see plotted commercial routes. The Freight tab displays weights, measures, and commodity information, along with safety training links for that commodity.
The Images tab displays a badge with a count of missing required images and allows drivers to review previously scanned documents. This way, drivers can easily see if a load is missing a required image from Rendition Customer because that missing document’s icon will be red. Drivers can also capture signatures, scan documents, and either take freight photos or upload them from the device’s photo library.
Pay 
The Pay screen makes it easy for drivers to see their pay history and pending settlements. The list of paid settlements includes the check number, date and amount and is linked to the Settlement Summary PDF from LoadMaster. The Pay section is configurable. You can disable paid settlements, pending settlements, or the Current Check Card on the Home Screen.
Settings 
Drivers can view their profile, which includes important dates like the driver’s work anniversary and the expiration of the driver’s physical and other certifications. You can enable automatic reminders to renew these credentials in LoadMaster. These reminders are sent to the driver as “push” notifications even when the app is not running on the driver’s device. If necessary, drivers can create a Motor Accident report that includes details and photos from the accident scene. The Support tab contains critical device and app data and a convenient button to request McLeod Support.
Driver Sidekick requires McLeod LoadMaster version 22.2 or newer.

bluejetty:00013956:ios.description:
The Clio mobile app helps you stay profitable and productive by accessing essential case and client information remotely. Update case statuses, communicate with clients and firm members, and review, share, or scan documents all from the palm of your hand.
KEY FEATURES
CAPTURE AND BILL FOR MORE TIME–Track billable and non-billable time on the spot.
・Increase profitability with time-tracking tools, expense categories, and custom billing rates.
WORK FROM ANYWHERE–Quickly access client, case, billing, and calendar information wherever you are.
・Stay on top of your day with a dynamic calendar and task lists.
KEEP IN TOUCH WITH CLIENTS–Communicate with clients securely and conveniently.
・Get instantly notified when a client messages you through the client portal or text message, and respond directly from the app.
MAKE IT EASY TO GET PAID–Accept in-person payments with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
・Get paid in-person with no terminal or extra hardware needed. Clients simply hold their debit card, credit card, or digital wallet to your phone and the payment is automatically recorded in Clio.
HAVE PEACE OF MIND–Rest assured knowing Clio has industry leading security and is approved by over 100 global bar associations and legal societies.
・Don’t risk losing important paper files or exposing client data by securely storing client and case data in the cloud.
TRACK TIME USING SIRI–Start and stop timers without interrupting your workflow. 
・Say “Siri, start a timer in Clio” to start the timer, then “Siri, stop timer in Clio” to stop it. It’s hands-free and convenient, helping you record all of your work in real-time.
TURN PAPER DOCUMENTS INTO PDFS–Save files to Clio from anywhere with no extra hardware required. 
・Scan documents from anywhere while automatically cropping out messy backgrounds and combining multiple pages into one file—leaving you with clean and professional PDFs.
LEVERAGE LEGAL AI–Get the answers you need in an instant.
・Get invoices drafted, checked, and routed to the right approvers automatically and leave writer’s block behind when you generate instant, professional text messages and client portal replies.

bluejetty:00170640:ios.summary: Share and split your live video screen stream to many devices simultaneously. App allows you to broadcast and to watch any content from desktop. Stay secure with alfacast while watching live streaming, the app supports end-to-end encryption
bluejetty:00170640:ios.description:
Share and split your live video screen stream to many devices simultaneously. App allows you to broadcast and to watch any content from desktop. Stay secure with alfacast while watching live streaming, the app supports end-to-end encryption technology. Automatic discovery technology will allow you to enjoy using the app. Forget about logins, installation and the long process of setup video broadcast servers, for alfacast it is simply not necessary. Stream your content from a video camera apps, photo album apps, stream video from player apps, show presentations, slides, photos or pictures anywhere and anytime!
To stream video from apps, you need to open a third-party app. The alfacast will capture your screen with all the displayed content. You need to display content from a third-party app on the streamer device screen.
For example, if you want to stream video from a camera, follow these steps on the streamer device:
• Run alfacast app and follow the instructions to use the app as a streamer
• Open the camera app and display it on the device screen. The alfacast app does not use your camera or access it
After that please follow these steps on your viewer device:
• Run alfacast app and follow the instructions to use the app as a viewer
• Select your streamer with a camera from the list of users in the alfacast app and watch the screen cast from the camera
alfacast features:
• Desktop screen streamer and viewer within local area network
• Serverless single channel peer-to-peer streaming technology
• Serverless multichannel peer-to-many streaming technology
• Full free
• Video streamer & viewer up to SD quality
• Automatic discovery of users on the local network
• Secure connection with end-to-end AES-128 encryption technology
• Multiplatform support

bluejetty:00126950:ios.description:
Orbot is the original free and open-source Tor-powered VPN for iOS and macOS. Orbot helps you access the internet with more safety and privacy, and no extra cost to you.
FEATURES:
- Browse the internet over Tor.
- Secure your traffic from insecure wireless networks and ISPs.
- Access .onion sites that are only accessible over Tor.
DISCLAIMERS:
- Web browsing is much slower than through a normal VPN because your traffic is encrypted and relayed through the Tor network.
- Orbot might not work on networks with advanced network restrictions. If the app does not connect, try using bridges (or a different type of bridge).
- Use of Orbot is at your own risk; remember that sensitive data does not always belong on a mobile device.
** Orbot is free and open-source software. You can read more about Orbot and how to support development of Tor on iOS by visiting orbot.app **

bluejetty:00161920:ios.description:
Rav-Pass: Taking public transit rides has never been easier. Plan your trip with real time schedule updates and pay directly from your mobile device
Pay directly from your phone - no cash and "smart" cards required, just take your phone to your next ride and scan the QR code onboard.
With Rav-Pass you can pay in any bus, train & light rail in Israel and enjoy daily and monthly discounts without upfront payments. 
Prefer using Rav-Kav? No problem! Top it up with your iPhone. Tap the Rav-Kav card near the camera area on your device (back or front), select the contract you want, pay using all major credit and debit cards. Tap again to complete the topup and you're ready for your next journey!
You can choose between Credit value which is acceptable by all public transit operators in Israel, or a Daily and Monthly passes according to the area of your travel.
Rav-Pass is an official public transportation payment app licensed by the Ministry of transportation in Israel. 
Rav Kav top up is available on iPhone 7 and above with iOS13+ 
We'd love to hear your feedback support@ravpass.co.il
Safe journeys, 
HopOn Rav-Pass Team

bluejetty:00023404:ios.description:
Turn your child’s drawings into living, playable characters.
Every picture becomes something kids can play with — they create, animate, and interact with what they draw right on the screen. Then meet Candy, Cookie, and Pudding from Kid-E-Cats, ready to move and react inside each finished scene.
FROM COLORING TO PLAY
• Color and customize your characters, then watch them come alive instantly
• Tap and interact inside each scene to keep the play going
• Simple, kid-friendly controls with bright colors and playful textures
• Guided drawing helps kids succeed from the very start
CREATIVITY THAT BUILDS SKILLS
Coloring supports early development in a natural way. Kids improve fine motor skills, build coordination and focus, and express their imagination through creative play.
WHAT’S INSIDE
• 15+ interactive coloring scenes with Kid-E-Cats
• Animated worlds to explore after coloring
• New content added regularly
SAFE FOR KIDS
• No ads
• Designed for a child-friendly experience
• Simple and intuitive interface

bluejetty:00061509:ios.description:
[Description]
Panecal is a scientific calculator app that lets you display and modify formulas. By allowing you to review your formulas as you type, it helps prevent typos and calculation errors. You can also reuse past formulas and utilize variable memory to recalculate by changing only specific values.
The on-screen cursor allows you to quickly navigate to where you want to edit by tapping or using the arrow keys. Featuring a powerful, flexible, and intuitive user interface, the app also supports swiping to scroll through formulas and long-pressing to copy and paste.
[Features]
- Recalculate easily using past formulas
- Effortless editing with cursor navigation and screen swiping
- Copy and paste formula text
- History log for both formulas and calculation results
- Binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal calculation and conversion (Up to 32-bit)
- M+/M- memory functions and variable memory (A–F)
- Support for arithmetic operations, inverse trigonometric functions, logarithmic functions, power/root functions, factorials, absolute values, percentage calculations, modulo operations, and polar/cartesian coordinate conversion
- Multiple angle units (DEG, RAD, GRAD)
-Multiple display formats: Normal (standard), Fix (fixed decimal), Sci (significant figures), and Eng (engineering notation in multiples of 3)
-Customizable decimal point characters and grouping separators
[Disclaimer]
Please note that Appsys accepts no responsibility for any damages, lost profits, or claims from third parties arising from the use of this software.

bluejetty:00186931:ios.name: Anatomy 3D Atlas
bluejetty:00186931:ios.summary: Explore the human body like never before with Anatomy 3D Atlas, the powerful interactive anatomy app designed to help you study, visualize, and understand every structure in stunning 3D detail. Whether you're a student, a healthcare profess
bluejetty:00186931:ios.description:
Explore the human body like never before with Anatomy 3D Atlas, the powerful interactive anatomy app designed to help you study, visualize, and understand every structure in stunning 3D detail. Whether you're a student, a healthcare professional, or simply curious about how the human body works, Anatomy 3D Atlas gives you the tools to do it all in a simple and intuitive way.
With highly detailed 3D models and a smooth, user-friendly interface, you can observe every anatomical structure from any angle and explore the relationships between organs, muscles, and systems with ease. The app is designed to make anatomy more visual, interactive, and easier to understand compared to traditional study methods.
The atlas includes a wide range of anatomical systems, allowing for a complete and structured exploration of the human body:
- Musculoskeletal system
- Cardiovascular system
- Nervous system
- Respiratory system
- Digestive system
- Urogenital system
- Endocrine system
- Lymphatic system
- Sensory systems
Key features:
- Detailed 3D Models: Explore anatomical structures with high-quality models and textures. Observe every part of the human body with precision, from individual bones and muscles to complete systems
- Interactive Navigation: Rotate, zoom, and move each model freely in 3D space. Easily focus on specific areas or structures for a more targeted study experience
- Layer-Based Visualization: View anatomical structures through different layers, from superficial to deeper levels, to better understand how the body is organized
- Hide & Isolate Tools: Hide or isolate one or more structures to simplify complex views and concentrate on specific elements
- Search & Selection: Quickly find any anatomical part and display its name instantly by selecting it
- Detailed Descriptions: Access additional information for structures, including key details such as origin, insertion, innervation, and function for muscles
- Custom Views: Save your preferred views and quickly return to them using the bookmark (pins) feature
- Multilingual Support: The app and anatomical terminology are available in multiple languages, with the option to display terms in two languages simultaneously
How It Works:
1. Select a body region or system
2. Choose a model to explore
3. Interact with it using intuitive gestures (rotate, zoom, isolate)
4. Discover anatomical structures and their relationships in detail
Subscription Information
Subscribe to access to premium app features; subscription details are the following:
- Length: weekly, yearly
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6808720042.name: Passport Stamps – Travel Map
apple-macos:6808720042.description:
Passport Stamps turns your travels into a living map — and lets the people who traveled with you help fill it in, together, in real time.
A map you actually own
Every pin, every note, every photo lives in your own private iCloud — not our servers. There are no ad trackers, no account to create, and no company database standing between you and your travel history. Uninstall the app and your data is still exactly where it's always been: your iCloud.
Real collaboration, not just a shared view
Create a trip map and invite your family. You choose who can edit and who can only view, so a partner can add places while the grandparents just follow along. Edit the same trip at once and Passport Stamps detects the conflict and lets you resolve it, instead of silently dropping someone's changes. Sharing is free, for as many people as you like — there's no hosting bill standing between you and your family's map.
Built for how you actually travel
• Tap a country or state right on the map to mark it — real borders, not just a pin
• Track status per place: visited, want to go, lived there, or going again
• Attach photos and notes to any location
• Curated checklists for U.S. National Parks and UNESCO World Heritage Sites
• Coverage stats: percent of the world visited, countries, states, and continents, counted automatically
• "Year in Passport": a personal annual recap of everywhere you went
• Export your map, or your stats, as a shareable image or PDF
Designed like a well-loved passport
A warm, vintage-air-travel look — parchment tones, airmail navy, postage-stamp motifs — with a full dark mode for night flights.
Passport Stamps runs everywhere your family does — iPhone and iPad — so the map stays in sync no matter whose device someone opens it on.
